tei:div.tei:p: 54 7 ri sa snye smra tsho / 3chi dī tās tsho su phyo ci ci me / //ci ga skum / ’ byu la lge pa sdi /( ca 5༄ni mo /ci sha la/ cig ci ma sa la ga 4zhe4 ci/ 2 4 — ri pho — —— — — tsho ci ge ——— — ci — —— — po ci nga ci rku miru ga 38 4 〉〉gyi ri co ji che rdo ri tshatshabarngu gang ni 33 ci mo dzi snye ci mo :hā 6nya kha 'im ma ci ga ci tsho — girtse rtsa —— —— 7 ca sto 0 0 095 4 5 ) 〉 ri )tsho/byu 4 — (3 — ri sgro 0 ne bsnyi 〉na ri ru ci la si khrom zheng chen rnga chib khul bo snga la rnyi ci ༷ sa rme sne kyi par cas skyes me/ ga byas pa/ tsho— ca byu — dri ci rig ———— rsha dzā — — snye 3 — ga rme ho — — — ——— — — — — lag /ri rdo te (6 byus zheng ri ste rdo / )ri byung5) 4 khutsho ci rngu sna sgyu sa ci ri sngal phri/ khu tsha te mi 0 6 gā'i ci (༄ge rari 43 kyi rshazhu〉༄ )ri sa/ — ske ri 〈〈khu ri byā ri ga la —— do rna —ci'i sri nga /ri/ ciXrdo / ) tsha dze ma dzes rwa — tsho gsaldotā chi dzo tsho tsho ci'i jirngo sre /sku nasgrom tsho 3 pe riri ri snye — —༷ neriX ga ༷ ri me 4 / ji ri ri byu shā / ri ༷ ri byusko/ ༷rnyas da spungasgo rwa༄ ri ci snyeX ༵ ci riX rme rdzog ci /sa tre/rtsa ri ca7 pe la ga4) sne rnel /ri ge shā ci mer ༷

dkar chagathog mar brgyud pa'i man ngag (1)gso dpyad rin po che'i 'phreng ba (4)nad kyi ngos 'dzin 'phrul 'khor drug cu rtsa bzhi ba/ (19)grum bu bcos pa phyag spa na lu gas / (49)rkang 'bam bcos pa (52)sna sbyongs/ (54)rde'u gso ba/ (56)bi ji'i mtshal 'u kha sdom/ (58)thal 'gyur 'phang lugs / (39)tsha gzer bcos thabs/ (62)'khun pa gros 'debs/ (64)bad kun cu ga po'i sgo sa bcos (66)rlung chen lnga'i ngos 'dzin (75)rlung mdzod dkar mo phyag sman lugs/ (7(1)rna ba'i sgos bcos (90)mgo bcos bdung rtsi'i gzer bu (93)bad gan bcos thabs (96)chu ser dkar bo gso ba/ (97)'bras bcos/ (1(37)par pa ta bcos pa/ (10 ri))1

la gnang ba'o/ / sngon gyi las 'phro'i dbang gis khu tshur 'bum dang mjal /bdag rang kho ngo'i bsod nams yin no rsha ma/ rim pa bzhin du bu la'ang mna' dang bka' rgya/ yon la gser sgrong re/ gos phyi nang re/ rta bzang ba re long / dpe bu la'ang g.yar rgyu yon la gser zho re mna' lan sasum dgos pa'i ba 'a rgya yod/ bu min ga'an la rgyal srid khug rung sbyin mi bya/ 'di thosas sman pa gzhan gyis 'gran blo bral/ nga min gzhan la yod pa min/ /dkon mod rgyal khams mi la dris / /phyag smun nga rgyal mi che rgyu/long nas yon tan rgyas pa dang / /khu tshur man ngag yod pa'i rtags / /'di med gcer bu mda' la brgya ba 'dra/ /'dzi med go ma tshon med pa 'i dang 'a ngo 'dra/ /des na ku tshur 'di la gces pa ra zungs/ gcig brgyud kho na'o /phyag sman nang na'ang re re rtsam/ snying dang 'dra ba'i bu la yod/ kun la ma yel snying la chongs/ /kun gyis shes na malas pa su yis byed/ /mang na rin chen gser yang mod/ /'dzi 'dra thosas kyi phyas mi na 'gran zla bral /nad la khyad 'don thon gyin rang ma dngas skye/ /phyag sman mkhas pa'i khyad chos 'don nga yin/ mna' dang yon so gas brka' rgya ma byas par/ /rna na ngag ston pa rnam sa la chos skyong zhal bzhi pa la sogs te/ bka' srung gter bdag rnam sa kyis bka' chad myur du phob cig sa la ya : rgya rgya rgyaḥ yi thi/maṅga / / / (

ni tshad pa ma yin zhing / /'di ni tshad pa 'i grogs su 'gal tshe na/ /shing dang rlung la reg bya tsha med de/ /gnas skabs bdag gas me yi grogs byed glu bzhin/ /'di dus rgyu la gnas pa'i grosas zhes bya/ /gnyen po grosas kyi thog tu babs pas na/ /grogs 'phel bas ni tshad pa nyid 'phel byed /nge phyir smin byed gnyen po ma gtogs pa/ /gnyen ngo bsten na 'chi 'am 'tsho dala' gyur/ /ma smin pa la chang sne mi btung cing / /yang na ma smin 'bru la mar khu ba'in/ /de dus gso bar byed pa'i sman pa bslus/ /smin long med na nad khams shas che bas/ /ma smin nyid nas nges par srog la gol / /dper na grong khyer chen por me thor bas/ /myur du rdzas snams bsregs par byed pal glu bzhin /'di la smin byed sanyen po dus gcis bsten/ /'di ni gnyen po bsten pa ra bka' bas na/ /nges par gso dka' myur du srog la rgol/ /rang nyirdo smin pa rang bzhin yu la dus rnams/ /gnyen por gyur pa smin par gyur pa de/ /de yang mkhris pa che dang ston dus dang /drag shul bsten dang la zas drod bag zos/ /smin par sla ste myu ra du bcos par bya/ / ces las ma 'das gnyen ngo gang bsten kyang / /thog tu babs te bcos par sla nga yin/ smin du mi 'dod rang bzhin yu la dus rnam sa/ /'gal bar gyur pa sa grogs kyi bad rlung bcas/ /de yang bad rlung shas che dbyar dang dgun/ zas dang spyod la ma bad rlung skyed pa ste/ /smin par gyur te nad stobs che gyur na /smin long med pa nyid du 'gyur ba yin/ /nad stobs chung na gso da 'a hūṃ na du sanas/ /smin pa'i grogs kyi bad rlung med pa nge/ /de nyid tshad pa rkyang bar 'dus pa 'o/ /spor byed bud shing zad pa 'i me dang 'dra/ ('ji la skad cis tsam yang mi 'pho bar / sanyen ngo gang yin thabs 'di myu ra du bsten / /snangs pa ma smin pa yi dus nge ru/ /bsil la rtsub pa'i thang dang bsil sbyor dang / gtar ga kha zas bsil la rtsub pa yis/ /rlung gis tshad nga zungs la 5

gyis don ni grang ba yin/ /stong dang gab pa gnyis ka tshul 'di 'dra/ /nge bas lda na pa 'i tshad par ma 'khrul bya/ /la cig rlung gi tshad pa zhes su 'dod/ /de ltar ma yin rlung dang ma khris pa la/ /ma ltos nam rmi nga tsha bar 'gyur ma yin/ /lto sa na 'di nyid tshad pa'i nad du 'gyur/ /'dzi ni ldan pa rna yin rkyang ba'i nad/ /de la rigs kyi stong ba zhes bya ba/ /nad gzhi'i rims dang brag shas che ba la/ /mkhris pa bad gan chu ser shas che na/ /gnas ni glo snying sanyis la dang bo nas/ /rlung nad zhugs nga 'i rigs kyi stong ba yin/ /nad dang nad kyi gnyen po bcu dgos so /babs kyi stong ba tshad pa stobs chung zhing /srog la mi rgol zungs zad byas pa sa na/ / rlung nad skyes pa 'ang yod pa 'i ri thang mtshams / glo bur stong ba gso dpyad thal ba yin /tshad nad yod pa thor bu'i rlung skyes sam/ /tshad nad zhi nas rlung nad skyes pa yin/ /'di kun dus la sa ma 'das shin tu gces/ /sab tshad ngo ngo tshad pa'i nad gzhi la/ (tshad rtags med cing grang rtags 'byung ba yin/ /'di ni thal bas g.yog pa'i me rdong 'dra/ /grang ba'i canas su tshad pa zhusas pa dang / /bad rlung gis ni tshad pa dbyibs pa yin/ /gnas ni pho ba mkhal ma snying yin te pho ba de nyid zas 'jug byed pa'i gnas/ / de phyir gnas der tshad pa'i nad zhugs glu pas/ /'ju byed me des lo sa pa'i la sa byed pas/ /bzer dang mi 'ju sgrigs (skyigs bu )sogs grang rtags 'byung / /mkhal ma chu yi rang bzhin yin pas na/ /tshad nad zhugs kyang dros na phan pa dang / /chu sri grang na na ba la sogs 'byung / /snying ri khyab byed rlung dang bad rkan tsonas /de phyir sems 'chos brjed dang gnyid med dang / /smyo 'jog 'dar ba la sosas 'byung bar 'gyur/ /'di gsum gnas kyi stobs la sa 'byung ba yin/ /lus spyir gab pa bad rlung byas che bas/ tshad rtags mi 'byung 'ga' zhig 'byung ba yang / /grang ba'i mtshan nyid das dang tshul 'di 'dra/ /rkyen dang ma 'phrad tshad stoXs

chung ba yin /rkyen dang 'phrad na spang la me thor 'dra/ /myur du srog la 'bar bar 'gyur ba yin/ /ldan pa nad nyid lus la gnod pa byed/ /nad dang zungs bras chu dang 'o ma('dres pa )bzhin/ /de ltar rnga smin rtags kun thams cad dang / rgyas tshad rtags lda na de lus stobs shor zhing / shin tu gzer drags zug 0zer drags pa yin/ nyal dang snyes pa rtsog pu la sogs pa /gang yang bde med smin long med pa yin/ tshad pa byer na rtags ni lus brtse zhing / /lus ri tshad pa phyi nang med par tsha/ 'di ni tshad pa dang yang mi 'dra zhing / /bsil drod gang ya nga gnod cing de mi bde/ /rnying ba'i tsha ba mtho na 'u sa lci zhing / /'di yi rtsa ni grims shing steng na rgyus / skabs su sna khrag 'ong zhing rngul kha snyi/ /rngul dbyung rjes la lha ga pa ra khams mi bange /pho ba 'ju stobs chung zhing tshigs bzhi na/ /shed nyams dma' zhing grib ma snyeg pa dang / sked dang lag rkang lag ma thil du dregs pa chasas/ / rgyu med res 'ga' bde zhing res 'ga' na/ /chu tshad 'thung na glo snying tshigs pa 'dra/ /rlung lda na gyur na lda na pa'i skabs dang 'dra/ /rgyas pa'i tsha ba ro stod sos brang na/ /sgrog dus nu mchin rtsib thung kha smor solas/ /gang du gzer yang phur ba btsug pa 'dra /lud pa khrag gam ser bo sru ga po 'am/ /she dul 'dra dang dud khu cung zad re/ /rtsa ni dras la chu ni mar ram ser/ /gotar ba'i khrag la rnag tsam mkhri/ sa pa chasas/ /kha sna skam dang dang ga 'grib la slog ldang nyal mi shes dbugs kyis 'jigs pa dang / /glo dang sbrid pa mi thon nyin gnyid che/ / nad stobs chung na mugs kyang gas la stobs chung / /de la stong ba nyam sa dang ma nyam sa dang ཿ /de ni tshad pa rlung ldan grogs su 'gyur/ /'di mi gnyen bshes 'grogs nas las byed 'dra/ /tshad pa bad dan ldan na thal 'gyur te/ /dper na mi mthun lhan cig pa dang 'dra/ /'di ni sanas gcig dag la mi 'jug cing / /gnyis la gnas na srog si bar chad byed/ /kha cig gnas 8

'gyur/ /de phyir 'phral du bzlog pa brtson par bya/ /'di ni drang srong mkhas pa'i sa/dmas ngag yin/ /khyad par rtags ni tshad pa ma smin na/ /grang shum 'byung zhing smin na de mi 'byung / /smin long med la dbang bo'i gzi brjid 'chor/ /tshad pa byer na rtag tu rngul kha snyi/ /rnying ba'i tshad pa yun lon gyur na shes / /drod bag gnod na tsha ba yin pa ra dpyad/ / pho bar gab na zas 'phrod mi bde ste/ /bsil bcud gtong na gtar bsres mi bde la/ /rlung gsang na na stong tshad yin par dpyad/ /snying la bab na lhas par gtar khrag ngan /mkhal mar gab na lhag pa ra chu la gsal/ /lus spyir 0ba na gsum ka brtas pa ra bya/ rtags gzhan 'khrul na mi rtogs pa 'ang ma nga / /ldan tshad gnyen po res kyis gnod nar byed/ /0so bya'i tshad pa lus stobs rtsa stobs che/ /gtar khrag 'bab stobs bzang zhing zus gzer 'dzoms/ /gnyen po thog tu bab cing dbugs kyang bde/ /dbang bo dwangs legs lce yang rlon pa ring / /'chi ba'i rtags med gso ba'i yan la ga tshang / /lud pa bde 'byung lus la ngal ba med/ /gso ra mi rung ba'i rtsa ni mkhrang la spun 'u da pa byi la lta bu sog cing ngar/ /drung na 'dug pa lus la phan snyam byed/ /rtag tu ngal zhing de yis dbugs mi bde/ /lud pa dud kha'am ljang ser dud kha ser/ /lu la thang jing 'gos tu mi btub la/ /khong thebs tshad pa che yang gtar khras bzang / /mu cor smra ba'i so lce nag la skam / /tsha smyo zhes bya gsor mi rung ba yin/ /de lta ra brtag pa'i rnam pa 'di dag kun/ /legs par brtag la so so'i thabs la 'jug / rang don grags pa nyam sa pa ra mi 'gyur phyir/ /de das bcos thabs gnyen po bzhi yin te/ /zhib sbyongs sman gyis bcos par bya ba dang / / 'jam rtsub dpyad kyis bcos par bya ba dang / / mthun dang mi mthun spyod la ma bstan pa dang / /'phrod dang mi 'phrod zas kyis bcos ske pa'o/ /de la dang bo ma smin smin byed thang / /'bras bu gsum mam ma nu ba'i //

pa 'am/ /sle tres sasum pa tig ta bzhi pa'am/ /ga pur gnyis sogs bsil la 'jam pa'i thang / / dro 'jam tsam la cu cung zad tsam gartogs/ /smin rtags ma ldan bar du rab tu bsngags/ /smin nas sle tres skyu ru ra yis dbye/ /dpyad du spu thul me la bsros pa bskon/ /spyod lam me dang nyi ma dro glu dku bas bdus /zas ni 'ju sla cung zad dro ba gnong / / bsil zhing 'ju — dka' chu grang mi 'thung spang / /rlung rma gtosas pa snang ba mchog tu —— ske bsngags/ /smin 'o nga med na smin byed 'di dag dang / /bsil sbyor drag po dus su sbyar la gtong / /de yang bad rlung dus su smin byed de/ /khrag mkhris dus su bsil thang gtong bar bya/ /man gyis smin dang rang bzhin smin du rung / /nad stobs sbyor bas gso bya myur du bya/ /smin du mi 'dod smin byed lnga bo las/ /spyod lam ma rtogs gzhi ni smin par byed/ /yang na sgyung dang sman gyis smin pa mchos / rnyongs par gyur na dang bo bsdu bar bya/ /de yi khong du bur rnying zho sbyar satong / /mtshe 'am sre long bsdus pa'i lums su gzhus /phyi nang bar du lus kun chu chag bya/ /'di yang tsha nas snying la mchos tu kyi shis / thabs 'di mi ldan bya byed byed pa rnams/ /thang chen ri dgas rgyang nas 'ded dang mtshungs/ /tshad pa rnying ba bsil che gnyig tu bsring / /gtar drags pa yi zhen pa ma bsal bas/ /pho ba mes 'chi lus zungs zad par byed/ /'di ni pa gas pa skam po sbangs dang mtshungs/ zas ni cas tu rnga bran sha nyid mchog /ga'an yang rtsi bcud tham sa cad shes pa ste/ rlung dang ldan na tshad pa sman gyis bsad/ /rlung ni zas kyi spyo ra ba drod kyis bcos/ 'di la 'jam khrus mchog tu shes pa yin/ /rgyas pa tshabs chen nad la sa pur satong / /tsan dan gi wang la sogs bsil drags rnam sa/ /shin tu bungs bskyed 'khru ba'i mang nyung la/ /nam gung nyin gung sman gzhug rdzogs pa ra satong / sbyongs skyugs dag dang 'dzi la mchos tu shis /stod la bab pa 12

bsil sman khrus kyis sbyongs/ /rtse chung la so gas rtsa rnams bar che gtar/ /snga dro phyi dro bstud la satar bar bya/ /ya nga na grag bungs skyed la gtar bar bya/ /zas su drod bcud phyogs tsam spang bar bya/ tsha ba khyog nas zas kyis ngo bslang bya /'di mi zhu 'chag srog la spu gri 'dra/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis brtag pa shin tu gces/ rgyas tshad stong dang 'bring tshad chung ba la /blo na du ga pur tsan dan 'a sogs pa/ / bdun pa dgu ba bcu gcig la sogs pa/ /nad stobs sbyar zhing yang ya nga gtong bar bya /rtsa yang snod la drug maso la sogs gtar/ /dang ga 'grib la mchin mkhris ldem pa gtar/ /ru thung gtar na mchos tu this pa yin/ /snan du gur gum bdun dang tsan dan brgyad/ /thang chen bdun pa'i phye ma gtong bar bya/ /spyir ni nad sto bas che na sman dang dpyad/ /gtar drags snyugs sdus yas kyi thos mthas bsu / /'jam po'i bcos pas tshad pa 'i sto bas mi non/ /dper na dpa' bo mi gcis stobs ldan yang / /dpung tshogs ma nga bo bzlog par mi nus ltar tshad pa stobs chung 'joms pas las byis dpyo da/ / drags na nad dang zungs 0nyis rtsa nas gcod/ /dper na sanod byed skye ba ngan pa zhig/ gdug pa bya phyir grong khyer bsregs dang mtshungs /de bas nad sto bas dang sbyar bcos par bya/ sbyor ba log na nad 'phel 'u sa zungs zad/ /sman gyis nad steng ma snyoms zungs zad byed/ / lhag na gnyis ka 'joms par byed pa yin/ /mtshams pa'i sbyor ba nad zad lus zungs 'phel /nad 0cis bcos tshe nad gzhan mi ldang bya/ /stong tshad gso ba rigs byi stong ba la/ /rim sa stong gtar na dang bo srog la rgol 9/ /khrag stong chang dang nyin sanyid spa nga bar bya/ /mkhris pa stong ba chang rnying mchos tu gnod /glo snying stong na bsil gsum thang yang spang / bad kun stong la ma ra snying gtong mi bya/ /chu ser stong la rme ra nag mchog tu spa nga / /de dag kun la dang bo sha tsosar bsngags/ /bur rnying thug pa byed dang 3

res mos bcos/ /de yang tshad pa rlung ldan dus mnyam bcos/ /bad lan lda na na res mos bcos pa mchos / dus ma nyam bcos na zas kyis rlung ya nga bsal/ /phugs kyi tshad pa bsil ba'i sman gyis bsad/ /satar ba'i rjes la tsho khu zho nyid gtong / /yang na kha zas bcud la bsil ba gtong /nad 0zhi rigs dang khrag shas che ba dang / /mkhris pa bad kun chu ser che ba dang / /sanas ni rgyu long gnyis la dang bo rgyu/ /rlung nad zhugs pa'i rigs kyi stong ba yin/ /nad dang gnad kyi gnyen po cung zad dbos/ /babs kyis stong ba tshad pa stobs chung gis/ /srog la mi rgol zungs zad byas pas na/ /rlung nad skyes pa'i ri thang ma tshams dang ni/ /glo bur skyes pa gso byed thal ba yin/ /tshad nad yod bzhin glo bur rlung skyes pa/ /tshad pa zhi nas rlung nad skyes pa yin/ /'di dus kun las ma 'das shin tu gces/ /gab dang ngo bo tshad pa'i rang bzhin la/ /tshad rtags med cing grang rtasas 'byung ba yin/ /de ni thal bas g.yosas pa'i me dang 'dra/ /grang ba'i gnas su tshad pa zhugs pa dang / /bad rlung gnyis kyis tshad pa bying ba yin/ /ldan pa'i nad gnyis 'u sa la gnod pa yin/ /nad stobs mnyam dang mi mnyam snga phyi can/ de ni tshad pa rlung ldan grogs su 'gyur/ /'di ni gnyen bshes 'grogs nas las byed —'dra/ /de ni tshad pa rlung ldan grogs su 'gyur/ /tshad pa bad gan ldan pa 'thab gyur te/ /dper na mi mthun lhan cig 'tshogs dang 'dra/ /'di ni gnas dang dag la mi 'jug cing / /gnyis la gnas na srog gi bar chadam byed/ /kha cig lhan cig gnas dang 'gal med zer/ /de ltar mi smin snang dang mun pa bzhin/ ma khris pa zhi ba'i sgo nas dro thang sacig / bad kun lci zhing bsil la dro ba gnyis/ /gnas gcig dag la 'jug tu rung bas na/ /bsil drod sman yang bzlos pa'i nus pa yis / /tsha ba bsil byed nga dang ma thun si ra 'gyur/ /'di dag sanyis kyis bye bras gsu ma las yin /gnas 15

ni rdo dang 'dra/ /spra rtsi gtong ba'i tshon dang 'dra ba yin/ /'di dus 0nyen po das dang sbyar bas na/ /sanyen po 'ga' yang thog tu 'bab mi 'gyur/ /'di ni rnyings par byed cing long med byed/ /tsha ba gram dang byer dang rnying ba dang / /ming si rnam grangs das tu 'dod pa yin/ rnying ba'i tshad pa lus kyi zungs kun dang / /yun ring 'grogs pas 'brel zhing zhen pa yin/ /dper na spos la snum zhugs ji bcin no/ /rlung med rlung ldan rgyu yi bye brag yin /rlung med dang bo tsha ba smad la lus/ /de ya nga bsil zhing gnod si bsten pa'am/ /ya nga na zhag gcig gnyen po zas grod sngas/ /rlung ldan rnyings pa nyid las gyur pa yin/ /de ltar tsha ba kun la dang bo ru/ rme smin 'byung zhing de nyid bcos pa yis/ /legs na smin zhing ma legs rnying dang rnyog /tsanas skabs gyur pa de ltar 'byung bas na /go rim dbye ba zhis byar malas pas 'dod/ /nge la rigs su dbye ba ngo bo dang / /lugs su 'byung ba'i tshad pa rkyang ba la/ /rgyas pa zhes bya'i tshad par 'dod pa rtse/ /nad stobs che na myur du bcos par sla / nad stobs chung na myu ra du mi so pas / /'di gnyis tshad pa spyi dang bye brag gnyis/ /ming si rnam grangs dag tu 'dod pa yin/ /tshad pa rtags dang grang ba tshul gcis las/ /tshad par 'khrul zhing don la grang ba yin/ /stong dang gab dang gnyis ka tshul 'di 'dra/ de bas lda na pa'i tshad pa ra ma 'khrul bya/ /kha cig rlung si tshad pa zhes su 'dod /de ni ma yin rlung yang mkhris pa la/ ma ltos nam yang tsha bar gyur ma yin/ /ltos na de nyid ldan pa'i nad du 'gyur/ /'di ni ldan par cung zad che la gtong / /sman mang gtong la bsil zhing 'jam po sartong / /me gtar snum ldan khrus nd+ra na 'jam po gtong / /bsku mnye bya zhing mchog tu drag shul spang / /res mos bcos na dus chod shes pa ra bya grang bcos tsha bar thal na skyon yon gnyis/ /yon tan saso sla thal na bzlog pa dala'/ /tsha chos grang bar 'khrul na 0so yun 17

ring / /thal na bzlog pa dka' ste mkhas pasagazab/ /ha cang thal na dmu chu chu ser 'gyur/ /'di lamachog tu khrus snan bzang bo shis/ /ngal zhing rko dbugs mi bde na de spang bya/ /bad rlung gnyis ka ldan na rlung 'dus pa sa/ / shin tu gso dka' stobs chen bstun la bcos/ /ya nga na nam gung zhin gung tsha ba bcos/ /srod dang tho rangs bad rkan gnyen po bston/ /tho rangs phyi dro rlung la brngan pa byin/ /de skad gso ba mdor bsdus bstan pa ni/ /zhal gyi gdams pa 'ba' zhig bkod pa yin/ /sgrib pa med kyang nyams su ma blangs na/ /ngo mi shes pa'i skyes bu 'phrad pa 'dra/ /de bas gnad la 'bad la nan tan bskyed/ /'bum dang khu tshur cha lag tshang ma bkod/ /bu 'am snying 'dra bcig las ma spel cig / gal te spel na dkon mchog bka' chad phob/ /snod ldan bka' rgya dam pa'i skyes bu de/ /rkang sanyis bzhi brgya'i gnyen po de gyur nas/ /bcom ldan thub pa'i rgyal tshab ngos zin te/ bsdu ba rnam bzhi'i 'gro ba'i don byas nas/ /bla med byang chub snying bo thob par shog / man lo/ /bha wartu/ shu lham/18

nad dang mi mthun par sdod/ 'dre sdod nges med du sdod/ nad sdod yun ring bor sdod/ 'dre sdod gdon bcos pas stongs/ 'chi sdod grangs brtsis la dus btab/ sasum pa bye bras phyed na gcis gal che gsu ngas dris la na las rtsa yi skabs so/ / tshad pa bye bras tu bcos na du mchis/bcos na ji ltar bcos zhus pas/ chu ltar rnyosas pa'i tsha ba'am/ mda' ltar sazer ba'i tsha ba'am/ me ltar 'bar ba'i tsha ba'am/ mun ltar — 'thibs pa'i tsha ba'am rtsi ltar zhen pa'i tsha ba dang lnga yo da gsu ngas/ de la chu ltar rnyogs pa'i tsha ba ni ma smin pa yin/ rlung dang bad gan gyi tsha ba 'dus su ma ster ba yin/ yang na skye 'gro ma chad pa yin/ de la nad drags na rin sla ba yin/ gzhi mkhris pa che na smin sla/ kha zas drod bas zos na smin sla/ spyo da lam dras shul byas pas smin sla ba'am/ de la ma smin pa snan gyis smin sla bar bya/ de yang 'bras bu gsum mam/ skyu ru ra'am/ ma nu bzhi thang gis smin par bya/ smin nas yod na sle tres kyi thang gis dbye/dus dang 'khrugs la 'ag gcig gis smin pa yang yod do/ /spyir ma smin pa chu'i rnyogs pa ma dwangs pa dang 'dra ba yin/ de'i dus su gtar na zug gzer skye/ kha cig shes pa bying / nad khrag chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa bzhin 'ong / lus zungs dang 'dres pa 'ong / gdams ngag dang bral ba'i sman pas bltas na nad tsha grang gang du yang yong ngo / /ngo mi shes pa yin/ 'jam thang dang kha zas drod bcud la bsduganas/ de nas gtar ba dang /bsil sman sbyar/ de ltar ma byas na dpyad kyis ma smin pa yin gsungs/'o na 'jam thang gang la bgyi zhus pas/ de'i dus sle tres kyi thang du bu ram gtong ba shis pa yin gsu ngas / kha zas lu sa sha sol bu'am ba lang gi sha thongs/ byus pa bag re byed nges so sa yong gis skad na/ dris lan las ma smin pa'i skabs so/ /mda' ltar gzer ba ni/ stong ba'i tshad pa yin te/22

stong ba'i tsha ba ni gzhi rlung che ba las rims kyis btab pa'am / cho nges drag ngo btab pa'am/ shus drag po btab pa'am/ yid mya ngan byas pa 'am mdor na ngas yid kyi la sa dras po las 'byung ba yin/ ngag skad drag pos bos pa/ mi mthun pa'i bsam ngan drag po skyes pa dag las 'byung /gzhan yang 'khrugs chung rims chung byung ba gtar ga'am/ bsil rtsub mo drags pa'i rjes la 'byung / rgyas pa'i tshad pa bcos pa rgud drags pa'i rjes la 'byung / gzhi rlung yod pa la/ ga pur drags na sazer dras po 'byung /rtsa stong la rgyug chu shin tu skom/ 'u sa la zug sazer che/ dbugs rgod la dras cing shin tu rtsub pa zhig yong / khras tsha ma yin pa la/ de lta bu zhig byung na gsor mi btub pa yin/ snar ga pur dud pas bdug pa dang /skyug bag re byas pa sa lce rlon du 'gro/ de la nges shes bskyed la bur chang 0tong / snying dang byug pa dang me btsa' rnam gang shes ci rigs su bya gsungs te/ stong ba'i tshad pa la mi 'dra ba bdog gam mi bdog zhus pas/bag mi 'dra ba yo da gsungs de zhus sgo sa/ rims stong ba'i tsha ba'am/mkhris pa stong ba'i tsha ba'am/ bad dan stong ba'i tsha ba'am/ chu ser stong ba'i tsha ba'am/ glo snying stong ba'i tsha ba yod nga las / de la rkang la ga dus tshigs na/ gnyid mi 'ong glo stong byed/ lus skya la rlon/ skra 'dab 'dar na rims stong ba yin pas gtar du mi rung / stong ba'i tsha ba yo da pa la sa grib ma la gnyid log tu gzhus lug sha dang chang gartong / sku ma ce bya/ 'di drod 'ba' cig nas thub pa yin/ ya nga nyin mtshan gnyis ka gnyid tshan la los pa'i 'phro la blo rtol bya'o/ /de khrag stong ba bya ba yin pas/de la chu gtong du mi rung / mi chang gtong bsku mnye bya/ nyin par sanyid srung / 'jam thang gtong me btsa' mi bya/ des thub ste 'ong gsungs ya nga gnyid mi 'ong / kha brla/ dbyal skya mig dang lce ser na/23

gan chen na zhu 'khyags nas gsal ba yin/ zas 'ju stobs chung / sngar gyi gos kyis mi dros/ rtsa dal du 'gro/ dbugs ring du 'gro/ khragasnyegazer bri/ skom dad chung du 'gro/ de las kyang grang na mig phug skrang /de tsam na sha chang drod gtong bas chog pa yin/ thal nas dmu chur song ba ya nga yod/ 'di 'khrul ba chung ba yin/ rlung 'as che ba 'di la 'khrul ba mang ba yin pas/ skabs su tsho khu dum re rtsa rtse gtong / zas glod sman sazhug bsring ba yin skad do /yang rlung stobs che ba'i tshad pa rnying la shor yod skad na/ rtasas ci lags ji ltar bcos/ sngar gyi de tsho la 'dugasam mi 'dus zhus pas/ glo snying stong ba'i tshad pa dang 'dra ba bcos pa yin/'di bzhi phal cher rims 'khrugs pa yin/ gnyid med sna bug skam lce sam rngams pa che/ tshig col 'khrul yong / skabs su bsngangs pa skad zer/mkhur tshos smug zas mi 'ju ji ltar tsha yang gtar du mi rung / sgal rus gos ra ba bskol ba'i khu ba mar dang go stod btab pa bsdu/ cung zad ngar yal ba'i nang du/ sbrang rtsi cung zhig btab la blud/ byibs la rngul dbyung lus sha satong du mi rung / rgod kyi tsho khu gtong / sbang ma chang gar gyi nye'u rdor btab pa gtong / des kha lce rlon dbang bo gsal/ dbong nyer gcis nas tshigs pa lnga bdun bsregs/ chang gtong / des thub/ dris lan las stong ba'i tsha ba'i skabs so/ /me ltar 'bar ba'i tsha ba ni/ rgyas pa'i tsha ba yin/ rgyas pa'i tsha ba'i na lugs ni/ lus kyi spyod lam drag pa dang / mkhris pa'i rims las 'byung / khur chen po khur ba'am/ stobs bskyed pa/ bang drag tu rgyug pa/ rta rgyug chang 'thung nas drag shul byas pa'am/ me tshan nyi tshan la 'dug nas drag shul byas pa las 'byung ste/ de la khras mkhris pa yin par don 'dra'o yang / 'khrugs rims gnyis kyang rgyas na rgyas par mthun/ stong na stong bar mthun rgyas pa'i tsha ba ngos 'dzin 25

pa'i rtags ni/ tsha grang spyi dang mthun/ 'on kyang rtsa drag cing phra ba yin/gzer mi 'pho na rengs yong ba yin chu dmar bras la rnag gam mkhris pa chags pa yin dbusas rtsod drod che de bzhin 'dus pa rgyas pa'i tsha ba yin stod na na stod rtsa gtar/ smad na na smad rtsa gtar/ pho mchin na na snod ka ru thung gtar/ bsil ci rigs su gtong la/ de yang nged kyi man ngag gi lugs byis/ rtsa argyal bo rtse chung dang / sman gyi rgyal bo ga pur la brten nas tsha ba thos bab tu bsad pa/ rtsa'i blon bo gal mdo sman gyi cu gang gur gum la brten nas/ tsha ba rkyang 'khrid du bsad pa rtsa yi 'bangs 'khris rtsa sngon bu dang / sman gyi 'bangs tig ta la brten nas tsha ba zag bcad pa bya ba yin pas go rim de ltar bcos/ spyod lam grang ba sos dal ba/ nyin gnyid srung ba/ kha zas drod bag dang / chag tse dang /'bras dang / khur mang dang / dar ba chu slad pa dang / ba ra'i 'o ma bskol grang dang / na so mas pa dang / rlung shas che ba rnams la skam sha dang / bsil sha gtong gsungs / dris lan las rgyas pa'i tsha ba'i skabs so /mun ltar 'thibs pa 'i tsha ba ni 'di yin te/ gab pa snying la gab pa dang / pho ba la gab pa / mkhal ma la gab pa/ lus spyir gab pa bya ba yod do/ /'di'i rgyu thams cad mchin pa las gyur pas/ grang rlung gisatsha ba sbas pa bya ba yin te/ 'di la rmi na ngag med pa rnams kyi ngos mi zin pa yin de ngos 'dzin man ngas spyi dang ma thun/ khyad par du snying la gab pa yin na cis kyang grib ma gnyid yor la 'gro ba yin/ snying gar sha bkra yo nga /chang rnying 'thung na mod la na ba yin/ sen mo mdog dkar sadong la srin thor rgyun mi chad pa yin/ des kyang yid ma ches na khrag la blta gsungs/mkhal ma la sab na/ rtags ni chu bzhag na ma ra nag lta bur 'gro ba yin mkhal ma'i zag chu rgyun mi chad/ las dang 'gro 'dug gi rkang ba zhir 'gro ba 26

yi / mkhal rtsa gang yod na ba yin/ chang gar ma 'thung na rkang ba gyur 'gro ba yin/ des kyang yid ma ches na/ long rtsa cung cig satar/ rnag tu nges pa yin/ pho bar gab na/ grang ya nga na la dro yang na ba yin/ pho khar phur ba btsugs pa'am/ rtsos po 'gril ba ltar yo nga ba yin kha zas dang skom gyi reg bya sanyis 'dzoms tsam gyis phan/ grang drags tsha drags gnyis gnod/ des kyang yid ma ches na/ rtse chung dang ru thung la rnag blta/rnag ni byang ba'i rgyab 'dra na nges pa ra yin/ 'di 'chos pa la nad gar babs kyang tshabs che na rtsa yas babs kyis gtor/ nge nas nad gang na'i rtsa gtar/ gang la babs kyang rma chin pa 'i rtsa gtar du mi rung / snying la babs na ga dur tsandan/ pho mchin la babs na gur gum dang brag zhun tsha bakhyog na soso 'i gsang du me btab/ kha zas slar glod/ dris lan las gab pa'i skabs so /rtsa lta ra zhen pa'i tsha ba tshes bya ba rnying dang rtsogs pa'i tsha ba yin te/ 'di'i rgyu mtshan ni dang bo tsha ba yin pa la/ sbyor ba nyes pas snyogs pa yin/ 'di la kha zas gyis rnyogs pa spyod lam gyis snyogs pa/sman gyis snyogs pa/ dpyad kyis snyogs pa bya ba yin pas/ de tshe rten thabs ma mkhas pas / tsha ba lus la tshen nas 'dres pa yin te/ des na ma smin pa la gtar ga ma snga/ sngas na dpyad kyis snyogs pa bya ba yin/ tsha ba bya shor bya bar 'gyur ba yin/ ltag rtsa phra la rgyud ring ba yin/ shed dma' ba yin/ rngul kha snyi ba yin/ grib ma chosas pa yin/ me nyis shes pa lci ba yin/ mtheb chung rtsa bar dresas chung chogs pa yin/ dang ga bde la mchu skam la tshigs pa yin gsungs/ de bcos pa'i thabs ni 'jam thang yun ring du gtong / khrag la bab ma bab cig blta/ khrag la rnag gam byang ba rgyab chags na/ de bcos pa bag sla ba yin/ nyams dang sbya ra la ngal gso yin bag re gtar/ ga du ra nyer lnga dang mar gsar sartong / je yang je 27

yang du rmi ngon pa zhig yong / yang bshal btang na bzang / mjug tu ris pa 'di yis tig ta'i sman mar sbyar/ khrag la rnag ma chags par kham nag lta bu byung na nad lci ba yin/ de la mang du gtar mi rung / ga pur nyer lnga ba sbyar/ kha zas sngar dang 'dra/ 'di la mchos tu bshal shis/ bcos dang lan 'gar bder tshor ba mi yong / le lo med par bcos/ blo ma logs par ma nor bar bcos/ yul gang 'phrod dang chu gang 'phrod du bcos/lo blo rgas nas nam sos cha med pa yong / dper na dngos po skyur ba dang 'dra ste 'phral du mi tshor ba yin/ rnying ba'am rnyongs pa shed chung ba la ni lug sha soms pa dang chang 'jamapogashed skyed/ de nas bshal gtong /tshad pa gad po grang bar shor ba bya bar yod pas/ tshigs pa bcu gsum pa bsregs/ tsha ba ldan 'dus la yang phan gsungs / drisalan las rnyogs dang rnying ba'i skabs so/ /na mo gu ru/ tshad pa'i man ngag la nged kyi lusas kyi rtsa chu nad gzhi la sogs pa gang gis kyang nad ngos ma zin na/ khrag la blta ba 'di man ngag yin/ de yang tsha rung grang rung / gtar ba'i khrag gis nad ngos zin pa yin/ des na 'di la man ngas cung jig yod gsungs/de zhus pas/ lar nad gar gnasakyi rtsa la bab pa yin te/ nad gar bab rang dga' ba yin/ de yang rtsa gang che che la gtar ba yin/ de yang rgyas nad la khrag mi ngan na khams che ba yin/ 'o na gang la blta na mchin rtsa la blta ba man ngas yin te/ lus la khrag ngan yo da na cung zhig mchin pa la babs pa yin/ de ci snyam na/ don lnga/ snod drug gi lus mtho gzhug thams cad kyi khrag gi rten mchin pa la babs pa yin/ mtsher ba khrag be phyi mo yin zer te/ mtsher ba la tsha ba skyes pa tsam med pa yin/ sang dang sar tsha yang ma chin mkhris gnyis las ma skyes pa'am ma 'gril ba med/ nge yang lus kyi stod na na ru thung gtar/ smad na na long rtsa gtar/ de sanyis la 28

nas rtsa gzhan la btab pas/ nge nas nge la btab na snyogs dosas med pa yin/ dang bo'i rtsa de la btab na nad snyogs pa'i nyen yod pa yin gsungs so/ /rjes bor bar bya ba rtags thams cad tshang ba yid ches pa yin pa la /rtse chung btab pas khrag dmar phal gyis byung nas 'phro bcad la long rtsa'am/ yob rtsa la dbugs dbyung ba tsam bya/ de nas rtse chung btab pa sa rnag dud kha zhig yong ba yin gsungs/ spyir tshad pa ma smin par gtar na sbrul gdus pa 'i khar chud pa dang 'dra/ zungs 'phrog rlung bskyed/ nad rtogs pa la sogs pa skyon dpag tu med pa yod pa yin de'i dus gtar ga dag lta ci smos/ sman rtsub mos kyang 'thor ba yin/ smin rtags shes pa shin tu sal che/ ngas ni tshad pa bcos pa sangs pa dang / phyis pa gnyis sa ngas skyon mang du mthong / smin zhing ma ldan pa'i phyogs gcig mi/ mi ngo mi shes pa dang nyams dma' ba dang / 'chol ba kun 'tsho bzhin 'dug ldan pa dang ma byed pa yin na/ phar btab tshur btab kyi rmi tshams chung ba yang ba gzhug tu lus zungs kyis mi thugapa smin pa bya ba dang bsil ni shin tu gal che gsungs/ de dus rlung dang bad dan na / mi gnod pa 'i thang 'jam pos smin par bya/ rtsa rgyas pa mi gtar/ lus ser sangs song na pho ba'i me 'chi/ 'u sa kyi drod yal nas rtse chung cu khrag dmar sal byung na cis kyang mi thub 'chi gsungs/ la rlab chol zer zhing lus drod che ba/ rtsa sbom la rgyug rtse chung dmar sangs byung na me gyis/ chang 'jam po thongs sha sol ba thongs / des thub/ ji 'dra yang byed mi dargas/ spyir 'khrugs rims gnyis /tshad pa tsasar rnying sanyis dang bzhi rka la 0rtar ga gtso cher bya/ tshad pa gsar rnying la khras dbyung mang yang mi sto/ rims la sngas sam mang na bying ba yin/ 'di dus tshod sbyor la kha zas la gzabs pa yin/ khu zas bag tsam gyis phan gnod nus pa yin/ mjug tu lus rngul mang dul30

gab na/ cis byang srod la gnyid mi 'ong / sen mo dkar/ snying gar sha bkra thor ba 'ong / cis kyang dran pa mi gsal ba yin/ de la ga pur la sogs pa'i bsil che sbyar/ snying rtsa gtar rjes/ cis kyang rlung yong bas rjes bcud kyi bsdu/ rang gsang du me bya gsungs/ mkhal ma'i rtsa gang yod sar na/ chu bzhag na dmar nag tu 'gro/ mkhal ma'i zags chu rtag tu 'ong / las dang 'gro 'dug gis rkang ba rtsi/ chang 'thung na mod la rkang ba lci/ de la mkhal rtsa gtar gur gum bdun pa dang brag zhun la sogs pa gtongag des thub gsungs/ yang snod kyi bad lon tsha skran bya ba de yi rtags ni/ grang dang na/ dros dang na/ zas skom reg bya dro 'jam gyis phan par tshor/ de la snod rka ru thung gtar/ gur gum bdun pa gtong /se 'bru da li gtong / kha zas yang gtong / tsha ba gis pa grang bar song ba yod pas rjes mi srung / de rnams tsha ba grang ba ltar snang ba bya ba yin pas/yid ches par byas la nan tan bya/ grang ba tsha ba ltar snang ba la du bdog zhus pas/ rlung rims stong ba'i rims 'khrugs dang / bad dzin skya rims dang / mkhris pa rlung bes btegs pa dang / rlung na/sa bud shing skam pa dang / mi 'gyur bad kun stod gzer dang drug tu shes par bya/ 'di rnams phyi tshad pa che la nang grang ba yin gsungs/ de rnams kyi nad gzhi thams cad rlung gis byas pa yin/ grang ba 'ba' zhig pa la tshad pa snang ba mi srid gsungs/ spyir de la bcud kyis bag re bde tshor/ bag re yang des nyes pa skyed de/ de la rlung gi rims rkang lag rus tshigs na/ gnyid mi yong lus dal kyang spa 'dab 'dar/ glo rtol gzer/ de tsha ba ji ltar sngon yang gtar du mi rung / grib ma la gnyid log tu gzhug lug sha dang chang gtong / bsku mnye bya/ 'di drod 'ba' zhig gis thub pa yin glu glu gsungs/ de la ma stong ba phyi tshad che/ rtsa stong la rgyug dbugasathung la 32

rgod/ skom dad che/ zug gzer che/ gzer 'pho/ sang na sar drag cing tsub pa gcig 'ong ngo / /de la snar ga pur bdug pa dang / 'u sa la byug pa bag re byas pas bde tshor ba yong / des nges pa bskyed la sha chang bag re gtong / byug pa dang nyin sanyid me la bsro ba gang shes bya gsungs/ de la bad kun skya ribs bya ba 'di ni/ gnyid log na za zi mang / shin tu myos shing mi bde/ rngul cung zhig 'ong na bad lan skya ribs/ sha chang gtong /bsku mnye bya/ rngul mi phyi/ 'bras bu gsum gyi thang satong / ma nu ba'i thang gtong / chu skol gtong / gtar ga mi bya/ des thub gsungs/de la mkhris pa rlung gis btegs pa bya ba ni/ 'di la gnyid mi 'ong la rlab chol zer/ rtsa phra la stong / mis dang lce ser na mkhris patwang gis btegs pa bya ba yin pas sha chang mi gtong / gnyid srung / bsil thang 'jam thang gtong / des thub gsungs/ bad dzin stod gzer bya ba ni/ pho ba dang rgyu ma gzer/ grang na na zhing zas bsil gyis gnod/ mar la sogs pa 'phrod/ lug sha'i tshod ma la sga btab pa gtong / so'abru bzhi ba'am bdun pa gtong / chu skol mar btab gtong / des thub/ de la tsha ba gtar du mi rung ba bdog lags na/ ji skad lags zhus pas/ ma smin pa/stong ba/ zungs zad/ khrag rjes ma chod pa'i tsha ba bzhi gtar du mi rung gsungs/ grang ba bsreg tu mi rung ba bdog lags na/ ji lta bu zhus pas/bad gan smug po lam chad pa yin te/ mdor na mchin khrag pho bar lhung ba yin gsungs/ zungs khrag 'don pa bdog skad na ji lta bu lags zhus pas/don snying la chu shor ba dang / khrag bsdongs pa khrag gzhug las ngan gnyis yin gsungs/ 'o na tsha ba gtar bas chog pa satar ram zhus pas/dmigs bzhi la tshad pa 'ba' zhig gtar du mi rung bas/ zungs zad pa tsam las med/ stong ba'i tsha ba cung zad khong nas gso dgosapa yin —33

gsungs/ tsha ba zhabs ma chod pa rnams rang lir 'gro/ ma so nga yang —tshegs med/ rlung yang gnyis ba'i rang bzhin yin te/ gnyen po'i dbang gis grang bar bsdus pa bya ba yin/ bcud kyis gso gsu ngas/ ma smin pa btang na byer ba yin/ tsha ba smin pa 'i dus na nad bla gnyan can bya ba yin/de bsal ba dang smin nas bcos dgos pa yin/ tsha ba ma sbin pa 'i dus gang du gtar na tsha ba byer te zungs zad/ nad rtsa 'grims mi na na yang na bar 'gro/ na ba 'chi bar 'gro/ nad 'di la mtshang can bya ba yin pas bcos dang gtar rma snga/ smri na bsil la 'jam pa shes dgos gsungs/rjes ma chad pa'i tsha ba ni/ sbyor ba nyes pas na 'grams nas/ khras bzang ngan med par chu dang 'o ma 'dres pa bzhin du lus la rma go mjug la byab nas yod pa yin/ zungs zad pa'i tshad pa ni gtar na srog la rgol lo/ /btub tshad kyi zungs gso dgos pa yin gsungs/ rung mi rung ni bye brag phar log tshur log gi 'phrang la ma shor na/ rang bzhin nor dogs med gsungs/grang ba na ba tsam ma gtogs pa/ dngos su nad khrag rtsa la mtshungs pa yin par dpyad rtag tu mi rung ba tsam med gsungs/ dris lan las 'khrugs gab pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o/ /yang rlung khrag 'thab pa la cis phan zhus pas/ chang dang ga pur sbyar nas gtong bas phan/ sle tres kyi thang gdu bur rnying sbyar bas phan/ dar ba sasar ba la gur gum btab pa sa phan lto bar chang satong nas lus la rngul dbyung bas phan/ bshal rjes chang gis sna blangs pa sa phan/ yid du 'ong ba'i gtam smras na phan/ dris lan las rlung khrag 'thab pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o/ /yang lan gcig na lugs mi bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / nad tsha grang gnyis las med pas/ de ngos 'dzin mang du gnas kyang / nges pa can 34

gang lags zhus pas/ lar tsha ba phyogs gcig ngos zin pa la/ na lugs gcig shes pas chog pa yin/ di ngos 'dzin pa ga'an mang bo yang yo da na de yang ma smin pa'i dus tsha ba yin pa la rtags mang bo mi mthun pa yod pas/nge'i dus na tsha bcud btang la blo ma lo ga par smin du gzhug des bsal yo nga / nad kyi khyad par gyis pho mchin mkhal ma la sogs pa la/ tsha ba rtags med par mngon na yang / gdams ngag dang ldan na stags phra'u las med kyang nges par yin gsungs/ yang rlung stong ba'i tsha ba lta bu/ 'u sa rtags rags pa byung yang nad kyi 'khrul ba chung / yang na rtags gzhan 'khrul yang / cung zad sad pa'i nges nga yin/ nam yang mi 'khrul ba'i dpyad ni/ gong du bstan pa'i dpyad kyis kha gso ba yin gsungs/ 'dzi rnam pa tham sa cad du 'khrulab mi srid dam zhus pas/ lar 'di'i khrag gi khyad par shes pa gal che sasungs pas/ de zhus pas/ bzang bo bya ba dam ra ba tsam la mi zer/ ngan pa bya ba rnag pa tsam la mi zer/ 'di'i byad par ni/ lus la phan na/ ngan khrag bsten na bzang bo bya ba yin /dmar tang ba yang lto khras bya ba yin/ 'o na 'di brag bzang ngan la sogs pa de yin/ 'di la dus su zag chags nas bcos na gang bas kyang gtar ga shes pa yin sasungs / lar tsha ba thams cad la/ nad dang lus zungs dang sbyar ba'i gtar ga shes pa yin/ de nas sman gyis bcos dgos pa yin/de yang sman bsil drod 'dres pa ni ldan pa lta bu 'gal mod/ thang phye ma bsre ba'i man ngag yin/ des na bcos ka thams cad khrag la bsri dgos so / /de'i gdams ngag legs par khong du chud par bya dgos so/ /rtags gzhan dang 'di mi mthun na legs/ tshad pa thams cad kyi ngos 'dzin/rtsa ba 'di la rag las dgos pa yin/ 'dzi stongs tshad the tshom can gzhan gyis go dka' ba yin/ tsha bar ngos zin nas kki bzod bcos dmas/ tsha 35

smin par byas la/ spyod lam gzhan gyis smin pa ra bya/ nad smin kyang khrag la rnag ma chags na/ khrag si rjes bor dgos sasungs/ tshad pa la yang gsar ba dang / rnying ba dang 'in tu rnying ba dang gsum 'dod gsu ngas/zhag bco lnga yan chad 0sar ba/ zla ba gsum nas lnga'i bar rnying ba/ lo lon pa shin tu cing ba zhes bya/ de la dang bo ni/ sman dang gtar sas gtso bor bcos la/ gnyis pa bshal dang sman gyis btso bor bcos la / mi na rnam sa (yan lag brgyad par bshad pa ltar )ro mthun pa/ nus pa mthun pa ra shes par bya/ gtso bo'i ming smos pa shes par bya/ de shes pa la yon tan ci yod zhus nga/sa/ ro'i nus pa 'byung / nus pas nad sel ba yin/ ro mi mthun pa mi bsre/ gtso bo'i re re'i phyir 'khor mthun pa shes dgos/gang sbyar yang 'dra ba yin/ de la zhu 'khyags byi mtshan nyid brjod par bya ste /de'i dus galus po ber ba khol/ rtsa dal la mabrang / chu skya'am sngo/ sngar gyi gos kyis mi dros/ des zas sman 'ju stobs chung / nyi grib gnyis ka la mi tshugs/ de'i dus su tsha ba phyogs pa yin/ kha zas bag tsam glod/dris lan las dbya da kyis bcos pa'i le'u drus pa'o/ /yang rlung la bcos thabs brtag thabs mang bo yod kyang / nges pa can gang las/sa zhus pas/ dbye ba mang ste dpyad gzhung du gsal/ rtas/sa la dgu ru shes par bya/ bcos phyir me drod thur la bsten/ khugs pa dang ldan pa dang rkyang ba zhugs pa'o/ /'di bcos zhig shes pa bag dka'/ de bas thog mar bla gnyan bsal bar bya/ byug pa shing kun slog skya'i thang yang gtong / snum bzhi'i dugs byugs/ phan yon gcig shes gtong / stod kyi rlung la byugs pa shis pa ste/ /bar du thur ma smad du 'jam rtsi shis/ /rjes ni sman mar (btsan dug )me btsas dpyad par bya/ /de bas 'di la gang yang 'tsho ba yin/ /dris lan las rlung gi man ngag bye brag tu bstan pa'i le'u ste 37

bdun pa'o/ /yang lan cig grang ba bcos na ji lta ra bcos zhus pas/ spyir grang ba la dpas tu med pa yod kyang / bsdus na skran dang / dwangs ma mkhris pa bya ba yod pas/ sanyis la'i rgyu ma zhu ba dang ( me drod nyams pa las byung /grang bar smin na kre thur 'is/ skran dang / lcags dreg dang / dmu chu dang / mkhrel ma la sogs pa la/ tsha ba gsum smi na gyi me/ sha chang zas kyi me/ dugs byug res bya'i me stobs dang drag shul spyod lam gyi me bzhis skabs dang sbyar dgos gsungs/ dris lan las grang ba'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o/ /yang bad kun tsha ba la cis phan zhus ju sa / nad 'di dang 'phrad na bag dka' ba yin te/ la ra ma nu ba'i thang gis bad kun tsha ba la phan 'u su dang tig ta'i thang gis phan/ se 'bru'i phye mas phan/ rgyam tsha lce myang tshas phan da slas kyis phan/ ro ldan rgyug pa sa phan/ sbrang / skyu ru ra/gla sgang gsum sbyar bas phan/ bshal skyus rtson pos phan/ tshigs pa bcu gsum pa bsreg pas phan/ mchin rtsa ru thung gtar bas phan/ dar ba so mas phan/ kha zas yang la bsil bas phan/ cung zad bcag pas phan gsungs so / /dris lan la sa bad gan tsha ba'i le'u ste dgu ba'o/ /yang lan gcig spyi dang phal cher bya ba bcog na ji ltar lags zhus pa/ ngos 'dzin ga'an las kyang ras dathos te/ 'on kyang 'dir sadams ngag can la rag las pa med gsungs/ spyir snying la nad cig yod na snying rang gis tshor ba bya ba yin te/ myos pa'am brgyal ba'am/ bsngangs pa byung ba bzhin/glo la nad yod na lu ba yin/ nge yang sro da la lu ba dang / tho rangs lu ba dang / zas 'phrod mi 'phrod las shes/ mtsher ba la nad yod na zas 'phrod mi 'phrod khrag gi me rtog byung ba la sa shes/ pho ba la nad yod na zas 38

'ju mi 'ju dang sbo mi sbo dang / 'khrol mi 'akrol la shes/ mkhal ma la nad yod na cis kyang chu la bab pa/ tsha na 'gro ba las kyis shes chu sri ba'o/ /rkang ba 'big pa 'dra nang lta bu ma nor ba zhig gis chos gzhan gang dang gang ma nor ba med gsungs/ ma tsher ba dang long la nad yod na pho ba g.yas ngos nas chu la 'bab/ tsha grang sang yin yang sbo ba yin/ 'dzi gnyis ma nor ba shes pa bya/ spyir de ltar yong ba la/ glo ba la nad yod na phal cher tsha ba yin/ snying la yod na phal cher rlung dang chu ser du 'ong / rma chin pa la yod na phal cher tsha bar 'ong / pho ba'i nad phal cher grang bar 'ong / long nad phal cher grang rlung du 'ong / mal/ la ma'i nad phal cher grang bar 'ong / yang mi srid pa dag par bya ba gang yin zhus pas kha cig na re/snying latsha ba mi srid do/ de dag par bya ba'i phyir du glo la tsha ba rgyas pa srid /glo tsha ba rgyas na de la tsha ba dang ldan pa ra 'ong ba yin/ gzhan yang pho ba rgyas na cis kyang mchin pa tsha ba yin/ mchin pa grang na cis kyang pho ba grang ba yin/ de ci snyam na gcig grang ba'i gzhi yin pa dang / gcig tsha ba'i gzhi yin pas so/ /de bzhin du sbyar ro/ /de bzhin du snying tsha na glo bcos bya ba dang / glo ba la rlung yod na snying bcos bya ba la sogs pa ci rigs su sbyar/gdams pa dang mi ldan pas/ stong ba'i tshad rtags phra ro ngos ma zin par drod bcos byas pas tshad pa rgyas pa ma tshor ba'i nyen yod sasungs so/ /gso ba rig pa 'i man ngag le'u ste bcu ba'o/ /skyes bu me lha'i zhus lan no/ /beeḍūrya la na mo/ spyir tshad pa gsar rnying bcos pa la don gsum ste/nad smin dgos mi dbos shes pa dang / dpyad kyi dus tshod thes pa dang /bar du nad kyi tshabs che chung la brten nas/ dpyad kyi che chung shes pa dang /tha ma ri thang mtshams su sleb sleb la brten nas/ la zas dam glod shes pa dang lnga'o/ /de la smin dgos pa ni/ rgas ches gzhon ches nyam chung dang / /39

bad rlung shas che'i rims rnams la/ /smin par bya ba man ngag yin/ /ma smin rtags ni grang shum byed /tshigs dang lus po byin pa na/ /za zi mang zhing sems las che/ /kha la mig rus na ba dang / /khyad par srod la rmi la ma mang ༈ /rtsa 'dar phra myur skad 'dar smra/ /me dang nyi ma 'dod pa 'ong / /'di'i dus su nad khrag dang zungs khrag 'dres pas tshad pa rgyas pa mi tshor ro/ /bad rlung gi khrag gnyis dbyer ma phyed pa'o/ /smin par byed pa la/ zhag grangs kyi khyin pa ni/ bdun/ bcu gcig bar du smin rtags ma byung bar dpyad mi bya/ sman gyis smin pa ni/ 'bras bu gsum dang / ma nu bzhi thang /skyu ru ra'i thang gis smin/ khyad par du gle tres la pur rnying btab la bskol grang gtong / gong ma gtso/ grang thang gtong / skol dang chogasho/ /smin pa'i rtags ni grang shum la sogs pas lus la nad dri 'ong / chu dmar ser du 'gro/ lud pa lam ser dud kha 'ong / lus la gzer 'byung ba dang /gtam mi thon zhing smra'o/ /smin mi dgos pa ni/ 'khrugs drag po dang /gzer drag po/ sha chang spyod lam drag ngo sa tsha ba skyes pa/ lang tsho dar la babs pa/ nad kyis btab ma thag nas lud pa kham nag la sogs pa 'byung ba dang / g.yang du lhung ba la sogs pa kha cig smin long med pa 'a dpyad bya/bar du nad tshabs che chung dang sbyar nas dpyad byed pa la/ nad rab ni lud pa dud khu'am/ kham pa 'byung ba/ rtsa drag la gzer phur ba btab pa'am/skad dang dbugs thung la brtsegs/ chu khrag gi rtog ma can du 'byung / de la yas babs rtse chung gtar/ ga pur gtong / spyir ga pur gtong lugs bzhi/ ga pur ka ra dang sbyar ba la/ spyang rgyug gam lcags mda' zer/de'i stong du cu gang dang gi wang bsnan pas rgyal blon gsum pa zer/ de steng du gur gum bsnan pa la mthun sbyor bzhi ba zer/ de'i steng du gla rtsi dang shing mngar bsnan pa la mthun spyor drug pa zer/ rno ba snga ma rno tshan rting ma 40

che/ sman zug pa'i rtags 'dar ba dang / bsngang ba/ rngul sogs byung na zug pa yin/ nad de bas tshabs chung na/ sman dpyad rig pas dpyad/nad mi drag par yam yam byed nas na na bshal bya/ sman dpyad rnying ma'i lugs kyis khrag dang mkhris pa zer/ gsar ba'i lugs kyis 'khrugs dang rims zer/ rnying ba rgyu yi sgo nas ming 'dogs/ gas ra ba 'bras bu'i sgo nas ming 'dogs/ don 'dra'o/ /'khrusas rims gnyis kyi khyad par ni/'khrugs stod brgyangs nas na/ rims lus thams cad na/ 'khrugs chu dmar/ rims chu ser/ rims dran pa mi tsasal 'khrugs dran pa gsal/ rims dran pa mi bde/ 'khrugs skom dad che/ rims la bshal dang rngul gtso che/ 'khrugs la bsil dang gtar ba satso che/ tha ma ri thang mtshams su sleb na/ bcud satong / ri thang mtshams gzhan du gsal /a tsa ra phyag rdum gyi lugs/ /baiḍūrya la na mo/ rtsa la brtag pa gzhan du shes par bya/ lce la brtag pa ni/ rlung gi lce ni skya la rtsub pa dang/ no mi tshor ba dang / ldib pa dang sgo'agyur mi shegapa dang / tho rangs zas ma zos dus mi bde ba dang / lud pa dkar bro sbya ba rlon pa dang / kha mang ba rnams ni rlung gi rtags so/ /tshad pa'i lce ni/ dmar ba/ ser ba/ nag pa/ thung ba/ skam pa/'brum bu dmar bo yong ba/ rlung ma yin par ldang ba dang / kha kha ba/lud pa khrag tu 'ong ngo / /dbugs thung / glo chung yong / g.yob pa dang /kha rlangs tsha ba rnams tshad pa'o/ /bad gan gyi lce ni ra tshil gyis g.yosas pa ltar dkar ba dang / ring ba/ chu skyur skyusas pa/ zas la ro med pa/ngal ba/ dbusas ring zhing grang ba rnams ni bad kun no/ /rlung gi so la brtas pa/ dkar la bkrag chung ba/ so na ba/ 'gul ba'o/ /tshad pa'i so ni khrag gi dregs pa chags pa / so rtsa nas khrag 'ong ba'o/ /dkar ba dang 41

gnas 'u gas ni/ rgas pa la skya ba lbu ba can du 'ong / dar ma la dam ra ser du 'ong / byis pa'i sngo skya sngo bar 'ong / nad tshad pa yin na chang sings mang bo 'thung na sngo/ grang ba min kyang ngal dub sri ba'am/'asalas pa yun ring du ma 'thung dmar ser du 'ong / lta ba'i thabs sne /nad pa spyod lam ma 'khrugs pa/ ri bo gser gyi zhwa gon dus snod 0tsang dag dang lda na pa 'dzi/ la dog ku ya rlangs pa mosas drang sro nga las len snying bro sasal sgron bsdus par blta/ nad dmigs bstan pa ni rlung gi chu dkar ba dang / rlangs pa chung ba dang / lhu ba mang ba/ chu la snyi ba/'phyen drags pa rnams so/ /tshad pa'i chu ni ser/ dri rlangs che/ lbu ba reg bya tsha ba snams so/ /bad dan chu ni/ ser dang rlangs pa chung / zlos pa dka' ba dang / snyigs ma che ba'am / ya nga na sangs pa 'o/ /'o na rtags de dang ldan pa'i nad de dus nam skye/ rkyen cis ldang zhe na/ rlung dgun/dpyid tho rangs 'gro 'dug ser bu dang / zas spyod rlung skye ba rnam sa kyis na'o/ /na lugs ni/ snying mi dga' ba dang / tshigs pa za ba dang /gnyid med pa dang / rmi la ma du sacan gzan gyis bdas pa'am/ 'phur ba la sogs pa dang / lus ngag sge spyod pa sngar tsanas kyi 'gyur ba dang /lus grang ba dang / khol bur sbrid pa dang / mgo bo 'thom pa / lto gas sran chung ba/ kha za snying 'dod pa/ lus tsha yang reg na grang ba dang /stong skyug dang sgregs ngan 'ong ba dang / zos na cung zad bde ba'o/ /tsha ba'i nad mi dbyar stod dang / nam gung / nyin gung / zas spyod mkhris pa sa skyed pas na'o/ /na lugs ni grang shum byed pa dang / 9 ro ske'abyung ba dang / long tsha ba dang / rtse ba sbrid pa dang ( rtsib logs dang /stod du gzer ba khong rlug cing na'o/ /rgyu ni ldos cing na ba dang / sa bon 'u gas pa dang / mkhal khrag 'dzag pa'o/ /ma chin pa'i tshad pa ni dang ga 43

mi bde/ 'u sa lci/ na zus 'ong ba'o/ /snying si tshad pa ni/ sto da mi bde/snying nu sa cing mi bde ba'o/ /rims ni/ spyir lus thams cad na/ byad par du rus tshigs tham sa cad khol/ za zi mang bro 'ong / dug ris thebs pa ni mdos sngo'am nag mis gis mi mthong / skyu ga bar bzod/ gre ba 'as kha phru ma nga / lce phugs su bros/ kha sodang lce nas lus sbyin/ 'khru skyug byed/ de ya nga rlung mkhris bad kun gsum ka shas gang che lta'o/ / bad rkan nam zla ston/ dpyid snga dro dang / / lu sa grang ba dang rngul ba dang / ngal ba dang / kha zas ma tshos pa dang / me du ba la sogs pas bred pa dang / snum rlan zos dus na'o/ /na lugs ni mgo bo 'jom pa dang / skad 'dar ba dang / rshas pa mi gsal ba dang / zas ma zos kyang mi ltogs pa'o/ /zas zos na mi bde ba dang / lus lci ba dang / rmug pa dang / brang tsha ba dang / sgregs ngan dang / grang na na zhing dros na bde ba'o/ /rlan grang ba ni khong sbo/ khog bzhi 'khyil zhing na/ tshigs ba'i na/'or du lhung / grang bar 'gro/ khol bur na/ skran du ston/ zas mi 'ju/ dmu chu 'gro bar ston/ pho ba dang lag mthil la dregs pa chags/mkhal sked rgyu zhabs su 'pho/ de ltar rtags brgyad zhar las 'byung ba rnam sa kyis nad ngos bzung bar bya'o/ /snum tshil lus lci ba la sogs pa dang /lce mtha' skam pa bad dzin no/ /ser zhing ral/ lus kyang ser/ skam pa dag ni mkhris pa'o/ /shin tu skam pa glo nad/ zur dag nag pa mchin nad do/ /gzhung dag nag skam snying nad do/ /dmar zhing thung na mkhal nad do/ /tha ma nag por 'khor ba na/ mtsher nad dag dang mchin nad rdo/ /sen mo dmar na mdangs chags legs/ sen mo mdangs yal 'chi ba'o/ /skya shar dag ni byung na yang / mtheb mo glo la mdzub mo mchin/ gung mo snying la/mthe'u chung mkhal mar shes par bya/ skya shar bad kun smug por brtas 44

lce chung babs pa la/ g.yer rma / pho ba ris/ khyemabu'i nang du mar khu blugs la / de'i steng du blugs te 'ded/ spyi bor phying ba bzhag la sru gur me la bzhag la bsro/ spyi bo nas sku mtshams sacig 'phang lo'i mig nas bton la bcud do/ /mchu bad nan gyis na ba la/ a ru ra dang / bu ram gnyis 'ib par btasas la/ khye'u 'thung ba'i nu zho la sbya ra la bskus/ kha dar dmar bos bcad zhag gcig mi bshu'o/ /des thub/ khab khong du shor ba dbyung ba'i thabs la/ rgod kyi 'dom spu'am/ ri bong gi dru slang nga la bsregs/ ser tsam song bar brngos la 'o ma dang thug pa byas te/ de rnams bsres pa 'i thug pa zhag gsum tsam gtong / zas gzhan srung ngo / /a ru ra dang tsha la bsres pa bas re gtong / skom srung / nad pa gan rkyal du ba'ag 'gyur du mi gzhugs/ mid pa la nya rus zug pa'am dus pa zug pa'am/ gra ma zug pa'am/ shing la sogs pa zug pa dang / srin bal lam kha che'i dar zing zing bor byas la/ skud pa bzang bo la dar btang la/ dar mid du gzhug skud pa mi btags bar bzung ste/ ske rtsa g.ya sa g.yon nas khu tshur gyis brdung la/ lan ba'i lnga tsam phar los tshur log byas nas/ lhor gartong ba'i skud pa dam bus drangs nas phyung na/ mi 'thosas par dbyung nges so/ /tsher ma gdug pa can zug na grog tshang gi sa/ 'brug rus/ ra khrag rnams chu la sbyar nas byugs na phan no/ /mi chu'i khyer ba'i dpyad la/ kha sbub tu bzhag la steng nas mis mnan no/ kha sna nas chu dbyung bar bya/ yang na phyug ma la maso bo 'phyang du bcus la bskal lo /des sol par 'gyur ro/ /mi 'asags pa gso ba la/ thag pa mi bcad par la sna lag pas bkab la dbugs dal bus gtong ngo / /des sos so / /cig sbur sdom sogs khong du thor ba'i dpyad la/ zangs rtsi'i rtsa ba brdung la lhor gtong bas phan no/ /mes tshigs pa bcos pa la glang gi lci ba byung thog byug na 46

phan no/ /kha zas kyi bsnang ma thag la/ ltag par khu tshur drag po sasum bdes rtso/ /sog dbrag tu gnyis/ des ma byung na kha sbrub tu bzhag la/rkang ba gnyis gshib la sman pa'i lag mthil gyi rtsal skyed la bdes so/ /grang ba glang thabs zhi bar bya ba la/ dur byid/ rgya tsha bul rtog dud pa ral ba can bzhi brdung la rma ra dang sbyar ba'i ril bu byas pas phan no/ /nged kyi lugs gyis/ srung ba'i rgyal bo la/ gu gul/ gla ba/ mu zi/ rta bon pa/ rma bya'i mdongs rnams sman lnga'o/ /spyang ṣka byi la phag bande /ro tshan )nus pa can gyis brun rnams lnga'o/ /sbal ba/ sbru la / te lo ba/ sre mong sha chen lnga 'o/ /spru ba'i rtsa ba/ ri tho'i rtsa ba/ mkhan pa'i rtsa ba/ shu das dbyi mong gi me tog snam sa te shing lnga'o/ yungs dkar/ la cha/tshwa/ sgog skya/ sa yer ma rnams te rdzas spyor ba lnga'o/ /chang skyur/ zo shabya rgod spos/ gla rtsi bzhi'o/ /'ib btabs lus la bcang / lto ra gtong /snar bdug gzhan la yang de ltar ro/ /'go nad can de dag risas dang /so srin la sogs pa la bcangs pas mi thub mi srid do/ /gza' skar bzang ba la sbyar ro/ /gnam mi mthong bar sbyor dus yi dam bsgom sa snying ngo bzlas/smra bcad byas nas sbyar ro/ /rtsa khong nas bsdom pa'i sman la gur gum/ cu gang / li 'i/ sus smel/ dom mgris/ tsan dan dkar dmar/shing mngar/ shing tsha dan tis rgya skyegs/ za 'og ser kra'i thal ba/skug rtsod kyi tshigs pa'i thal ba/ mgron bu lho ma'i thal ba de rnams ka ra bzhi 'gyur dang sbya ra/ tsha ba che na ga pur/ rgya skyegs kyi chus phul la satong ngo / /'u sa ma go mjus gi rtsa gang chad kyang the tshom med do/ /khong rtsa chad pa dang / tshad 'khru la/ mthan pa g.yar yin na lo ma la/ dgun rtsa ba 'ib pa ra brdungs la chu la khu ba thon par bsnyal la ka ras kha blang la gtong ngo / /rka ba yin no /mkhris pa gur gum srad nag btong / ji lta bu yang tshod byin 47

'dug go/ / sdod kyi man ngag la/ pags la sdod na 'dre sdod yin te/mnan na yod pa 'dra/ 'gyur ldog che'o/ /sha la sdod na na sdod ste/ mchil ba 'dra na thung (nad co )la rtsub/ rus la sdod na 'chi sdod yin/ lto ba'i yas mar rtsa yod med la bu ram/ snying rtsa med pa la chang gtong bas phan pa yang yod/ mar rtsa yas rtsa med pa gso ba dka'/ sdod pa'i grangs la 'chi dus btab/ ma 'khrul rtags kyi 'khor lo/ skyes bu me lhas mdzad/ nad ngos 'dzin pa'i man thog mkhas pa phyag gi lugs/ rgya'i mthing shog sngon po la/ gser gyi yi ge can zer ro/ /marga /
la gtong / /stag rgyas gyen la los srid na/ /par 'gyur/ /cis te bcad pa sa ma chod na/dom mkhris la tshar btab pas the tshom med/ gcod/ /slob dngo na sa ngas mgon la/ /khyung thi

yugs (byung na yugs sa ma'i mnga' khrag ma byung na rdor rta brdab pa'i thal ba )na ldong ros dang / /zhib btags ba yi chu la sbya ra/ /bsku zhing byugs pa sa chu ser 'joms/ /nag po'i sbyor ba bshad par bya/ /sngar bzhin ba chus legs par bkru/ /de nas sman gyis byug pa bya/ (kyi lce dkar bo lcags kyu ba/ /sga tig nag po rnam pa gsum/ /bungs che 'byor tshad zhib par btags/ /shu dag nag po phab tsam btab/ /yang yang blusas pas mi 'tsho med/ /spyo da pa'i sbyor ba lag len ltos/ /rkang 'baza bcos pa 'i thabs zab mo bdud rtsi bcud kyi la ga len yin no/ /yi thi/ dge'o/ /53

satong / /'di yis de'u sbyongs par byed pa snge/ / des dwangs ma 'byor na/dbya da kyis 'don par byed pa la/ /rde rigs rnam pa bzhi yod nge /lha de dkar dang btsan rdo dmar/ /danu lde sngo la bdud rdo nag phal cher lha rde dkar bo 'byung / /btsan rde dam ra bo 'ga' yang 'byung / /phyi rma gnyis kyang srid pa tsam/ /lha rdo dkar bo nges par 'tsho/ /btsan lde phal cher 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /phyi ma sanyis po phal cher 'chi/ /dpyad kyi sngon du rim gro bya/ /las la bya ba sman pa'i las/ /man pa'i gnyen nam rgyal bo la/ /dpyad ma byas na 'chi 'gyur la / /byas na 'chi dogs med pa lags/ /de ltar rgyal bo la zhus nas/ /srub mtsham sa nas gang ma gtogs pa/ g.yon gyi phyogs su 'bral bar bya/ /bya thabs bla ma'i 'al 'a sa dris/ /de nas rdo ba thon pa dang / /bu ram ra gtogs zas mang byin/ /'u sa kyi smad 'a bsku mnye bya/ /zug gzer byung na long rtsa satar/ /phyag sman rin rgyal bdas gis sbyar/ /'gro kun sdug bsngal grol bar shog / yi thi maṅga / bha wartu/57

bzang yang rang sgo zhan/ /rigs kyi grags pas nad pa bcos/ /rang gi nye tshan gsod pa yi/ /sman pa la la dme pho yin/ /bslab pa med pa ra tho co byed/ tsond dang gsang gi khyad mi rshas/ /dpyad la snying khams che ba yi /sman pa la la smyon pa yin/ /yon tan chung la nga rgyal che/ /bsod nams chung la dug ngo hrul/ /kun gyi snying du mi sdug pa'i/ /cha na pa la la mdze pho yin/ /'tsho ba'i nad la khas mi len/ /'chi ba'i nad la dus mi theb/ /lus ngag dul bas bcos pa yis/ /sman pa la la rkun ma yin/ /dbya da rnams 'chol nas gnod ma nga byed/ /ma byed smra na phan ya nga 'jog / mi chos bde bar spyod pa yi/ /sman pa la la zog po yin/ /bsla ba sbya nga so nams ma byas par/ /yon tan lo tos rma rgyas pa'i/ /bsod nams 'bras bu med gyur pa'i/ /mi na pa la la yi dwags yin/ /yon tan bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor ngan/ /pho so zol bstod mjug ma rgyas/ /ma bslab la da mo 'bod pa yi/ sman pa la la spre 'u 'dra / /phyug cing khengs grags che ba las /yo byad blangs nas mchod sbyin byed/ nad pa bu ltar skyong ba yi/ /sman pa byang chub sems nyid yin/ mang thos shar gyi ri bo las /man ngag nyi ma 'i 'od zer gyis/ /blo yi pa da mo rab phye ba'i/ /sman pa mdzes pa'i me rtog yin/ /blo gros rab gsal rta bdun dpa la/ /yon tan gzi 'od stong gis brjid/ / nyes sasum 'khrugs pa'i mun pa sel/ /sman pa nam mkha'i nor bu yin/ /lesas par sbyangs pa'i ri bong 'dzin/ /rmad byung rgyu ryā ra khrod na mdzes/ /nad kyi gdung ba rab sel ba'i/ /sman pa zla 'od rab sasal yin/ /rgyud sde'i stobs kyi 'bor los bsgyur/ /man ngag dbang gis cod pa na mdzes/ /thos pa 'i dngu nga mas gzhan zil gnon/ /sman pa 'khor lo bsgyur rgyal yin/ /bcong nad dam pos zin pa yis /sman nga nge yi mtshan thos na/ /nad pa tham sa cad spro ba bskyed/ sman pa snyan pa'i phrin yig yin/ /rkyon med yon tan ldan pa'i lus/ /'dzin spyod dran pa'i tsal 60

gsu ma rdzogs / /grogs mched brtse ba'i g.yu ral rgyas/ rgyu na pa mi yi seng ge yin /thos bsam rgya mtsho'i gling nas 'ong / /brtson 'grus rdo rje'i bzings la drongs /ded dpon slob dpon bsam pa bzang / /sman pa nor bu rin chen yin/ /de ltar skyo na yon legs brtag nas /skyon spa nga yon tan len pa ni/ /rigs rgyud 'bras bu don yod yin /dus sasum mkhyen pa'i 'ang ston zhig po nas / /dar ma mgon po man chad nas / /da lta'i mi na chung yan chad 'a / /gzu bo'i blo yis legs pa ra gzhal/ / chags sdang med par legs — bstan nas/ /dus sasum mkhyen pa'i chos rje zhig po yis / /'du ba mun lta ra 'thibs pa'i gcong nad la/ /zla ba lta bur gsal ba'i sgron ma nga / /gnas la me chen 'bar 'dra'i tshad pa la/ /bdud rtsi lta bur bsil ba'i chu rgyun nga / /gangs ri kha bas non 'dra'i grang nad bas la/ /sprin med nyi ma lta bur 'gro ba nga / /ma rung srog bcod sbrul 'dra'i dug nad la /'joms byed rma bya lta bu'i gnyen po nga rga / bzod dka' ri gzar chu 'dra'i 'khru skyug la/ / bas yod thabs kyis gcod pa'i ral gri nga / /gza' dang khyi smyon klu 'dra'i dug so gas la/ /sasang sngags sman dang 'dra ba'i bde gshegs nga / /shing rta gzer phog 'dra ba'i chag khrug la/ /khrim sa kyi mgar ba lta bu'i sman pa nga /rig pa'i ra bar mang bo tshogs pa na /seng ge lta bur 'gran zla med pa nga / /zhes pa'i 0tam nyid sman rwa rnams la 'o/ /rig pa smra ba lha'i sman pa dar mthon gyis legs par bkod nga 'o/ /yi thi/ man bha wartu/61

la gtar bar bya /glo la ro stod pho ba gzer/ /ma chin pa rtsib 'o ga pho ma chin gzer/ /mtsher rma mkha' ma de nyid gzer/ /sman ni rang rang la bsgyur bya/ /mkhris pa 'u da pa ser ngo ste/ /dma na ni dom mkhris tig ta bya/ /des ma ci na a ru ra/ /ma tsher ba li shi pi pi ling / /mkhal ma sus smel gtong bar bya /ru thung smad dam long rtsa btar/ /satar sa mang na rtogs nas 'gro/ /rin rgyal 0zer bcos zab mo i ji/ /dge'o/ /

la )'a /zhal bsro srid zhu (mar gtong )bkur sti bya/ /ga'an yang (mi la srin yong bas )'di yi ma na ngag la/ /lung la khyab pa'i rig pa'i sman (so so 'i kha bsgyur)/ /gang 'a gang phan snan dpyad ris pa'i mda' yis (rgyung lu nga dang bstun )bsnun/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad kun 'joms/ rgyal srid bstan pa 'dzug (rus khu'i tshod ma satong )pa la/ / zhabs 'dren byed pa'i mi (mi ngan/zas ngan/ gtam ngan )gsum bsrung ༈ /mi rnams srin gyis 'chi ba la/ /'di med sman pa gshin rje 'dra/ /gso byed nad gzhi ci yo da kyang ( /thos pas dga' zhing sems re dro/ /reg pa bde ba ngo mtshar skye/ /pho log 'khun pa gros 'debs 'di/ /kho bo g.yu thog mgon ngo sa sbyar/ /phyag sman mkhas pa 'i khyad chos yin/ /ya nga cig 'khun pa gros 'debs sbyor ba la /gla rtsi shu dag su ga smel thang phrom dang / / dwa ba pi pi ling bca' sga rgyam tsha dang ni kha ru tsha/ yung ba srin bu dmar leb dang / /shing kun dang ni bong nga dmar/ /byi tang ka ni re res kyang / /srin gyi grong khyer lnga brgya bshig / 'akun pa gros 'debasasbyor ba 'di/ /phyag sman mkhas pa'i zhal gdams yin/ /yang cig srin bu'i mkhar bshig la/ /'khun pa gros 'debs gzhir bzhag nas/ /bse cur bying bying thu lu ba/ /tshan gyi grong khyer lnga brgya yi/ /srin gyi mthar rnams bshig par byed/ /long rtsa gcig gam gnyisaka gtar /bi ji mkhas pa'i zhal gdams yin/ /shu snyam/tshangs pa dbu sel dud pa la/ /mu zi gla rtsi shing kun dang / /byi tang ka dang thang phrom pa/ /bong nga nag po sgog skya dang / /srin bu dam ra leb 'a tshil sbyar/ /mkhar rdo srin med steng du bsregs/ /dud pa nam zad bar du bdug /tshangs pa dbu sel gyi gdams pa yin/ /'bum chung khu tshur 'di phyag (rin rgyal )sman mkhas pa 'i khyad chos yin/ /bod yul dbus na phyas sman malas/ /nyams yig khu tshur i thi/ mgilo / bha wartu/ dge'o/ /65

'di ltar bya/ /rme nu kuṇḍa ka ri dang / /sle tresasga skya bzhi yi thang / /thun bskyed yang yang gtong bar bya /de nas mchin pa'i rtsa la gtar/ /gsum bzhi re tsam gtong bar bya/ /bar shun gsum gyi khugs su gzhug / se ba 'om bu skyer bar sasu ma/ /'di yis bad ban khro ba srung / /glo rtsa thang rtsa zung cig gtar/ /'di yis bad tan kro ba srung / /de nas se 'bru'i sbyor ba bya/ /se 'bru shing tsha sug smel dang / /pi pi ling dang da lis sga/ /'di ming se 'bru drus pa ste/ /'di yis bad kun sbyong du rung / /'di la sbyong byed blun po 'ga'/ /kha cig thur du sbyong ba mang / /blo 3 na dpa' bo'i gzhung la sa — —kyang / /skyug sman mkhris pa 'i sman mchog yin/ /bkrus sman bad lan sman mchog yin/ /des na bad gan stod du drongs/ /de nas skyusas kyi sbyor bskyibya/ /'gro ba 'dren pa sangs rgyas yin/ /'di ni lcags kyu'i 'dren glu —— pa mchog /nad ni skyug gis 'dren par byed/ /po son cha yi nus pa yis / /nad ni lcags kyu lta bur 'dren/ /gser gyi phud bu'i nas pa yis/ /zhags pa lta bur 'gugs par byed/ /bya khra phad dang ri sho bas/ /nad gzhi steng nas 'khrugs par byed/ /shu dag lhum rtsa rnam gnyis kyis / /drod bskyesdo gzhi glu'adzin rkyen du 'gyur/ /rgyal blon 'khor bcas bskyon pa'i rta/ /sprang rgod rta la bskyon la gtong / / skyug la lugs gnyis/ lho bal rgyal bo'i lugs/rgyal blon bod kyi /skyugs dang gnyis/ /lho bal rgyal bo'i lugs ni/ sbyor ba'i sman de rnams snga dro lto stong / zas zos nasayud tsam nas sman 0tong nas 'thung ma thag skyug pa mnan nas/ de nas yud tsam nas skyug tu gzhugade nas bya rog gi sgro pho bar gtong ste/ pho ba'i nad dkrugs nas gtong ste /nad ma lus par skyug go/ /rgyal blon bod kyi skyug ni sman de rnams chu la sbyar la thang du bskol te/ rma nga nyung bre phul bdun du yo nga ba tsam bya/ dang bo sman bskol ma thag man khu bzhi phul gang blud la/ nad pa khri pus modang 67

mnyam pa'i steng du nad pa bzhag la/ mgo bo thur du brkyang ba la/ gre bar kho rang cu mdzub ro gtong la myug tu gzhug sman pa'i lag pas nad pa'i rgyab nas gyen du ded/ lto ba'i gong du/ snal ma'i gru gu chen po zhig bzhag la/ des lte ba nas gyen du btsir gyin skyug go/ /de nas tsog pur langs nas sman phul lu re tsam gtong gin/ sngon ma ltar byas kyin skyug tu gzhugalan grangs lnga yis sman de rnams zad par bya'o /de nas spod/ pi pi ling /skyu ru ra/ yungs dkar/ rgyam tsha bzhi'i thang gtong la/ phul 'u de tsam bya/ de lan bzhi satong la/ byed lugs sngo na ma ltar byas la skyug tu gzhugade ltar lan dgu yis / bad lan gyi nad kun rtsa ba nas 'thon/ mig la rab rib yod na 'dis thu ru 'gro/ skyugs kyi rjes la/ 'bras bu gsum gyi thang gis snod bde zhing 'jam par byed do/ / rjes la mgo bro na ba dang /mchin pa na ba dang / mig dmar ba byung na/ ru thung gtar/ ra go bo la bra zhwa bskon/ bad kun smad du 'grims na/ 'di gzhan dbang can gyi nad yin pas / bad gan 'obs su lhung ba bya ba yin/ rkang 'bam yang 'di las 'byung ba yin/ skrang ba'i nad thams cad bad kun yin/ gzhung nas/ rlung med mi na mkhris med tsha/ med de bad kun med mi da/ /khrag med dmar bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes pas/ smad du 'grims na 'bam la sogs pa so so'i bcos thabs bya'o/ /rgyu long du babs na/ ba le ga bong nga dkar bo rnams kha bsgyur du gtong bas bkrus sman bya/ rtsa khrus dang bya'o/ /gzhung nas mthus pa bkrus sman/ dngar dang da bad lan la ni tsha ba srud/ rlung la snum dro lan tsha can/ zhes pa'i sbyor ba ya nga bya'o/ /nad gang la babs dang / phyi nas bltas pa'i sbyor ba yang bya dgos so/ /grum bu ya nga bad kun chu ser gyi tsha ba tshigs pa la babs pa yin te/ po ba'i yul 'di rlung me mnyam nas/ bad kun myag byed mkhris pa 'ju byed dang /68

gsum po pho bar 'dzom nas rlung gis bus/ /ma khris pas skol/ bad dan gyis myag par byas nas rtsa chen nyi shu rtsa bzhir gram te/ zas kyi dwangs rma lus zungs su 'gro/ snyigs ma dri mar 'gro/ lus zungs dang bo khrag nge nas sha de nas tshil/ de nas dus/ de nas rkang / nge nas klad pa/de nas lams dwags rma ste/ 'u sa zungs rgyas par byed pa ltar/ 'dzad pa rmi nga rim gyis 'dzad do/ /lus zung4zad pa la brten nas rlung skye cing glu 'phel/ rgyas pa la brten nas / bad lan dang ma khris pa 'phe la/ de nas lus zungs rgyas pa las byung ba'i bad kun la bzhung nas rigs nyi shur bshad mod na ya nga / 'dir bsdus na lnga yin te/ rtas byed mgo bo la sanas/des chad pa rnams rtas shing / dbang bo rnam sa tshim pa ra byed rdo/ /'byor byed ni tshigs la tsanas te tshigs rnams sbyor zhing chag grug rnams sbyor ro/ / myag byed ni pho bar gnas te zas rnams myas par byed pa'o/ / zas zos ske 'grul bar byed pas na/ 'grul dang 'byin par byed pa yin de las ldan 'dus 'khrugs pa las/ nyi shu'i grangs su bshad pa yin/ de ltar dbye ba drug cu gnyis/ /drug cu gsum pa sdebs nas rgyu /smug po zhes pa sdebs nas rgyu/ /smug po mas pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ khrag dang 'dres las byung ba yin/ khrag mkhris srog ni gcig pa'i phyir/ mkhris dang 'dres pa gsu ma du 'gyur/ de ltar 'dus las byung ba na/ /gso dka' ba yang de ltaraglu yin/ /rgya sar lto skrag chen mo zer/ bod na bad gan smug po zer/ /mkhris pa 'i sa ni mkhal ma yin/ /rgyu long gnyis kyang yin si ra 'dod/ /mtsher ba khrag si rgya ma tsho ste/ /mtsher ba la yang sanas zhes gsu ngas/ bad kun stod na gnas pa'i phyir/ /stod du skyug gis drongs par bya/ /yun ring skyugs na mcho rdol zer/ /khras rnag dud khrag can rnams 'byung / /de yi thog ma ma ni nas/ yu ga re bde zhing 'joms par 'gyur/ /smad du byung na mcho rol 69

brgyad sbyar/ /bad lon shin tu gting ring bas/ /de rnams cis kyang ma song na/ /smug po 'don gyi sbyor ba bya /'don la dasar 'don dmar 'don rmudang / /skyug 'don gsum du nges par grags/ /nge la dkar 'don bshad pa la/ /se rgod rlon(ka ka ri )pa mang du bcad/ /ldum bu re ral yu gu shing / /spang rtsi dwa bo pu shel rtse/ /se rgod byed yin/ gzhan ma phyed/ de rnams legs par bsres la bskol/ /gangs chu bre gang nang du bstol/ /zhag bdun bar du thang re gtong / /de nas gangs thig sung phyed la / /lha mo g.ya' kyi thun cig gtong / /thang du bskol la lan gsum gtong / /de nas skyugs kyi sbyor bas drongs/ / smug po dkar 'don zhes bya ba/ /'od srung rgan pos bshad pa yin/ /smug po dmar 'don zhes bya ba/ 2ri rnyan thang la rgyug pa'i bras /rnyan gyi khrag la zer/ /dron mo byung na mchog tu legs/ /grang mo yin yang bsnyal la btung / /ji tsam khu ba spog tshad btung / /gyen du skyugs na shin tu legs/ /ma skyugs nangs par bshal gyis sbyongs/ /srug po'i dam ra 'don bya ba yin/ /'di yang 'od srung rgan pos bshad/ yang cig smub po skyug 'don la/ /sman ni gtso za ba sha ka / kyi lce dkar dang gri shan po / /pu rtse shel/ tsha la/ thom bu/ ba le da bsdus thang zhag bdun gtong bar bya/ de nas zhag gcig ngal bso la / /pha khol gzhung (yan lag brgyad par )las bshad pa bzhin/ /tsha chang gar ma bre phyed blugs/ /gnyid log rngul ni gaspur ston/ /smug po skyugs 'don zhes byar grags / /'od srung rgan ngo sa bshad pa yin/ 'di med smug po bcos pa de/ /lag ldum brag la 'dzegs pa bzhin/ /'di 'dra smug po bcos pa de/ /sgeg mos me long bltas pa 'dra/ /'di 'dra gzhan gyis shes sam ltos/ /shes na shin tu mkhas pa yin/ /drang srong g.yu thog mgon la sogs/ /phyag sman mkhas pa rnams kyis gsungs/ /yang cig smug po shin tu snying chad gsob dka' ba yin pa'i phyir/ de rnams 71

kyis sel bar ma nus na/ thal skar gyi bu dpal sgros dang / thang sgros gluganyis pos bshad pa'i smug po lcags khu'i sbyor ba bshad pa ra bya'o/ /de la smug ngo 'i rgyu gsum/ ring ba'i rgyu ni/ gti mug nye ba'i rgyu ni khrag tshad thang la lhag pa/ dpe 'di ni 'od srung san po dang / drang sro nga thal skar gyi bu dpal sgros dang / thang sgros sogs kyi dgongs pa phyag sman rin rgyal gyi phyas len nyams myong ma yin pas bstan bcos brgyad pa'i dgongs pa yin zhing 'di na sayu thog gi mtshan 'bri ba 'di ni malas slob kyis nor bar bris so/ /shin tu nye ba'i rgyu ni/ skyes bu kha zas drod can zos nas ma 'phrod/ spyod lam rtsing ba la shin tu gso ba dala' ba'i nad/ ngal dub chang skyur ram/sha rul thud rul/ bas 'khur de lta bu'i zas kyis nyen nas/ /nyin par gnyid log pa la rten nas shin tu nye ba'i rgyu 'byung ba yin/ de la gso ba'i thabs rin po che lcags khu'i sbyor ba bshad pa ni/ dang bo lcags kyi rgyu brtag pa ni/ lcags ni rdo ba las byung ba yin te/ lcags rdo la rigs gnyis yod pa las/ ma ju ra dang / gser sdig can gnyis yin/ rdo ba de gnyis las 'byung ba yin pas/ de nyid kyis ni gnod byed ces te/ ma 'ju ra btul mi dgos/ de ga rang sman la bsres pas chog gser thig can btul bar byas te/ lcags thams cad ni gser tig can la yong / de la stag pa bee shing gnyis kyis bzhu ba mchog tu bzang ba yin/ 'om bu spor skyes kyi shing sa rnamasakyis bzhu ba ngan te dor bar bya'o/ /sum pa dang / lcang ma/skyer ba la sosas shing 'jam pos bzhu bas kyang byar btub/ shug pas bzhu ba kun nas bzang / de lta bu'i lcags snod bzang bo'i nang du/ lcags tho mang bo blugs la de'i nang du a ru ra rdos po bdun hram hram brdungs la blug mtshur nas a ru ra rdog po gcig gi tshad cig bzhag la sanas dben par 'ag gsum byibs la bzhag de nas brton la lcags kyi cu gur 72

nyid du dpyad (cing mos par byas nas)/ /nad ni sna tshogs grangs (ga'an ldan pa dang 'dus pa yang so sor bstan )med phyir/ /re re nas (brjod kyis mi long )ni bstan mi nus/ /rags rim tsam gyi don sdud nas/ /rtsa ba'i rlung lngar 'dus pa (rlung nad brgyad cu zer kyang 'di ru 'dus pa yin/ brgyad cu'i ming ni tha snyad yin )yin/ /mdo tsam ldan pa de ltar mod/ /rlung nad (nam mnyam dang zad pa dang 'bel ba'i dbye ba rab dang mchog rab dag de las mtha' nyid 'gyur )bcos pa'i man ngag cher bsdus pa'o/ /rtsa ba (rtsa ba lnga bo la brtan pa thob dgos so )zin na yal ga zhor la shes 'byung ngo / /ma lo/ bha wartu/ 78

na/ /spyo 'brog go ni log pa yin/ /de nas rlung ni 'dres pa yin/ /dbye ba mang bo bshad par bya/ /mkhris pa 'dregartags tsha ba dang / /snyoms gzer mgo 'khor mun 'thib byed/ /tsha sngo skyur dang lan tsha bro/ /bsil zhing lci la spang ba dang / /tsha sogs zos dang bsnyung ba dang / /rtsal dang rtsub pa lhag par byed/ /'gro 'dod bad lan ldan pa yin/ /khrag ces tsha dang na dang bcas/ /sbrags sha sha nad shin tu zug / skrang ba das ni mdog 'gyur zhing / /thig le dmar bo 'byung ba yin/ /sha dang 'dres pa 'khres pa dang / /ba spu dag ni mdog 'gyur zhing / /'brum bu phra mo 'byung ba dang / /spu rtse lus la grog ma ni/ /rgyug pa snya ma du sems pa 'byung / /tshil gro 'dres pas gso dka' la/ /sayo 'ing snum la 'jam mkhrang lus/ /lus la spang zhing yi ga 'chus/ /de ni phyug po'i rlung nad yin/ /rus pa dang ldan reg na tsha/ /bcir na mngon par dasa' ba dang / /khab kyis rab tu btsags snyam byed/ /rkang dang ldan pa'i lus dag dang / /g.yal mang sbrid pa snyam sems byed/ /rab tu na la lag gnyis kyis/ btsir na bde bar 'gyur ba yin/ /bad kun gyis lci 'gul mi shes/ /tshor med snum zhing grang ba dang / /sayal zhing cung zad na ba yin/ /'dres pa'i mtshan nyid 'dren pa yin/ /nad gcig las gyur gas ra ga6sla/ /nad gnyis las gyur 'tsho ba tsam / /'dus pa las byung chu ser 'dzag / rengs dang 'thor bu 'chang ba spangs/ /rlung ni yan lag tshigs canas pa/ /khrag gis nad la myur gnon byed/ /rengs dang tshigs 'khums na bar byed/ /chu bar gnas la zug byas dang / /sgur dang bad kun nad du 'gyur/ /tshigs la gnas pa'i rlung skrang zhing / /rkyal ba rlung bis gang ba 'dra/ /dkar bo rlung yin dmar bo khrag /dkar la ba spu bu ga 'brub/ /dmar la rngab rus khrag dbyung bya/ /de rnam sa gso ba bshad par bya/ /sha tshil bsten la khrus sman bya/ /mas dang grags dang zhi bya'i snan/ /gong du ji skad 81

srungs zhes pa ni/ ma nyam sanas kyi rlung 'phel te/ stod du lud nas gyen du rgyug ded song ba la/ sazhung nas skyug pa shugs drag mi bzad 'chi/zhes pa ni/ skyug pa zas ma zhu bar skyug pa dang / nag po ja bzhur 'dra ba shugs drag po byung na/ gsor mi nyan/ gzhan 'bad la gso ste/ sman la la phud bdun pas gso bar bya'o/ /sug smel btsod dang la la phud/ /na sa puṣṭha ge sar dang / /pi pi ling dang bca' sga rnam sa/ /zhib btags la ra drug 'gyur sbyar/ /zhes pa sa gso/ lcags gong gyong bo zhun gyis btul/ tshes pa ni/ rkang la ga zha 'khums su song ba yin te/ skabs 'dir gzhan dbang la so gas pa cod bcad de/ gzhan dbang gi rlung gis/ /rkubs dang mkhal mar za khu dang / /sur ya la sosas pa skyed de/ /bcos pa'i thabs ni /khong sman aru bcu ba sbyar bar bya/ a ru ra/ brag zhun/ shus pa tsher ma can/ se 'bru dang ni/ sug smel/ li ga dur/ byi tang ka dang / dzā ti/ 'bri ta sa 'dzin/ pi pi ling rnams/ ka ra bzhi 'gyur sbyar ba'i glo rtsa la khrag gtar/ bdud rtsi lnga'i lums bya/ rjes snum gyis byugs/ mdo 'asags yangs dog mgron la dris/ zhes pa ni/ thur sel gyi gnas su nyes pa gsum po 'khrugs nas rtsa chu la gegs byas na 'jam rtsi'i cho sa byas te/de la nad bzhi so so'i kha 'dzin btang / bshang ba zad pa'i nad byung na/ra lug nang grol zan dron dang / sbyar dug la sha 0nyis btsos byin/bshang ba 'phel ba 'khru bas gso/ zhes pa cha shas 'khrugs pa'i/ rlung nyer brgyad gso ba la/ mgo bo'i rlung drug bshad zin/ ma jings pa rengs pa la/ nam mthong 'gugs pa gnyis la/ yer ma/ rus phyes/ pi pi ling / gsu ma gyi tsha ltos byas la dugs bya/ ltag rtsa dang chu rgyus rnams dugs kyis 'dul/ rjes la rtsa khrus bya/ bad kun lnga la / gnas ni grang rnying gzhogs byed sogs/ gcong chen gzhogs phye mjings pa yon gzhung 84

nas bshad pa bzhin/ sngon la 'jam rtsi bya/ rjes la rtsa khrus bya/ de nas gnas khang nye bar sbyar te/ thur ma bya/ cho ga lag len spyi dang mthun/rma'i bad ka nagasodami rung / a pa na thur sel gyi/ rlung rmi gyen du song ba yin/ khyab byed dang 'dres na/ 'o gas su song ba yin te/ a pa ta zhes bya'o/ /de la sngar gyi 'jam rtsi dang / rtsa khrus gso bar byas nas/ nu ma'i 'go thur du rgyu ba'i rlung gsang phug sgog skya dang a 0 ru brgyad pa sbyar ba'i sman mar bya/ a ga ru dang / dzā ti/ snying zho tha cu tsang ༈ spos das/ra/ ru rta/ a ru ra/ nā ga ge sar/ ka ra sum 'gyur sbyar ro/ /des nges par 'tsho'o/ /bad bzhi bad kun/ rkyen mkhris pas byas te bad lan dang / tshil dang / rlung rnams zil gyis mnan te/ stobs chen du gyur nas rlung dus nang du zhusas nas/ gang bar byas te/ rkang ba 'desas mi nus par/ lce bem bem por 'dug nyid pa skyur/ me nyi gang gis kyang dros mi nus/ 'di la pha bol brla rengs 74'dod/ la la phyug ngo 'i rlung rmi nga zer/ 'di yi gso ba ni sngon la bad kun ji dgos la/gzhung las chu bo rma tsho 'dra rgya ma tsho sogs/ /chu rgyun zlog pa yun ring brgal/ /de yis bad kun tshi nas gso/ /zhes pas/ de la zas za ba'i sngon 'a ‘mar khu 'jam po hub gsum re tsam sbyin/ phyis des ma na chod snum gyis/'jam rtsi 'a na grangs mang bo bar ma chod par bya/ me drod nyams na bca' sga 'u su'i thang gis gso/ de nas dkyi ba'i dugs bya ste/ mar dang rgyam tsha dud pa sasum sbyar nas dugs bya/ de'i steng du mejas ring bo phyi shel/nang ras/ bar du phye mar dus phye/ g.yer ma/ tshwa rnams blugs la ran par dkris te/ thog mar rdo me la bsros pas dugs bya/ zas rul song dang tsha skyur srungs sran ma'i phye yang spang / ce spyang mgo bcos pa'i thabs la/ dang bo yin par shes pa dang / ma nu bzhi ba'i thang gtong 85

byin long khrag gtar de nas da lis/ 'om bu/ mtshe/ mkhan pa spa ma bdud rtsi lnga'i lums bya/ skabs sungal bso la/ lug pags rlon pa dang sbang ma'i lums gzhug khong sman ba 'a da kyi lce/ ba le ga stong ri zil can bzhi'i thang gtong / zas bcos gong dang 'dra/ sran ma'i thong bo rje ngar dang / brla'i bar du tshigs bar gyi rlung zhugs pa yin te/pus mo grang bar yong / de la bul chu dron mo dzra mar bsros pa ste 'og tu bzod la/ bul chu dron mo'i rgyun log yun ring du bya/ pus mo'i sna le mig gnyis la me bya/ chud khu bdug sazhug tu phye mar slog pa ya ra gal bskus la rgya cher byas te/ mtshan mo dkris nas nyin mo bkrol bsachog mkhris pa khrag dang bcas pa'i rlung / /rkang ba gnyis su tsha byed cing / /khyad par du ni 'gro tshe tsha/ /zhes pa la khong sman thing mngar gtong / /rkang ba la chu bsil rgyun blugs/ /nyi ma phyi ma snum gyis byug pa byas la tse nyi la bsro/ /yang phyi de chu grang gi rgyun blugs de dang 'dra/ /res mos lan gsum tsam bya/ /cha shas kyi nang nas gso ba 'di sla/ /gang cu rkang ba rtse 'gyur zhing / /bem bem po ni 'dug pa dang / /bad gan rlung 'khrugs las gyur pa/ /rkang ba rtse bar de bshad do/ /zhes pa la/ rkang ba chu dron 'jam pas bkrus la/ nas ngan gyi zan g.yos la rme ra rnying bcug nas/ long mo man chod snum zhing dugs byas pas phan/ skam po'i sha dang ri dwags kyi sha byin mar rnying til mar zhungs dkar las byung ba'i mar rnying blud pas phan/ bad kun mkhris pa 'dres pa las/ /tha mar mkhris pa sbyang bar bya/ /khrag dang 'dresal dreg nad kyi/ /gso ba ji skad bshad par bya/ dugs bsku sha 'u 'o ma mar snum bcas / /ya 'dres sel bar byed/ /ces pa ni/ ji sha rtse gzugs 'khums kha me la —sogs pa gsum ni ming tha dad smos kyang / gso thabs snga ma gsum las tha mi dad do/ /'u sa kyi rlung chen ngo gzhog phyed skam pa ni/ gcog g.yon pa 86

du bya/ ces pa 'ang de min gso ba log na rlung 'khrugs 'gro pho ba'i rlung bu rigs 'ong / mnyam gnas kyi rlung gis mkhris pa 'ju byed kyi me sbar nas/spu rilas song ba ste/ gso ba gong du bshad zin to/ /'dres pa'i nad ri tham sa cad la/ /bcud rkya lag len cho la bzhin/ /sgog skya bsten na rab tu phan/ /ces bshad pas/ khrag mkhris byi nad ma yin pa/ rlung nad dam bad gan dang 'dres pa la/ bcud snum dang sbyar ba'i sgo ga skya'i sman mar bya/rlung thams cad la me'i sbyor ba 'jus ra lug nang khrol zan dron dang sbyar dug la sha gnyis btsos byin/ zhes pa la / go stod 'dzim pa gnyis po/dpung ba 'ja' la snas sman dang / zas kyi rjes pa la snum sbyin phan/ khrag gong lag ngar na ba la/ thang chung kham phor ra yi sna sman phan/ thal la gzhon nu'i 'o ma dang / mar gyi nying khu byas nas ni /sna sman byas gyur rlung nad sel / /brla rengs pa la 'jam rtsi dang ཿ /zas byi sngon du snum sbyin ske phan/ /rlung nad gsob mdor bsdu sa 'di/ (slo ba ma rtag tu dga' phyir glusbyor/ / dge bas byang chub myur thob shos / phyag sman ma las pa rin rgyal gyis/ /thubs kyi bdud rtsi mgul gyis bum par blangs/ /ljags kyi steng nas bdud rtsi chu rgyun gsu ngas / /thugs kyi nying khu bdag la tshim par ga nang / zab/ yi thi/ maṅga /
kyi ni/ klad pa 'dzag pa bcad do/ /rtsa chad pa mthud/ chag pa 'grilas / pa srongs/ rgya nag dkar bo mi na gyi da pa tshethi/

pa'i se 'bru brgyad/ se 'bru bzhag nas da lis bsnan pa yis / da lis sbyor ba dag tu shes par bya/ da lis thog ltar nad thog 'gro bar bshad/ga pur gur gum sbyang rtsi sbyo ra ba dag ru shes par bya/ grang rlung nad rnam sa sel ba'i se 'bru da lis kyis/ lha yi dbang bos lha min bcom pa ltar/ ga pur gur gum da lis kyis/ tsha grang gnyis kyi nad sel the tshom med/bdud rtsi gzer bu sman gyi 'khor lo bsta na pa yin/ rgya gar mkhas pa dzi na mi tras phyi rabs kyi don du bkod/ phyag sma na mkhas pas nyams su blangs pa yin/ dpyad bzhung gzhan la ma ltos pa'i khyad chos yin/ kun la ma spel nyams su long / kun gyis shes na ma las pa su yis byed/ maṅga / bha wartu/ shu snyam/95
