na kor ling gnas pa'o/ /ma bdud rgyal mo'i byang chu de/ /mna' dang gtad dang thab sogs kyis/ /ma bdud stong nas khros pa'am/ /slob dpon dmu la thab gtong bas/ /nyin 'thibs mtshan ni yer ba dang / /chu ni go ba'i chu ltar rul/ /rtsa ni res mtho res dma' byed/ /kha zas mngar la sred pa byed/ /de lta bu yi nad pa la/ /'bad pa byas kyang don med pas/ /tshe med de dag dge la sbyar/ /gzhan yang dpyad kyis mi phan pa/ /kha snar thor bu byung ba dang / /kha gdong ma mchu thung ba dang / /dpyad la ko long bsdoms pa dang / /sman la gzi ri sna stong byed/ /de 'dra'i nad pa spong bar bya/ / so ba zas kyi phanasaganod lta /pho nya mchin pa 'i grag la brtag / rnag chags gyur na sgom 'khrugs dang / /tshad pa myur du smin pa dang / /rnag chags chu dang 'dres pa dang / /khu tshis bye dang chos 'dra dang / /grang kyang 'chags su mi 'dod na/ /don la brag ni rgyas pa yin/ /gtar ba'i man ngas bstan pa ra bya /chu ru 'dug na gsor mi btub/ /ser nag 'dug na 0so ba dka'/ /ska la rnag khrag byung na 'tsho/ /ljang gu gcin dang 'dres pa dang / /lhu ba ser bo byung ba ni/ /ma zhu ba yi mig ser dang / /snod mkhris kha nas lud pa yin/ / rang bzhin khrag ni nag pa la/ /gzhan na chu ru 'go ba de/ /zungs khrag rul ba'i chu yin te/ /'di yang gso ba dka' bar bshad/ /dmar cing myur masas 'od dang bcas/ /yun ring ba'ag na chu ru 'gro/ /'di mi gso ba sla bar bshad/ /rten 'brel rgyud la brtags pa ni/ / ser bo khrus kyi rang mdog gluyin/ /sgo nga nang gi spyis dra dang / /ljin dang be snabs thon tshad ston/ /dmar bro tshos khu 'dra ba dang / /smug po skya shal 'dra na 'chi/ /dalar bo lhab lhob mang na 'tsho/ /zug med dbugs chen byung na 'tsho/ /ljab rdzib shin tu mang na 'tsho/ /'di rnams sngon 'gro'i cho ga'o/ dngos bzhi sman gyi lo rgyus ni/ /tsha chu grang chur bsgyur ba la/ / gsus ma ra 'bebs pa'i sbyor ba glu 99

dang / /chu rlung 'byed pa'i sbyor ba dang / /chu bo lam du gzhug pa dang / /rgya mtsho gnas su skem pa dang / /rtsa sbub dri yobasal ba dang / re thag sna nas btul ba dang / /phyi nas mi bzlog mna' bsgag rnams/ /legs par bshad kyi nyan par gyis/ /tsha chu grang chur bsgyur ba na/ /am lha'i (skyu ru ra )thang gis cung zad dbye/ /rme chin pa'i ngan khrag phyir dbyung bya/ /rtse chung gnyis kyi shed smad bya/ /rtsa kha sbyangs phyir glo rtsa satar/ /'om bu'i bar shun a ru ra/ /sle tres khu bas rngul yang 'don/ /gsus mthar 'bebs pa'i sbyor ba la/ /ga pur hong len gi wang gsum/ /bar mar sbyar la khung du gtong / /'di yis don gnyis 'grub par byed/ /gser gyi me tog e ran ta/ /thar nu dur byin gur gum rnams snum ldan bsil ba'i thang sbyor bya/ /'di yis gsus glumakhar 'jig par 'gyur/ /rtsa khrus gtong bar mi bya'o/ /bshal chung chu yi g.yab sor 'gyur/ /chu rlung 'byed pa'i sadam sa pa la /stong sgong zhi ba'i me btsa' bya/ /'o ma khrus thug gar bo yi/ /snum rdor ldan pa'i skyo tsha sbyin/ /khrus dang bsku mnye byug pa bya/ / cung zad bltas par gyur pa dang / /phyi dro sbo —'grogs yod med blta/ /yod na sbang rmi bsros pas bdug / bca' sga dbang lag thang yang gtong / /de nas yun tsam ngal bso la/ /chu bo lam du 'jug pa la/ /sbyangs la rnam sa pa lnga yod de/ /rin chen rgod kyi 'phrul sbyongs dang / /byi khung debang bo'i 'phrul sbyangs dang / /sa pur bsil gyi sbyang rgyus dang / / drag po 'dus pa'i spyi bshal dang / /rmi na ngag zhun gyi skem khrus rnams/ /gzhung nas gsungs pa mang yod kyang / /dgos pa yid la 'grub pa dka'/ /'jog po'i gtsug gi nor bu 'dra/ /de ni malas pa'i thugs kyi bcud/ /shin tu tsasang ba'i man ngag 'di/ /sasal bar bdag gis bshad par bya/ /drag po 'dus pa'i spyi bshal la/ /thar nu dur byin bzang bo drug /sdig pa srin bu tshe ke ru/ /rgya tsha sug smel sbal rgyab dang / /darkar bo chig thub 100

bcu gsum gtong / thun tshad bla ma'i zhal las dris/ /grang du mi sazhug gtam mi smra/ /zug gzer byung na chu bshal bdus / skyugs na stod la chu grang bldeg /byad la phus btab rdo grang bdug /ma zug bar du tsos pur 'dug / de nas 'tsho chu lcag mda' (mo da na rko chu rul ba )gtong / /dang bo sun na phyi nas gnod/ /bar dpyad kyi ngal bso na/ /phyi de nangs par dbyung bar dka'/ /ji ltar 'bab ka zhen gyur spang / /chu la srog ni brten pa 'i phyir/ /chu ni ma zad 'chi mi 'gyur/ /nad zad rjes la sgrim pa dathos/ ces bya ste/ /nad zad pa ji bzhin du rlung skye bas/ snga dro khrus zug man thug pa sla mo la 'o ma btab la gtong / /dgong ka sha gsar tsho khu sbyin/ /sgos chu byin/mar nas gam til mar lhu ba med pa 'i bsku mnye bya/ /skabs su sga'i lde gu yang byin/ gsus pa 'phring la zhag bcu drug nas 'dzad/ dpyad lan gsum bya/na le sham ni rdog po re gang ka hril mid byed du bcug me yi drod ni 'tsho shes na de ni sman pa mkhas pa yin/ skabs su tsher ma'i lde gu byin/ nge nas yud tsam ngal bso la/ zlog mi zlog gi tshod kyang dpas mi bzlog nyams mi bltas pa dang / dgong gi dus su smems sman ni/ khem bu bzang bo re re satong / gzhug tu mchin pa na gyur na/ rtsi'u lnga ba'i mnge thung dang / se 'bru bcu yi sbyor ba rnams/ skabs su gtong ba shes par bya/mchin pa'i rtsa la me btsa' brdeb de yi mchin rgyas zhi bar 'gyur/ nge yis chu bo la ma du byug rgya mtsho gnas su skems pa la/ /rin po che'i rgod rsām sa dang / /lhum gyi thal skems chen mo dang / /dar ya kun gyi rtsi sbyor dang / /thal skem rtsi dang sbyar ba dang / /dan da'i thal ba kun tu rgyug /gzhung 'di 'di ltar bshad pa yin mod kyang / /rin po che yi rgod skems ni/ /skabs su smos pa ma gtogs pa/ /dmu rdzing nad la mi 'jus ste/ /mi 'jug nyes pa bskyed phyir ro/ /mchin pa'i zags ni bsdoms pa la/ /dar ya gan gyi 101

rtsi sbyor phan/ /de yi sbyor thabs 'dzi lta ste/ /sman gyi rgyal bo dar ya gan/ /dom dang nya yi mkhris pa dang / /li khri dang ni rnam pa bzhi/ /chang la btab pa dwangs snyigs dbye/ /tho rangasadus su hub re byin/ /yang cig sman gyi sbyor ba ni/ /khong sman gser mdog phyin pa'i bcud/ /4yi bcud ni ser bro rko dang / /rwa ni gcig tu skyesapa dang / /skye 'gro yongs kyi mdog sasal dang / /se da ris dang sgrug sgrug bsres/ /me nyams chen po'i sbyor ba'am/ /yu la ka yi thal bar sbyar/ /thal skem rtsi dang ji ra ba ste/ /dmu dzing rgya mtsho lta bu matso skoms/ /kum gyi thal skems chen mo ste/ /mtshal sbyangs legs par 'byongs pa dang / /bya mo nag mo'i sgo nga dang / /dom mkhris dang ni a shwa ka /brag zhun dang ni stag shug pa/ /rgya skyegs khu ba'i rta la bskyon/ /nam langs dus gagrong khyer gtong / /dan da'i thal ba thun re bsre/ /nang na mchin pa ma zag pa'i rtags/ /phyi yi mthar bzhi g.yo ba yin/ /de ni 'di das gzhug bsdus nas/ /nor rgyasabadud rtsi thal sbyor zer/ /phyi dang nang cu dpu rdzing stems/ /dan da'i thal ba kun tu byugs/ /thams cad 'di yis 'grub par 'gyur/ /de ni bi ji mkhas pa'i zhal nasabyung / /de yi sbyo ra ba bstan par bya/ /shing kun mu zi gla rtsi sogs/ (rgya shug thal ba sbyar zos na/ /dmu rdzing rgya mtsho lta bu skems/ /ba dang rta dang phag dang gsum/ /khyi yi thod pa skam po dang / /dur dus thod pa skom po rnams/ /grong khyer tha ma rnying ba yi/ /gog por song ba me la (g.yag rgod kyi rgyu sha )bsregs/ /dud pa chad pa'i dkar lha ga pa/ /sgron shing thal ba spen sol dang / /tsha ba gsu ma dang byi tang ka /'bras bu gsum dang rtsi tra ka / se 'bru 'ing tsha su ga smel dang / /de rnams thams cad zhib par btags/ /ka ra dkar bo thun gcig ma nyam/ /chang gis phul ba tho rangs gtong / /zhag ni bdun phyag sacig dang ni/ /zho gnyis dang ni sung phyed ba'i/ /man dang bar ma chen po yin/ /spyor ba rtso rim bzhin du 102

byar ni rung ngo / /dgos pa'i sa ru zas nor btang / /'di yang sman pa'i 'dod pa min/ /shes na nor dang srog 'chor bas/ /'chi bdas spyod pa bzlog pa nas/ /rang srog skam par thon 'dod na/ /nad pa gtang phod snying rus bskyed/ /sman pa ngang rgyud bsrings la chos/ /nyen med bde legs thob par 'gyur/ /skya rbab la ni rigs dgu ste/ /nad gzhi so sor 'dres pa dang / /gnad dang dus las byung ba dgu'o/ /de la gso ru rung mi rung / /khyad par brtag pa'i rim pa la/ /dang ga bde zhing la zas len/ /mdangs dasar chu sngo rtsa yang dal/ /dbugs la spangs kyis chog ma log / de ltar 'dug na gso bar bya/ /de las log pa gang zhig 'di/ /skyes pa dang bo rkang nas skrang / /bud med mgo nagaskrang na 'chi/ /pho mo rkang dang mgo skrang 'chi/ /bkug shugs drags na 'chi ba yin/ /de la sogs pa spang bar bya/ /gso ru rung ba'i nad pa la/ /se 'bru bzhi'am drug pa brgyad/ /rta ni bu ram smug po bya/ /chang gis phul na bdud rtsi 'dra/ /smad du babs na lo nga rtsa gtar/ /stod du babs na ru thung gtar/ /ma nu kuṇḍa lo ri dang / /sle tres sga skya bzhi yi thang / /bad kun 'dres pa skya rbab 'joms/ de nas sbyar bar bya ba la/ /thar nu dur gyid dan da sogs/ /de steng byis pa khron bu dang / /dar rmi la ni nu ha 'o/ /can po la ni sug smel dang / /gser gyi me tog gtong bar bya/ /kun la dzā ti gur gum dang / /de nas mtsho chu dang ni chu'i lcag mda' 0tong / /stobs chung nad mi des 'tsho byed/ /gal te stobs chen gso dka' na/ /sa bzang bshad pa'i lde gu bya/ /'bras bu gsum dang rtsi tra la / byi tang ka dang ga pur dang / /snyan lcags dang ni phye ma dang / /'o ma chu dang zang rtsi lag gcis bskol ba yi/lde gu chu ma chod pa dang / skya rbab can la srog ster byed/ /skya rngab can la lcags phye dang / /de nas khrus kyi sbyangs ba ni/ /dzur byin dan da byi tang ka 104

gser gyi me tog dong sa dang / /gur gum dzā ti sug smel dang / /spos dkar thal ka so ma ra/ /mar gyis sbrus la ril bu bya/ /tho rangs nam nu ngas dus na gartong sne /chu tshan mar bcug lcag gis brab/ /dros chen dus na thug pa ske skegatong / /lto ba sra la mi 'ju na/ /snum dang dugs dag byas na ni/ /'ag bcu lon nas gtong bar bya/ /kha tshar sman rnams mnyam pa la/ /gtso bo'i sman rnams bskyed la gtong / /rjes ni 'bras dang tsho khus bcad/ /de rjes bcud kyi sbyor ba byed/ /snga dro se 'bru'i sbyor ba bya/ /phyi dro bcud kyi sbyo ra ba gtong / /me drod gso phyir ltag pa spra da/ /de yi bcud kyi sbyor ba ni/ /chu ser sma na brgyad rtsa ba lnga/ /thal ka so ma ra spos dkar/ /zi ra da ra bo go snyo da dang / /seng ldeng spod dang bil rkang brgyad/ /des kyang skya bob skem dka' na/ /lca ba shug pa'i khaṇḍa yis/ /skya rbab 'or nad ma lus skom/ /shug pa'i bar shun mang du bsosas/ /btsod dang lhan cig bskol nas ni/ /ba chu bre brgyad blus la bskol/ /khaṇḍa spyi dang 'dra bar bya/ /lca ba shug pa'i laṇḍa yis/ /dmu rdzing 'or nad ma lus skem/ /zil chags gzhung las ba'ad pa yin/ /phyi nas me yis sbyo ra ba tsam /pho bar lhen gsang bar ba dang / /bco brgyad smad kyi 'or gas nga dang / stod kyi tshigs pa bzhi lnga dang / / spra ba lnga lnga sa bsregs par byed /'di yis gso ba rdzogs par bstan/ /shin tu bcos dala' bzlog pa na/ /'o lon sbyor ba 'di yis ma nan/ /sgos skya li shi tshod dron gtong /dro bar nyal 'a gnyid khug bya/ /shin tu sbyangs dka' lto sra na/ khu lhang g.yab kyi btab pa 0ces/ /ba chu'am 'bri mar gang 'byor la / / bsko la grang byor mo sasum gsum satong / /de yi rjes spyod 'bras bu gsum /ba yis zhun ma ra dag la sbyar/ /dgong phyogs zos la lto 'jam nyal /tshad mi rta byang ma'i rta rtos tsam/ /thun lnga gsum 0nyis bar du gtong / /dmu rdzing saso ba mardor bsdus 'di/ /bi ji mkhas pa'i bzhung lugs dang / klu yi bu mo'i 'bru bshad 105

dang / /nor rgyas bu'i snyan rgyud dang / /dan da ka 4zhus lan rnams/ /gcig tu dril ba'i man thog 'di/ /phyag sman sprang bo rin rgyal gyis/ /slob ma rtag tu dga' phyir sbyar/ /de las byung ba'i dge ba yis/ /dmu dzing rgya mtsho skems par shog / sbyong byed gso byed rjes spyod log gnon no/ /thar byed rma go mjug bsgrigs pa 'di/ /nyi 'od 'bar ba'i rgyud/ 'chi bdag rtsod pa bzlog pa'i rgyud/ zil chags skor gsum/ dmu 'or gyi rgyud gang zab nas btus pa/ phyag sman sprang bos btus pa rdzogs so/ /106

rtsom pa'i 'chug srung / mdog 'gyur nas gcod pa'i sbyor ba bya/ tshad pa che na ga pur ram dkar nag tig ta/ bsil gsum gyis tshad pa'i me bsad/ chung na kyi rtse dkar bo tig ta hong len ma khris pa'i me bsad/tshad pa che na gur gum/ brag zhun/ gi wang / tsan dan/ brag rkang gis zags bsdus/ tsha ba chung na/ gur gun / ba 9 ga spa nga rtsi dwa bos zags bsdoms/ ldum bu bsdus pa'i khu ba la mkhris pa sna tshosas btab pa'i khu ba gtong bas rtsa kha phye ba bsdom sa/ tsha ba chung na dmar bo gsum gyi bsdus thang gtong bas bsdoms/ a ba skol ba'i khu ba la/ mtshal mdakar dang / tsan dan dkar bo/ thog rus/ thog lcagasagatong bas rgyu ma'i rtsi rul srungs/ tsha ba chung na sa nyag mo dang / bdud rtsi rta ni ba yi khu ba ni rab/ med na bdud rtsi re dang sbyar nasabatangs na rgyu ma'i rul srung /zas kyi gzhi 'dzin/ tsha ba che na dmar bor 'khru ba la/ rgya skyegs khu ba la/mtshal skyer ba sbyar/ de 'khru ba bsgyur/ tsha ba chung ling ser dang ljang na mtshal chu 'dam bu ka ra/ dpa' bo ser bos 'khru mdog bsgyur/ de nas nad tshabs che zhing zungs zad na/ dur byid/ thar nu hong len dong gra sbyar/ tsha ba chung zhing zungs ngan na/ a ru ra gser mdog gi me rtog khron bus sbyang / gso byed gnyis kyi zas kyi gzhi bzung / tshad pa 'khru ba'i dus su / skyer ba/ a ba/ bong nga dkar bo rnams kyis khaṇḍa 'debs par dpyad/ yang kyi lce dkar bo/ brag zhun/ mgo dus bsdus pa'i khaṇḍa gtong / da trig ka bed mon cha ra/ sga skya pi pi ling mon mo dang / chur skol ba lto ru gtong / sprang gi khaṇḍa 'khru ba chu 'dra'i rgyun bcad do/ /bdud rtsi sa myag ram bu dang / ba chu dang sbyar nas a ba'i me rtog bsdus pa'i ku ba'am/ rgya skyegs khu ba la gtong na 'khru ba chad/ shed mi 'chor/ rgyu ma mi 'grul / tshad pa sel lo /bdud rtsi dam pa'o/ /sman gyis gcod pa ni/111

dom mkhris/ kuṇḍa rka ri/ gur gum kha tshar btab gtong bas/ a ba'i bsil des tshad pa chog cing rgyu ma'i rul srung / rlon pas rgyu ma mi zam ska bas zasakyi gzhi 'dzin/ sra bas rgyu ma mi chad/ dpyad kyi rdzas yin pas/lus zungs 'byed la rlung 'dzin/ sha chen gyis rlung kha mnan no/ /tig tas mthus pa'i me bsad do/ /gur gum gyis mkhris pa'i la rlangs 'bri/ dom mkhris kuṇḍa ka ris rtsa kha bsdoms/ de rnams rgan po dang nus pa chung ba la bya'o/ /dar ma lus zungs ldan pa la/ gong gi steng du a ru ra rma chu bsnyung /bron bu/ lhum rtsa/ dur byid kyis cung zad sbyangs/ des nad 'byin dang sa bde'o/ /lus zungs zhan pa dang / rgan rtson la khron bu dang / a ru ra bag tsam gyis nyams gso/ nges bde nas 'khru ba ma chod na lug gi klad pa btsos pa la/ gtsod khrag gtong bas chad do/ /des ma chod na tsha ba sasum bskol la sgog skya kha tshar btab pas chad/ de rnam sa ni rigs su phye ste/sgos kyi bcos pa bstan pa'o/ /shri badzra gyis ba da pa'i gnas dang sbya ra te/glum zer gyi dud khu lus phyi la bab pa yin te/ a ru ra/ lcags phye/ rta ser lta bu'o/ /mar la rtsam pas 'khru/ rme chin mkhris pho mchin na ba gcig 'ong ṣka/ tig tas mkhris pa'i me bsal/ gur gum gyis me bsal/mkhris pa dang dmar bo gsu ma thang stor gyi rtsa kha kun bsdoms / dang bo mtshal lta ra 'khru na/ rme tshal gyi kha bsgyur satong bar bya'o/ /dud kur 'dus na/ mchin ma khris kyi nad yin pas/ gur gum/ brag zhun/ tig ta gtong / dom mkhris gser gyi me tog khrag rkang / dhar ma ra dha'o gsu ma/ spyir mchin mkhris kyi tshad pa thur du zad pa yin/ rgyu bzer gyis mchin pa 'i nyes pa ni/ mkhris pa la ma bsdom na/ zungs khras thon nas 'chi nyen che/ rlung gis skyug pa/ byung na/ sman zas mi 'ju ste nyes pa che/smod kyi nad ro thur du ma sbyang na/ tshad pa bying mi thon te nyes lnge che/ rgyu 113

na/ / thog mar sbrid cing martso rkang rnams/ / theb kha re tsam sozhing na/ /mjug tu mgo dang ya na lag babs/ /bya ni 'gyel mang sha sngo skam/ /don snying rnams la byas par nges/ byang ba sha 'gul rtsa 'byugs skrang / khrag skyug sna khras rma nga du 'byung / mjus tu rtsa la gram pa'am/ sngo sbyor rlung skye snying la ni/ /ldang dub byed cing snying la bab/ /sru sbyor srin ba'in 'byus cing na/ /gzhug tu rgyu rma ra babs pa de/ /gsus pa khrag gis gang bas 'chi/ /rdo sbyo ra mgo na dang ga 'gags / / bad kun skyed 'gyur pho bar babs/ /rin chen mchil ma kha g.ya' dro/ /mtshan ma mi 'khrong rmi khal mar babs / /ngo ti bzung ba mi na yin te/ /de'i rtags dpa' bo bsdus pa gtong / /skyugs na nges par yin zhes gsungs/ /krim bzhag 'dra ba'i tshod ma la/ /nya phag dor btab 'thung ba na/ /nges pa ra yin zhes dbyug 'dod/ /bya thabs bla rmi 'i zhal 'a dris/ /yang na sman rnams len na yang / /'gyur ba med ces rme khas rnams sasu ngas/ /mdor na sha 'gros nad sna mang / /stobs 'chor dran pa mi gsal zhing / /ldang dub che na yin par 'dod/ /nyam sa su myo nga bas man ngag ——yin/ /de rnams ma tshan nyid bstan pa'o/ /saso ba'i thabs la rnam gsum ste/ /bsdu dang bsad rjes sacod rim pa'o/ /dang bo bsdu ba'i rim pa ni/ /snying la bab la bslong la bcos /gsar dang rgyas la slong mi dgos/ /slong na nya phag thud ru'i dang / /sanod pa 'i zas dang yang na ni/ /cig thub zhungs dkar dbang bo lag /rno mig gis btsal zhib par brtags/ /chu yis sbrus pa'i ril bu ni/ /nangs re sra na chung tsam pa re/ /'ju stobs sbyar gtong slang zhing 'dud/ / bar shun gsum dang khyung gshog dang / /gser 'od gsonamakhrag sbyar gtong na/ /sha rus rtsa dang don snod kyi/ /nad kun 'dus par the tshom med/ /lus rtasas pho ba lci nyes na/ /dang ga mi bde 'ju stobs chung / /rtags de ldan na gsad dang sbyangs/ / sang 'tshams sbyor ba'i rig nga sa ske 116

shes /de nas gso ba'i rim pa la/ /spyi dang bye brag gnyis yin te/ (spyi la zhi sbyangs gnyis su 'dod /zhi byed la gnyisathang dang phye ma shis/ /thang ni rgyal blon dam pa sbyor te/ /bsdu gsad spyi rjes bcad pa gsum/ /'di yis 'grub 'gyur the tshom med/ /rgyal drug 'om bu bag la dbang / /spang rtsi dwa bo pu rtse shel/ /lhum bu re ral par pa ta/ /blon po nyungs dkar spang rgyan dkar/ /se la son du skyer bar shun/ /se god tha ram gang ga chung / /dmangs ri sang la babs gyur kyang / /ma de thung gtong ba shes par bya/ /ga'an yang gtso bo gsum bzhi dang / /lnga'am drug dang rgyal blon dang / /sang 'tshogs bltas te man ngag ltos /thun tshad rgyal bo su ma nyis la/ /kha tshar rnams ni sum cha re/ /satong thabs grang thang bsdus thang dang / /'bri ta la sogs nad lams sbyar/ (thun ni gnyis gsum bzhi la sogs/ /tshad pa'i tshad sbyar nyung ngu bsring / /gyong ba sbangs thabs zhe la phog / 'di ni dug sel bdud rtsi 'dra/ /rtsa dang don snod nad rnams kun/ /bsdu sa shing 'joms pa ra the tshom med/ / sha rus pags pa'i nad rnams ni/ /phyir 'byin rngul dang ba spur 'don/ /dang ga 'byed cing tsha ba chog / sdud cing brtag pa 'di nyid yin/ 'on kyang dug 'don nus pa skyed/ /lus zungs gso dang sman len rtags/ /bla ma mkhas pa'i zhal la dris/ /phye ma sa bsad pa 'i spyo ra ba la / sdud dang bsad dang phyi rjes gcod/ / thams cad 'di yis byed par ma glu 'gyur/ /gtso 'khor gnyis la gtso bo mi/ /nad kun khong sdu da gtso bro di rkodang / /dug sel 'du ba 'joms pa dang / /dug 'joms tshad chog satso ngo dang / /rnarma rgyal dpa 'a bro dkar ser dmar/ / shi la dza du gser shing dku dang ༈ /sa chog zang dmar gser 'od bu/ /yig gang ma dang kur nu ma/ /gi wang ka ra ra sa ya na/ /be skyes mu la bca' sga ste /snying dang se 'bru mkhris pa rnams/ /zhib btags 'phrig tshug tshangs pa la yo da re kun/ malas pa'i 117

'bras bu thang chu dang / /mu zi ba chu rang cu gcin/ /sbyar gtong byugs pas sel bar byed/ /'brum bu byung na gtsod bu byus / de yis nges par 'tsho bar byed/ /rlung las gyur pa'i thang gtong zhing / /thang dang bdud rtsi ha tshos bya/ /rngul byung rjes la kor lo ru/ /phyag sman ma las pa'i khyad chos yin/ /bu min gzhan la spel mi bya/ /khu tshur nyams kyi yig chung bya/ /nga min gzhan la yod ma yin/ /i thi/ nyams dga' skyid pa la/ dge'o/ /120

gtong / /skems byi sbyor ba gsum yin te/ /brta'i thal ba gzhung dang — mthun/ /lcam pa shug pa'i khu ba la/ /gze ma bsdus la bu ram sbyar/ /yang na sa bzang lde gu la/ /lcags phye tsi tra byi tang ka / tsha gsum kro ru tshe chang sbyar/ /chu dang 'o ma mar sbyang rtsi/ /lde gu chu ma chod par sbyar/ /'di ni tshems spyor dmapa yin/ 'jigs byed la la thos ma ru/ /se 'bru bzhi brgyad gnyis sa ma bdun/ /sang 'phrod sman gyi mi 'phrod gso/ /de ka kho nas 'tsho srid do/ /spyor ba'i sman ni 'di ltar bya/ /me skyes me tog zad snying drag / ba bcud saser dang rwa gcig skyes/ /tsha ba gsum dang tshwa sna gsum / /lcam pa sdig srin mtshal da ra dang / /byang tshwa rnams ni zhib btags la/ /rkang mar gyis ni mgo bsdus la/ /kong bur du ba ma shor bsregs / /'ju ba snga phyir thal bar gtong / / thar nu dur byid gnyis dang ma nyam/ /chang gis phul la rgyun sbyongs bya/ /skems ni 'bigs byed skabs dang 'dra/ /phyi na rtsa 'phrang me yis srungs/ /de rjes bcud kyi sbyor ba bya/ /log na me gso de rjes sbya ngas/ /phyi rjes bcud kyis bcad par bya/ /yi thi/'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gcong chen dmu chu gso ba'i thabs / /nyams myong zhal gyi bdud rtsi 'di/ /bde legs rtogs phyir yi ger bkod/ /dmu 'dzing 'byung ba'i sngon tshul ni/ /phye mar me drod nyams nas 'byung / /be snabs 'phel nas rgyun 'phrang 'gag / 'jam por 'khrulas pas thal gong na/ /rlung dang 'dres pas sbos 'grogs 'byung / /thur sel log pas dri chu bsri/ /nyin mtshan gnyis ka gnyid chung byed/ /kha cig phyi dro sbo yang srid/ /dri chu dmar ser tsha bas te/ /sngo skya cha shas yin par 'dod/ /bcos thabs tshad pa'i rtags ldan na/ /sngon la tshad pa bcag pa'i phyir/ /am nyi'i thang gis dwangs snyigasa'abyed/ /khrag si khu rtsigs byed pa nas/ /rnag thag ma chod bar bu gtar/ /ru thung smad nas rim gyis gtar/ /rtse chung 122

glo rtsa long rtsa gsum/ /re re gtar ba shin tu gces/ /pho ba'i me drod gso ba'i phyir/ /dgong ka na le sham re byin/ /skabs su rngul 'don gcig gnyis bya/ /gser gyi me tog e ran ta/ /des kyang tsha ba chog da 'a na/ /dbang bo lag pa 'o mar btab/ /de steng ga pur btab la gtong / /lus zungs mi 'dzad tsha ba chag / des tsha ba 'chag so/ /da ni tsha ba 'chag pa dang / /chu rlung 'byed pa shin tu gces/ /chu rlung 'byed pa'i sbyo ra ba 'di/ /tsha chu grang chu gnyis ka la/ /thun mong dpyad du shes par bya /da trig se 'bru chu sbyar sbyin/ /rkang ba gnyis la bsku mnye bya/ /ba 'bri'i mar gsar phu lu dong / /go pur gsum mam hong len bdun/ / btab pa'i sman mar chu rlung 'byed/ /pus gong 'khyid gang rtsa chen gtar/ / spe drod nyams pa'i gsang sa glu glu snebasregs/ /tshigs pa brgyad dang bcu bzhi bsregs/ /dgong rka phyi dro sbo ba 'jig /shin tu chu rlung 'byed dka' na/ :rtsabs sar 'ba' lo'i dwangs ma la/ /star bu chu khur bsings pa de/ /'thung nas dgung nas skyes bu 'thon/ (chu rlung 'byed pa'i gdam sa pa ste/ :sman pa rmams la gas nga ba yin/ /de nas sbyongs kyi sbyor ba la/ /thar nu khron bu spa ra gang / /hong len bzhi cha snum rtsa phyed/ /ba tsha can gyi chu la sbyar/ /3 gas kyi smod du zhag gsum bzhag /dal bu'i me la dkrus cing bskol/ /rma ra dang bu ram zho gcig bsre/ /steng dros chu ma chod par sbyar /de la khre tshar btab pa'i sman/ /dur byin zho sacig na phra bdun/ /rgya tsha rgyam tsha mdze tsha gsum/ /mtshal dkar dbyi mong pi pi ling / /su ga snel da byin kham pa gsum / /sra na rma bzhi bzhi tshad du bya/ /srin shas che na ka ra sbyar/ de rngams lde gu sman pa dang /rin chen dngul chu co gang dang / /mu zi bzhi nam ba chu phyed/ /de rnams gong si lde gu dang ཿ /stan pa bsres pa 'i khud du ma nye/ /ril bu sha ril tsam du bya/ /nang re ril bu re re gtong /mi skyugs pa yi sbyor ba bya/ /sbyo ngas lnga dril ba'i las len yin/ /123

skyesas kha ba'i rta la bskyon/ /nam langs dus su khyor re satong / /ma chin khrag gnas su skematsha pa yin/ /dpu rdzing 'or nad gso ba la / /tsha chu bcos pas mi thub ste /grang chu nges par 'tsho ba yin/ /tsha chu grang chu bsgyur la bcos/ /sngon la grang chu byung ba dang / /phyi nas 'chos lugs gcig pas chog tsha rung grang rung gnyis ka la ( /nad dang chu rlung phyed dus sbyar phyi chu nang du 'dus 'dus sbyar/ /rtsi chu nang du bsdu thabs la/ /de yi sbyor ba 'di ltar bya/ /krim shas chag chog bca' ba'i tshod ma la/ /g.yer ma btab pa sa mi na cigs 'byed/ /chang 'jam mdze tshas bsrings pa des / /phyi chu nang du 'du bar byed/ spang rtsi lcam pa thur 'go gang / yer ma gnyis 'gyur gze ma phyed/ /sdig srin bzhi cha tshad du bya/ /byang ba bshog pa dasar bton bdun/ /zhib btags dar dmar khud du bsdum/ /chang la sbang la khong du gtong / /rtse gur zhal gyi rtsa khrus dbyung / /ma hā ki ci'i 'ol gdams yin /'ji yis phyi chu nang du 'dus / /des na rin chen rta la bskyon/ /spyir yang dmu rdzing nad 'di la / /bcin sri nad dang 'dres ma yin/ / des na chu lam sbyang ba'i phyir/ /rgya tsha ru rta ñtsa ma pa gsum/ /thang du byas te rtse gur tsotong / /ta cang drags na tsha ba skyed/ /zho kha chu dang sbyar rmi nga 'is dmu rdzing nyams kyi yig chung yin/ /phyag sman rin rgyal bdas gis sbyar/ /i thi/ dge'o/ /125

'jam mnyen btsal ba dang / /dmag dpon lta bur 'khor gyis bskor ba dang drug so/ /de la ga pur su ma nyis/ cu gang sum cha sangs chus sbyar satong / /de sna mi rtsod lta bu gcig bzhur yin/ tshad pa stobs chen rgyas pa thog babs gsod/ /ga pur cu gang gur gurma rgyal blon gsum pa bong dkar/ tig ta ru rta mtshon char bskur/ 'khrusas rims rgyas pa gsod par byed/ 'di ni dpa' bo lta bu'i mtshon cha yin/ /rgyal bo lta bur tshogs su 'don pa ni/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga'i sbyor ba'o/ /yang na ga pur tsan dan dkar/ /cu gang gur gum li ga dur/ /dom mkhris tig ta pu rtse shel/ /rgya skyegs sbya ra bas 'grams rko 'khrugs nad/ /stod gzer tsha ba rgyas pa yi/ /lud pa du khu dmar ser glu 'joms/ /'di ni rgyal bo lta bur tshogs su brton pa yin/ /skyel mi dgra zin sgrim pa ni/ /ga pur cu gang la ra dang / /chang byor re dang thun re sbyar/ nad stobs thun tshad sbyor ba gces/ /'di ni stong tshad kun gyi gnyen po yin/ /btsun mo lta bur 'jam mnyen btsal ba ni /gla rtsi dom mkhris hong len dang / /bsil gsu ma gser rma dos thar nu ma gi ta/ /rgyal bo btsun mo brgyad yin te/ /sbyor ba gong du bsdebs gyur kyang / /btsun mo'i nus pa 'chor mi srid/ /nad ni rims 'khrugs la sogs pa/ /'di brgyad bsdebs pas gang yang rung / /rgyas tshad stobs ldan ma gtogs pa/ /tshad pa kun la bya 'ded byed/ /khyad par gab cing rims 'khrugs sel/ /de rnam sa mkhas pa'i glu gdams ngag yin /dmag dpon 'khor gyis bskor ba ni/ /ga pur thun che dmag dpon tsam/ /de la bzang bo drug dang tsan dan dalar dmar dang / a ga ru dang chu tpal tig ta dang / /gla rtsi li dur dang bcu bzhi bro 'tha / /dmag dpon lta bur 'khor gyis bskor ba yin/ /rin chen zhabs pa ches bya de yis /dmag gi tshul ltar nad kun 'joms/ /khyad par don snod dran nyams dang / /tsha bas 'bogs lkugs dran nyams ma lus 'joms bye brag 131

gsungasapa su yis gsungs/ bar du mdzad pa su yis mdzad/ tha mam dgos don ci la sbyar/ phan pa'i yon tan du ru gsungs/ gnod pa'i nyes dmigs du ru bshad/ kyai/ tshangs pa skye dgu'i bdag po la /'phrul gyi rgyal bos zhus pas/ tshangs pa dang / tha skar gyi bu sanyis kyis gsu ngas pa drag po dbang gi rgyal bo nyid sa chu me rlung la dbang byed pa khyod nyon cig grong khyer lta na sdug de yi byang phyogs na/ ri bo gangs can zhes bya ba/rang bzhin bsil bas de'i phyir/ zla ba'i stobs dang ldan pa 'i ri la/ ro kha bska/ nus pa bsil rtul skam pa yod nga sa/ khyad par glo snying bi ske —'khrugs tshad sel ba'i sman tsan dan/ ro kha bska rig pa gsum yod pas/ ga pur rigs ni rnam pa gsum du 'byung / nas pa bsil yang rtsub rgyas tshad pa thos babs su 'joms pa/ ga pur dang tsan dan 'di gnyis sdong bo dang thang chu zhes sanyis su 'dod la/ ga pur la rigs gsum dang / nus pa che chung 'byung ba ni/ tsan dan la rigs gsum yod pas so/ /tsan dan sa mchos las mang / gor shi sha las ltas gzis tsan dan sbrul gyi snying bo las shel sa pu ra 'byung ba yin/ bzhi tsan dan gyi thang chu la zer ba yin/de la ga pur no zhes so/ / drang srong kha cig na re/ tsan dan gor shi shatsan dan sprul gyi snying bo 'dir med la / tsan dan sa mchos cu mi thang chu ste/ga pur la rigs gsum 'byung ba ni skye gnas kyi khyad par yin/ ri rtser skyes pa la shel ga pur/ ri thang mtshams su skyes pa la stag gzig ga pur/ thang du skyes pa la mang sa pur zer ba yin/ drang srong kha cis na re/ sdong bo'i lo ma mang / shar nub gnyis la stag gzis byang rgyags la shel 'byung ba yin zer/ drang sro nga kha cig na re dus kyi byed pa bo lo gcis lon pa shel/ lo gnyis lo na pa stag gzig 'o gsum lon pa la mang ga pur yin zer/ drang srong kha cig na re/ dgun gyi thang chu shel ga pur dbyar gyi 133

khrag shor ba'i than pa yin/ /gang zin par ni ra nan na na/ /phog dus za zi byed cing 'bubs/ /don snod zin pa 'i than pa yin/ /de ltar byung ba'i phog yu la la lta mi dmas/ de rjes bang chen rnam gsum ni/ ngom nag tshad pa skyes pa ni/ /nang du brtol ba'i bang chen yin/ /thal skyor mchin mkhris khug rme gzer /rtsa yang myur grims skom dad che/ /chu ni dmar la dri rlangs che/ /de yang khrag babs bang chen yin/ /dbusas rgod dgye dang sgur mi shes /rtsub bur la ngas na yang tshes dgos / /glo lu mi shes za zi mang / /don sno da zin pa'i bang chen yin/ /bang chen rnam gsum byung ba dang / /bya gtong rnam sasum brtol ma brtol brtag pa ni/ rtsa'i bya satong mig yin te/ lta ga mig 'byed dang 'dzum pa dka'/ /mig ma dngas nyams thing sha chu rengs/ /yan la sa bya myong sbrid cing na/ /rtsa yi bya gtong rtol ba yin/ /kha sna'i dbugs nyams sna drod thor/ /lus kyi stobs shor sta na la 'byar/ /sen mo'i bkrag shor na ba na/ /zungs kyi bya gtong rdol ba yin/ /mdor na kha dmar 'dzi ltar brtag / khrag babs chung na bcos su yod nga ra rtasas/ bya satong gsum sleb ma sleb zhag gsum lnga'i bar du brtag nge la 9na ni 'byed par — 'gyur/ /de la bya gtong ma byung na/ /rma khas pas rtsal dkrugs thub paralanges/ /lnga la bya gtong byung ba na/ bcos su chad par la dmar gdag /rtsa chen chad pa'i khrag babs che/ /gnyen pa'i don la mtshon lam ring / /bya satong gsu ma la 'ong long med /la chen 'das par kha dmar brtag /khrag babs don la ma zin mtshon lam thung / /bya satong byung yang 'jigs nyen nyung / /nyan chung 'tsho ba kha dmar brtag man ngag zhal gyi ti kha zhes bya ba phyag gi lugs / tshogs bsas phyir yi ger babod pa rdzogs/ i thi/'gro mgon thugs rje can la 'dud/ ma na ngag zhal gyi ti la las/ /lus la zug rngu lus pa la/ /stor ba btsal dang chung ba gnyis/ /stor ba btsal 141

lta bu'i rnas de nyid/ /phyed dam sum cha phyed tsam 'byung / /spyir na glo nad bad dan yul/ /de phyir dbyar dang dgun dus bde/ /dgun dus bde ba ma yin no/ /de dag bcos thabs go rim bzhin/ /rlung glo thang bo bsil bcud bsten/ /rma ngar gsum lde gu kun tu bsngags/ /des ma zhi na 'bras bu sasum / /ba mdzo'i mar gsar sngar gsum ldan/ /bdud rtsi lta bur bsngags pa yin/ /gso dka' ba la rlung gsang bsro / /skya rbab dag byang de 'tsho — srid/ /ma phan skya rbab bcos thabs ltos/ /tsha subayodag 'a tsan dan glu bcud/ /tsha ba chung na tsan dan brgyad/ /yang na a krong brgyad pa bsngags/ba ra mdzo zho mar gsar dang / /ri dwags ba sha sol bu bsten/ /tsha gzer de 'dra satar ga bzang / /des ma phan na bshal gyis sbyangs/ /chu yi 'phrul 'khor dag kyang bsngags/ /nyi shu lnga'i phye ma yang / /'di la bdud rtsi lta bur bsnga sas/ /glo ni bad dan yul yin pas/ /thes pa bad dzin sbubs su dku zhugs / /des na glo nad 'di mang phyir/ /rme khas pas 'dzi lta ra shes par —gyis/ /thog mar bad kun rgyam tsha dang / /de phyir ri sho spyang tsher ba /dur byid zhad tsam rus ku la /rgyam tsha kha tshar pi slang btab/ /de yis pho ba'i bad kun sbyangs/ /de 'og glo sbub sbyang ba'i phyir/ /star bu spang rtsi do bo —sbyangs/ /lde gus bad gan 'byar bag 'don/ /des ma thon na yang cig sbyar/ /rjes la mu la lnga ba'am /cu gang lde gu khyad par bsngags/ /pi pi ling gi lde gu yin/ /'di la rab tu bsnga gas so zer/ /kha zas ba glang ri dwags sha /mar sasar sbrang rtsi ldan pa dang / /dar gsar spod chang bzang bo yis/ /'di la rlung sga grosas ldan nam/ /glo nad gzhan yang rlung ldan na/ /ba 'o dron mo khyor re gtong / /dgong dang tho rangs 'thung gyur na/ /mchog yin dag gis myong bas grub/ /glo gcong glo mig gcong bral bas/ /de 'dul phyir ni thog ma ru/ /a krong god kyi gcin lums sam/ /yang na rme khan pa a krong rgod/ /148

bul to0chur sbyar rlon pa ru/ /gcin nam chu rgyun yun ring blugs/ /yang na chu tshan phyi thun bzhag / de nas pan rtsa'i sbyor ba bya/ /glo skyu gas 'dren zhing gcong de drangs/ /tshud pa sngo skya skam la 'drem/ /gcong thabs mang du byung na 'tsho/ /ma thon lums dang 'dren sbyong bya/ /skabs su gcong 'dren du markosbyar/ /ka ra ba 'o dron mo yi/ /ra 'u ga rtsa zan zho 'thung gi/ /glo ba ma sum brgyang satong na/ /glo gcong gso ba'i mchos yin no/ /gro dang yos chang sro los bsing / /ba 'o dron mo btung bas phan/ /gla ba dang ni dgo ba'i sha /ma sungs gsar ba mchog tu bsngags/ /glo rgyas tsha 'khrusas lta bu la / /rtse chung drug rma go nang du gtar/ /lud pa dmar tshag khrag tu 'u / /sro lo rgya skyes/sa 'bri sog btsod/ /bsdus te grang ba yang yang gtong / /tsan dan dasar dmar ba sha ka / cu gang gur gum utpal skyu ru ra /cha mnyam ka ra drug 'gyur sbyar /dmar gsum thang gis phul la satong / /rjes la gtar ba shin tu gces/ nyi shu rtsa lnga'i sbyor ba yang / /man ngag lta bur sbyar bas phan/ /chu yi 'phrul 'khor bsngasas pa yin/ /de ltar byas kyang stobs chung na/ /smug po glo mig rgyas srid pas/ /smug po'i rgya bshal bsngags pa yin/ /ji srid khrag tu rdol srid na/ /gur gum dom ma khris sang ga chung / /me tog rgya skyegs khu ba dang /bar sha ba ṇi lnga sbyor ram/ /rma bya'i ma dngas ras sbyar ba mchog 'di la gtar zhing chu 'dren bya/ /zas skam phyogs tsam bsil bar bya/ /ldang nyal lus kyi drag shul dang / /skad drasas 'bod dang dri ma btsir/ /me dang nyi ma spang bar bya/ /glo rnag bum tshang 'dra ba la/ /zhung na ska ma pas skem pa ltar/ /ma nga na dang bo sbyangs bya zhing / /rjes la gso ba gces pa yin/ /zhung na skom sa kyi sbyor ba ni/ /a krong bcu ba'i 'dren skoms dang / /yang na zangs thal mu ji'i thal/ / sha ru spen ma'i thal ba dang / / a krong chang ngam sro lo dkar /sum gyur ka ra bzhi 'gyur sbya ra/ /rnag skoms glo mang gso ba yin/ /149

yang na wa dang srin bya'i klad/ /mu zi zangs kyi thal ba dang / /cu gang spang rgyan sro lo dkar/ /star bu ka ra sbyang rtsi sbyar/ /rnag skoms glo gso'i gdams pa yin/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga'i man ngag ldan/ /rnag skom sa tsha ba 'jomasapa'i snyemachog /de ltar gang 'phrod mkhas pa sa sbyar/ /rnag bungs che la sbyar ba'i thabs/ /star bu palca'i spyor ba dang / /pho rog mig gi sbyor ba dang / /byang rtog rgya skyegs snyigs mas mnan/ /man ngag lta bur sbyar byas na/ /glo sgrubs rnag kun 'dren par byed/ /lu sa stobs chung larnag bungs che /nor bulalugs su sbyar dathos na/ /'jam 'dren rig pa'i lcags kyu ltos/ /'di yis rlung mkhris bad kun nam/ /rnag sogs glo ba'i nad kun sel/ /glo nad kun la bsngagasapa yin/ /'on te rnag khrag 'dres pa na/ /shu mo za yi min mar mchog cu sang a krong a ru ra/ /ka ra skad rgyal 'o mar sbyar/ /re 'u rtsa zan zho 'thung gi/ /glo ba ma sungs rgyas btang na/ /glo gso khrag tu lu la phan/ /wa yi glo ba a ru ra/ /cu gang dom mkhris shing mngar rnams/ /gye ma rta rkyang 'o mar sbyar/ /ka ra sprang rtsis kha bsgyur te/ /'o dron tsam la mnan pa'i zhos/ /glo gso rnag khrag 'jom sa la phan/ /khrag bcas lud pa sbyar mi glu rung / /des na gnyen po de dag sbyar/ /khrag med rnams la sbyang ba mchog /de yisarnag yul thon srid na/ /gang dri sbal sgong lta bur 'byung / /song gi glo gso'i sbyor ba bya/ /khrag tu byung na gong bzhin bcad/ /de ltar ma byung rnag mi chod/ /mu zi zangs kyi phal ba dang / /sro lo sa ram pi pi ling / /spen ma sha ru bsregs pa'i thal/ /wa dang srin bya'i klad pa dang / /spang rgyan la ra dkar bo rnams / /sbrang sbyar lde gu tho rangs gtong /nyi shu rtsa lnga'i phye ma ni/ /dgong dus gtong la ltag pa sprad/ /des ni 'thoms par nges par yin/ /khacig rlung dang ldan srid na/ /so so'i sman mar ltag pa sprad/ /glo mang mig 'grib gang la yang / /cu gang shing mngar a ru ra/ /ka ra ba 'o'i dus su dbul/ / 150

pa gtong / mar mi gtong / skran zhar nas rang khrus byung na bzhar la bshal gtong / bshal rjes la bcud gtong / rang khrus ma byung na khrus gtong dathos/ khrus 'ong dus/ skran shubs 'ong ngam lta/ byung na legs log mi yang / nyams yan/ srog la yan/ thur sod swā hwa/ oṃ āḥ/sngags la zug byung na/ brgya rtsa bzlas la chang la btab la gtong / sman gyi steng du tsha sna 'dug tshad gur gum thun sacig se 'bru rnams gtong / rdo la sngags sum brgya btab bro/ /yi thi/ rdo sog ril ljag darkar nag gnyis/ cong zhi kha ru tsha rnams zhib par btags la thal bar gtong / chang la sngags 'di btab pas phul la — gtong / /ya so gcod pa'i sta re/ /ma so gcod pa 'i zor ba/ lce la sgo —lca gas/ yid pa byang chub kyi rgyun lam nas pho ros sha byer du khyer/spyang mo lug khyer du khyer/ sman nyung bar sartong / yang skyug yang na khrus yo nga / mu stegasakyi gdams ngag lugs so/ /yi thi/ ———bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skran bcos pa 'i ma na ngag la /dang bo sngon du brtas pa sal che/ 'tsho na spus blangs la bcos 'chimartags yong ba ni/ mis dang sen mo ser na 'chi/ de min gang 'dug dang 'tsho/ skran la rnam pa mang yang / tsha skra na grang skran sanyis su 'dus/ de la tsha skran dros na na ru 'ong / grang skran grang na na ba'o/ tsha skran bsil gyis bcos/ grang skran drod kyis bcos la/ bsil gyis bcos pa la / sro lo shu dag dkar bo/ sgru ba dkar bo/ yung ba/ rdo nga ros/ sayer ma/de'i steng du rdo la btul na 0tong / sbang ma bsros pa'i dugs bya/ tsha skran gyi ji gas ni 'di yin/ oṃ spar la khas shig suca/ oṃ par kha khas shig sruhwa nyi shu rtsa gcig re btab/ grang ba drod kyis bcos pa la/ rgya tsha shing tsha kha ru tsha/ pi pi ling / rgyam tsha/ de'i steng du rdo thal gtong ngo / /tshwa rngos 154

pas dugs bya/ grang skran gyi sngasas ni 'di yin/ oṃ bas ta/ u skon rdu shig snyahwa/ zhes sngags mang du btab bo/ /tsha skran grang skra na gang yin yang rdo ba btul ma mang ba gal che'o/ /pho ba sbo na sman 'di rnams sbyar/ cong zhi tsha la bsresas thal sga skya mdze tsha ya bakṣa ra pi pi ling / na le sham da lis dang brag zhun gang rung / gnyis po gang rung / bzhan rnams bur dkar sbya ra bas bad gan srin nad skran nad sel/ mchog tu ma zhu ba sngo ba thams cad sel/ tha ji mkhas pa'i khyad chos yin/ yang skran sngags la/ oṃ kri min/ tri na ga rbad/ nā sa shan tri/ tri la thud/ rag dur le tag rbad suhā/ zhal bzang gi gter ma'o /skran bcos zab mo i thi/glang shu ba la/ lum bu'i khu ba 'a byang bul btab pa shugs pas phan/ya nga na bong dkar dri chu la sbyar bas phan/ ol pho/ mi rus / bu mo stag lo ma'i nying krad sasum bsregs thal mar kha tsha ba la sbyar nas gtong bas ma zhu ba thams cad la pha na / bad chu la/ a ru ra/ ru rta/ brag zhun gsu ma sbyar ba byusas nas dar dmar bkab pas phan gre ba'i 'bud sman la/ mtshur nag mu zi ser bo rgya tsha shu dag sga skya dwa rtsod pa me tog gsum pa rnams thun nyams sbyar 'bud do/ /byung na gong du snyan sbyang satong ba man ngag yin/ bi ji mkhas pa 'i nyams len yi thi/na mo gu ru/ srung ba me gal ma'i rdzas la/ til dkar nag gnyis/mu zi dkar nag sanyis/ shu dag dkar nag gnyis/ gu gul dkar nag gnyis / shing kun/ rta bon/ rwa gzhon gsum/ gla rtsi rnams phye ma ra sbyar la/ snga dro bya ṣā ta'i skad ma byung gi gong du mi ma nga rung zhung med kyang rung ste me gal la rdzas thun re blugs nas/ mgo bo phur nas dud pa sa bdug pas nad rims gdon rigs kun la phan zhing bsrung ba'i mchog yin/khyad par nad rigs tham sa cad thub pa yi/ phyag sman cher rje rang cu khyad 155

chos yin yi thi/sngags 'di blo la yod pa rang gis chog yo dam sbyo/ yas bhyo/'bras gzer sto/ 'bum gzer sto/ snying gzer sto/ lhog gzer sto/rgyu gzer spyo/ ma ra ya kha the suhwa/ gzhan srung byed na snga gas phreng gcig bya/gla ba shu dag gnyis rta zhi grin dang gshin rje gshed du bsgoms/ rang sbyan ras gzigs su bsgoms/ rab gnas lo rang dang rten 'brel snying bos bya/nad bzhi brgya rtsa ba'i dang khyad par du gzer thub bo/ phyag sman lugs zab i thi/rgyu gzer bsrung sngags ni/ rang nyid phag mor bsgoms/ oṃ dkar tram sod/ dmar tram sod/ nur tram sod/ e tri tsa tso/ lcags kyi pho morgyu ma'i nad srungs/ shig surwa/ rang srung tho rangs mang du bgrang ngo / /gzhan srung la snod sas chags med par chu gyen du bcus la mang nyung gang byung rung de la sngags sum brgya re btab la/ nam mkha' mi mthong bar byas la/ras sngon pos bcad do/ /khyem bu gsum re tho rangs byin pas nad kun thub bro/ /rin rgyal rang gi gser gyis atsa ra nas bslus pa yin/ gcig brgyud kho na'o/ /phyag min malas pa'i khyad chos yi thi/ man /156

ba ku tso pa ku cig khram khram rtsig swāhā/ brgya rtsa re bzlas la btung / nam langs dus su dom mkhris chang la sbyar la btung / 'thung rting brla logs lan gsum 'dre/ nyi shar dus su gur gum sran ma'i me tog ri mar gyi khu ba sbyar la gtong ngo / /dngul chu bzhig pa ni/ srin lag dngul gyi rdo rjer bsgom sa/ sngags 'dzi nyer gcis bzlas nas btab pas nges par 'jig go/ /oṃ sarba sid dhi/ ras yo gi ni/ pha la sid ti hūṃ/ thun tshad ni/mi gcig la dngul chu sran ma gcig su zi sran ma gnyis/ gla ba dri 'byin/gu gul sran ma phyed dang gnyis/ a ru ra sra na ma gcig chang phul gang gzhi thog gcig sbyar la satong / sman phyi ma gur gum srid rtse gcig sran ma'i me tog lnga/ rme ra khu hub gang yin/ mgo ba'i nad rigs gang la yang lo gcig khyud skor thub pa yin/ zab rgya rgya rgya/ yi thi/yi dam phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lag len dmar srid la/ spyi chings brgyad de/ ri bo ming nas 'gyel ma 'gyel brtag pa dang gcigadon po btson du thor ma shor/ mkhar gyi gzhi mtha' nas nyams ma nyams/ljon shing lo 'dab nyams ma nyams / nyi zla gza' skar gyi 'od 'khrugs ma 'khrugs brtag pa dang lnga'o/ /de nas ri bo rming nas 'gyel ba ni thang la rdo bor ba ltar khrud song nas gnad sa de 'phral du nyen che/ de la srid pa 'i zur bzhis btegs pa ni/ gtsug lag srid pa'i bu bzhin bsgrub/ gso ba nyan rgyal tsam/ don po btson du shor ba ni/ shes pa g.yel lam/smyo'am 'bog pa ste/ tshe srog glud kyis bsrus te/ di la spyir sde brgyad mdos sam/ rgyal bo'i bcos ka la 'bad/ 'du ba rlung shas che ba/mkhar bzhi rma tha' nas nyam sa pa ni/ gzhan btub par yod kyang / yan lag 'a rengs sa ma/ gya nyes su so nga ba yin te/ 'og 0don bcos sman gyis byugs pa bya/ dugs la 'bad do/ /ljon shing lo 'dage nyams pa 163

ni/ sasang ba'i mdzod du legs pa ste/ byad du rngul sum pa dang / ba spu log pa dang / mdog log pa dang / 'byung bar bshad do/ /de la skye shing gis 'byung ba gdams pa ni/ spu sogs dang / sardon yas kyis bcos/nyi zla gza' skar gyi 'od 'khrusas na sde brgyad gnad spro ba ni/ mig la brtag pa ste/ mig gi steng nas mar thig le dasar ser dmar gsum byung na/btsan bdud rgyal bo dang gsum shas che/ nag skug sngon po byung na/ dmu dang ma mo shas che/ 'og gdon shas che/ de bzhin 'og ma la yang brtagaphal cher steng nas 'ong ba yin/ 'og nas byung na kha rngal steng lci/ pho mo dang lci yang steng 'og dang / kha dog ma brtag cig dmar khra chem song na sde brgyad kun bcogaso/ /spong du bstan pa'i rtags la bya'o/ /spyir nor sa 'ga' yang yod do/ /mig sprin dkar la rtsa ris dmar nag kha dog mi gsal ba ltar byung na rlung skos che bas mdze pho dang nor sa yod mig sprin dmar bo byung na/ khrag yin/ mnyam na ma yin/ rlung shas che'o/ /lar khrag can ni brtag dka'o/ /rkun ma phugs su bcug pa 'dra zer bas/ kho bo'i rtags nyung yang / sde brgyad la kho'i ma khyab pa med pas / gong ltar bcos so/ /spyir gzhung la zhib tu blta ba dang / bcos pa nyams myong gtso che ba yin/ gzhung dang nyams myong bsdur ba'i sadams pa/ snying dang 'dra ba'i bu min gzhan la sbyin mi bya/ 'du ba tsha grang brtag pa gal che gsungs so/ /'di ni brtas pa'i man ngag yin/ bcos thabs logs su gsal/ gza' 'phar ba gong rgyug brtsi shes dgos so / /brtag pa khyad par can yi thi/ shu bham/164

su bcug go/ /skar chen shar ba dang / khyem bu bzhi bzhi gtong ngo / /de zhu zhu dro bar byas la/ de rjes zas bcos ni/ lug gi 'o ma bskol la rgyun du gtong ngo / /med na mdzo mo 'bri'i 'o ma la bya'o/ /de bzhin med na ba'i 'o ma la bya'o/ /rkang lag grang ba'i lha gas pa mi gtong / drag shul dang rngul ba'i las mi bya/ dpyad gzhung chen mo 'dis bud med brgya la spyad kyang khu ba zad par mi 'gyur ro/ /tshe nyi zla dang / stobs glang bo che dang 'dra/ rtsal seng ge dang 'dra ba 'byung ba yin pas/ da byin dkyil 'bor chen ngo 'i lag len zab phyag sman mkhas pa'i khyad chos/ dpyad gzhung gzhan la med pa'i khyad chos yin pas zab/ spyir da gyid la sbyor thabs rnam pa gsum yod de /de tres sam du sbyar ba/ sman ma ra du sbyor ba/ mdag thabs su spyo ra ba dang gsum las/ phan yon gis dka' ba/ rtsal che ba/ chu ser dang grang ba sel lo/ /da byin 'dul thabs ni/ grod pa'i long khar bstum la mar gyis brtsas la chos pa dang skam la/ da gyid dang drod sman tshad mnyam pa ra —bsogasal/ bu ram drug 'gyur dang sbyar la/ de tres sam gyi sbyor ba zhes bya ste/ skar chen shar ba dang chang bzang bos phul la gtong ngo / /bud med dang ngal dub spang bar bya'o/ / kha zas drod la brten mal dro sar nyal/yang sman mar du sbyor na/ 'o ma bre gang chu bre phyed/ 'bras bu gsum gyi khu ba phul gang du bsdus pa'i chu skyed la/ snod bzang bor blugs la gtong /'di mi sman mar ro/ /sbyor ba'i rgyal bo mchog yin no/ /gtong thabs rjes srung ba gong bzhin no/ /yang khyad par du drag po byed cing sa bon 'phel bar byed na/ sems can sna tshogs rnams dang / khyad par phag lug ra thug 'bras bu dang / ka lan dha da'i sha dang / skye sgye'i lo ma phong bzhin pho cong /rsha zi per sor/ khur ma zin brtag la grangs tshad mnyam par bya/ rjes srung song dang mthun/ yang mdag thabs ni phye ma de rnams thun re re 167

dkar ma'i 'o ma btab/ med na dmar mo 'i 'o mas bya'o/ /kha tshar gyi sman thun tshad ni bkrol ba'i gseb tu sbrang rtsi khem bu gang/ shing rma ngar che chung co gnyis/ bu ram mang ba btab/ ka ra nyung ba bya/ kha tshar gyi mar mang nyung gi tshad sran ma gnyis byi bungs rigs par bya/ gtso bo'i sha mi chas pa nus pa med pa 'i mi la mon sran spar gang / sman kyi tshogs drug gam lnga gtong / drug 'go yin nam nus pa bag re yang na sha (lug gi mgo mjug yin )gang yang rung ba mthe bo che tshad tsam bzung / sha dang dus pa pags pa gtong / mchil ba'i sha bubs gcig brdungs la gtong / drag na sman ni/sga (ngabang bos nus na )chu nangs mar mang du gtong / des ma thub na/ pho mtshan zur rtsa gtar/ des thub par the tshom med do/ / yang rnam pa gcig la/ gtso bo'i rsha dang ra lug 'bras bu dang / pho mchin klad pa dang gsum / bu ram la bu byas la gtong / khyad par ro tsa'i man ngag 'di/kun la spel ba ma yin gyis/ / bka' rgya dam pos btab la gas so / /kun gyis shes na mkhas pa su yis byed/ / de phyir gces pa'i bu la sbyin/dpyad gzhung ga'an la rme ltos pa'i/ / phyag sman rme khas pa'i khyad chos gso dpyad yin/ / yon la rta re gos phyi nang re gser srang re long la bka' rgya pos thob/ nga min gzhan la yod pa min/ / yi thi/169

'ju byed kyi sman ni/ pi pi ling dang se 'bru yis/ /rin chen thang la 'ju bar byed/ / mi na gyi grogs la gser la rtag tu ngu dngul la 'brug rus/zangs la sha ru 'u sas la dbyi mong / gser dngul zangagalcags ba'i/rim bzhin mthun pa'i grogs su shes par bya/ gser la a ru ra sogs bcud len du sbyar/ dngul la mdze tsha'am / nas mtshur la sogs rdo phye'i tshul du sbyar/ lcags la tsha ba gsum ste drod kyi sde/ zangs la bzang drus bsil te phye mar sbyar/ kun la ka ra dkar bo'i rta bya'o/ /sbyor ba'i —— —le'u'o/ /rin chen saser gyi nus pa ni /tshe ring nad med 'u sa zungs 'phel/ /rin chen dngul gyi yon tan ni/ /dul gcod rnag dang chu ser skem/ /rnag dang chu ser skom sa pa sa me dang rma tshungs/ /rin chen zangs kyi yon tan ni / / tsha ba 'joms shing glo rnag skoms / /rin chen lcags kyi yon tan ni/ /ma zhu 'ju zhing bad ban 'joms/ / gzhan yang yon tan kun la brjod mi ————langs / /kun gyi sbyor ba mi shes thig ngo blugs pa yin/ /gal te (nyin mo'i skar ma /shes na zong cus btsongs/ /rgya gar mkhas pa'i phyag bzhes 'di/ /zhang sman rang ni rin rgyal sogs/ /mkhas pa rnams kyi phyag len yin/ /yi thigaso dpyad sman pa kun ni/ 'u sa ni 'dul ba (stod 'dul ba mkhan dang mtshungs dgos /ma ban dang bsdun/ ngas ni (bar gyi 'gal gcod pa ni shes rab pha rol phyin pa dang sbyar )bden tshig brjod pa med pas 'jam pa/ khu byug gi gsungs lta bu/ sem sa kyi ting nge 'dzin (sman bden tshig rtag chad kyi mtha' dang bral ba dbu rmi ra rang bstun ngagos so )'chug med/ byams pa dang snying rje'i 'gro don bsgom sa/ /'gro 'chag nyal sasum gang byed kyang / /byang chub kyi sems dang ma 'bral cig / rgya yi ma thing thog sngon po la /stong 'khrul gyi khug ma gser gyi yi se can rdzogs so/ /178

gzer ba gang sazer cha med dang / /khrag la rnag med dmar la gar/ /lud pa dud khu lhu bar bcas/ /nad rnams spyi yi phyi ltas yin/ /rgya gar drang srong dzha na rdo rjes tshigs bsdus pa'o /ma ma pyi tri su dzaḥ ngal med bzlas na( ) rtsa yin lhan gyis / shu lham/ sarba man / bha wartu/dge'o/ / 180

bsdo/ /lus dang longs spyod rang gi srog las phangs / gyu ba g.yo sgyu can la sbyin du phangs/ /zhal gdams/ yi thi/bdun drug ma lta bu la ril bu khong du satong / nyin zhag phrug gcig srungs/ dus bzang la sbyin ldan par sbyar/ bka' rgya gser zho re nges pa ra long / gcig rgyud kho na gyis/ phyas sman lugs/ i thi/ sarba mgi / dge'o/ / 183

'dres pa ji bzhin no/ nad kyi 'phel 'phro ma chad rtags yin no/ /da ni chu yi dwangs snyigs 'byed pa ni/ dngas snyigs 'byed pa'i sman la gsum yin te/ rlung shas che na 'bras bu gsu ma gyi thang / /dron mo gtong ste rngul ni 'don pa ra bya/ /mkhris shas che na tis ta par pa ta /rsā tres dron mo'i thang btang rngul 'don bya/ /bad shas che na ma nu bzhi thang gtong / /dron mo btang ste rngul ni 'don par bya/ /tsha ba lam nas ldog pa mas bya ba/ /kun gyi thun mong bas te e ma ho/ /'dzi rnam sa rim sa nad ma smin rtags dang ni/ /dwangs snyigs 'byed pa 'i man ngag dam pa'o/ /'khrugs nad ma zin tsha ba ri/ stod kyi lud pas 'tshangs pa dang / /rtsa phra dbugs mi bde ba yin /nge yi dwangs snyigs 'byed pa la/ /spang rtsi dwa bo ba sha da hong len gsum gyis gro thang gtong / /nge nas mkhagapas gtar bar bya/ /chu ltar snyogs pa 'i dwangs — snyigs 'byed pa ra byed/ /rgyas pa 'i tsha ba me ltar 'bar ba de/ /'di la rnam pa gnyis yin no/ /rims kyi tsha ba rgyas pa dang / /'khrugs kyi tsha ba rgyas pa 'o/ /rims byi tsha ba rgyas rtasas mi/ grang shum byed cing snying byin na/ /nub mo blab col byed pa ni/ /bsil 'dod dran pa nyams dus der /rims ma smin pa'i tsha ba yin/ /'khrugs kyi tsha ba rgyas rtags ri/ /rtsa grims chu ni khrag tu 'ong / /lus la dri ni 'byung ba yin /dbulas rgod gzer dus 'u da pa ser/ /glo chung 'bud de lce yang skam/ /'khrugs ma smin pa 'i rtags yin no/ lar gyi rims la sman gtso che/ /'khrusas la brtags pa 'in tu gces/ /me lce chus bsad pa 'i man ngas ni/ rims ma smin pa'i dus su ni/ phye ma dang thang bzhal shis/ 'khrugs na ma smin pa la yang / gong ltar phye ma ba'al shis/ spyir mi smin pa'i tshad pa la/ /kun la ga pur cu sang dang /gur gum gyis ri lcags mda' gtong / /tsha ba che na rtse'u chung gtar/ /chung na a so ru thung gtar/ /snod du babs na ba4la gtong ngo / /lo nga gi rtsa ya nga gtar bar 185

bya/ /mkhal ma dag la gab pa na/ /chu yi rtags su mkhas pas ba'ad/ /sman ni bsil tsub migatong ngo / /bsil gsum gi wang sdig srin dang / /rme spul rma zho sha pi pi ling /gtong ba'i sman yin byin gzhug gtar/ /mtsher la thab na se 'bru dang / /sug smel la sogs gnong ba yin/ (snod la babs na barshal gyis sbyang/ /ya nga na snod ka ru thung gtar/ /'di rnams gab pa'i tshad pa yin/ /mun ltar gtibs pa zhes bya ba/ mun pa'i mthong sgo de ltar bya/ /stong ba'i tshad pa 'di ltar bzung / /'di la snam pa gnyis yin no/ /rang bzhin gyis ni stong ba dang / /rkyen gyis stong ba gnyis yin no/ /rang ba'in gyis stong mtshan nyid ni/ /lto stong drag shul byas pa dang / /mya ngan byas dang gnyid chag dang / /mi ni na so bos pa dang / /rlung yas che ba dag la yang / /rtags ni dang bo tshad pa ste/ /spyi dang mthun te khyad par du /'u sa yang gnyid ni bya ltar yang / rtsa stong chu dmar lbu ba che/ /mis har dbusas thung zus sazer che/ /lce skam gzhung ni nas po ste/ /smra col smra la ldang dub che/ /rlung sasang mnan na reg mi bzod/ /ma da' zug mnge'u dbyung ba yi/ /'di mi rlung tshad 'thab pa yin/ /'bras bu gsum dang sro lo'i thang / / bzang drus shing tsha gi wang dang / /ka ra sbyar la gzhong bar bya/ /kha zas gsar ba tsho khu dang / /sgog skya'i chab mig gtong bar bya/ / de ltar byas pa sa legs pa ra 'gyur/ /des na drag par rma gyur na/ /tsha grang gnyis 7 lesas brtags la/ /tsha shas che na bzang drug dang / /tshad pa'i sman rnam sa mang du gtong / /gan te rlung shas che ba la/ /sre long thang ni satong bar bya/ /chang bzang nyung ngu yang yang gtong / /sbang skam kha phrus btab stong du/ /nyal nas rngul ni 'don par bya/ /gzhug tu rlung kyang byung gyur na/ /bsku ma nye bur chang gtong bar bya/ /rlung gi gas nga la me btsa' bya/ /rang bzhin gyis ni stong ba la/ mda' zug mde 'u dbyung ba yin/ /rkyen gyis stong ba 'di ltar yin/ tshad pa skyes 187

don la 'dra/ rlung dang bad dan gnyis bsdong grang ba yin/ zas sman bcud dang drod kyis bcos bya'o/ /rlung nad gcig bu rgyas la bcud kyis bcos/ bad lan gcig bu rgyas la drod kyis bcos/ rlung dang mkhris pa bsdongs pa bal nad mig ser yin/ rlung dang khrag tu bsdongs na rlung 'khrugs yin/ rlung dang chu ser bsdongs na skya bob yin/ don snying grang ba rgyas pa sbyo ba'o/ /snod la grang ba rgyas la sra na smug rlon rus la grang ba rgyas pa (rlung nad )sing sing yin/ sha la grang ba rgyas pa sha re bel po yin/rtsa la grang ba rgyas pa rgyu ba chad/ pags la grang ba rgyas pa phyi drod chung /grang ba mor rtser babs pa pho glang sosas / de la rgyas pa skran dang 'or gyi nad/ grang rlung bsrings la bcos te glang chen dpe/ bsrings nas ma bcos nad logs srog la 'chang / ma dor na rlung la bcud dang grang ba drod/ nad gnyis bsdongs na drod bsil sbrags la bcos/ rlung la dpyad du —bsregs la grang bar dugs don rgyas chal snod la thur ma bsngags/grang rlung nad ni ci dgosagar bab kyang / bcos thabs bzhi mthun rig pas bsgyur kha tsam/ mang bor dbye shes zhung bar sdud shes ni/ nad dang bcos thabs rigs pas sdeb shes na/ nad kun dus su ma sngas ma 'phyis bcos/ 'dzi ni 'phags pa'i rigs te bkur bas 'os / rgya sar mkhas pa'i thugs nyams khu tshur 'bum chung dkyus su bkod pa 'o/ /slob ma las 'phro can gcig dang 'phrad par shog khu tshur 'bum chung yang thig 'di/ rgya sar ma khas pa a tsa ra nas bzung ste/ phyag sman rin rgyal nas / ngeng sang mkhas pa phyag gi bu/ a pha sangs mgon man chad du rgyud ma chad pa 'di bdas la 'o/ / 1 91

gsol/ /shing rta gzer 'go bud 'dra'i chag grugs la/ /khrims kyi rma gar ba lta bu'i sman pa yis/ /bdud rtsi sman la byin gyis rlab tu gsol / /gza' dang khyi smyon mdze dug la sogs la/ /gsang sngags smri na dang ldan pa'i drang srong gis/ /bdud rtsi sman la byin gyis rlab tu gso la/ /rlung mkhris bad yin 'du ba'i nad rims la/ /bdud rtsi lta bur sel ba'i a tsa ras / /bdud rtsi snan la byin gyis rlab tu gso la/ nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong zhi ba dang / /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi skyob pa'i bdud rtsi 'dis/ /bdud rtsi sman la byin gyis rlab tu gso la/ /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang / /'gro ba kun gyi nad rnams myur bas la nas/ /pha mes risas bzang rang sgo a tsa ras/ /'gro kun ma gon dang nad la phan gyur nas/ /mi na rnams sbyin par 0tong ba'i bso da nams kyis/ /nad med bde bar skye 'gyur zhing / /skye rga na 'chi med pa dang / /mya ngan 'das pa thob pa ra shog/ lha rnams kyi ni bdud rtsi lta bu dang / /drang srong rnams kyi bcud len lta bur ni/ /bdud rtsi sman 'di khyed la sanas gyur cig / bdas gis smon lam ci btab 'grub 'gyur cis /sangs rgyas sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal 'o ཿ /na mo bha sa wa te/ gu ru bai ḍūrya/ pra bha rā dza ya/ ta thā ga ta ya/ arnya te/ sa mya ku bu ya/tarya thā/ 67rtse ṣa dzra/ rtse ṣa dzra/ ma hwa ste ṣa dzu/ rā dza sa mud ga te ye spya cha/ rten 'brel snying bo bzlasabarjod bya'o/ /marga /193
lcam pa sra ma spru thal ge ke rugu gul ri brong ril byi dug patshugatsher rgyamadza bye ga
— dgye meng ——
shrī ba
zlurme zlu stene cha zlurme tre ge

byi dīl dri 'a shu zur rgya tsha skyu ruphyi ba'i mthothal / dze masta can lu bu babaslang rgyamatsha ru'ithalab 'ibo(ril ma bya ma byimongs(sregapa'i tha' rus mi cig nya rus glag cu snying khrag dur byidapa gsum gyi thal
la nga thang da byi tang ba dmar leb gla rtsishingakun sgogasu phurathacho dbasgom palag se 'bru babaslang gurmelarnole ma rgyamatsha mdzitsha rbengalen

brgyad pa dang / so ma rā dza la sogs pa'i gzhung gzhan du blta bar bya'o/ /rtags ni rtsa stong myur zhes pa tsha grang gnyis te/ mchin pa zag pa la sogs pa'i rtsa chu rnams ni/ rtsa phra la myur te bgrang du mi btub stong ba ni shin tu nyam chung ba'o/ /dpe ni sos ba'i mis rgyu lta bu'o/ /sha gdong bar du zhugs pa'i chu ser ni/ rtsa dal la nyams yid dman pa'o/ /dper glang rgan gyi kha chu lta bu'o/ /gdong skra nga skad dma'/ bol spang ces rī ni/ gdong skra nga ba mkhur sha mig rma chu skrang ba/ skad dma' ba ni skad 'dzer la nyam chung smra mi shes pa'o/ /bol skrang zhes pa ni/ rkang ba'i bol dang / rje ngar gyi nang lha nga'i nang skrang ba'o/ /shin tu skam dang lus snyi ches pa ni/ skam pa ni sha zad pa lus bol spang ba dang / 'in tu skom dad lus lci ba sha mdog sngo la sogs pa'o/ /gso bar rung dang mi rung dang / /mi rung ba ni 'di lta ste/ /glo lu zungs shor zas mi len/ /chu rnams btsag ltar dmar ba dang / /yang na smus dang rlangs pa che/ /de ni mkhas pas spang bar bya/ /gcig shos blang bar bya ba yin/ /de la kha cig bur mas btsas bya ste/ /de la sos par gyur ma thag/ yu dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin/ /'jig rten das na rab tu dkon/ /de ltar 'di la mkhas pa yis / /mi na gyi gso bar bya ba yin/ /sman la gnyis te spyong dang skem/ /de la 'di ni gnyis ka yin/ /de la gnyis te sbyar thabs dang / /gtong thabs dag tu thes par bya/ / sbyar thabs grang dang tshad pa dang / /bsregs pa gsum du shes par bya/ /thog mar grang ba 'bras bu gsum/ /tsha ba 0sum dang hong len dang / /zhu mkhan shu dag ru rta dang / /shing kun ser bo rnam gnyis dang / /rgya tsha dang ni kha ru tsha/ /rgyam tsha dang mi lce myang tsha/ /shing tsha dang ni tsab ru tsha/ /zho dang mar dang bu ram dang / /'ag dang tshil bu gzhan yang gtong / /bsdom sa pas nyi shu rtsa lnga ste/ /de ni grangs tsam bstan pa yin /tshad ni dang po brgyad po la/ /zho ni gnyis lnga gtong ba dang sne /zho ni 208

gsung ngag la brten pa'o/ 'jug dus rtags ri/ 'jug dus ni lus ngal dub ches pa dang / nyin gung gnyid log pa dang / ngal dub drag po'i rjes la chu 'thung ba dang / bkres dang khrus kyi rjes la chu rlung ma thub pa la byung rsā /gzhan me dang drod stoms la sogs pa 'i chu mang bo 'thung zhing / rlan grang la nyal ba la byung / de ni phyi'i 'jug rgyu'o/ /nang gi rgyu ni zag pa bdun/ glo ba la zag pa dmu chu dang / mchin pa mtsher ba'i rma khal ma'i skran zag rgyu long zag pa/ 'dus pa phyi tshan langs pa'i dmu chu dang bdun no/ /de —rnams ni 'ju ba'i rgyu'o/ / rtas/sa ni 'og nas ston pa bzhin/ gso ba'i thabs zhes pa ni/ sman dang dpyad gnyis las/ dpyad ni thur ma yin la/grang chu lder so lta bu la / dbusas thung la sogs spang ngo / /spyir thur ma la sogs pa la gdams ngag tu mi byed/ sman gyis gso ba ni skom sbyangs gnyis kyis gso ba'o/ /mdor bsdus pa ni gzhung las man ngag tu byas pa 'o/ /nyams myong cung zad du yi ger bkod ces pa ni/ nyams myong gzhung la brten nas de la goms pa skyes pa'o/ /cung zad ni man ngag tu bkod pa/yi ge ni mi brjed pa dang phyi rabs la bzhag pa'o/ /de la mjug tu bshad pa me drod nyams pa la sogs dpag tu med pa'i rgyu rnams gzhan du blta bar — glubya'o/ /210

pa ni/ chu mdog sngar dang mi 'dra ba gur gum gyi khu ba lta bu'o/ /rtsosas pa ni ko chu lta bu gzhan yang btsod khu la so gas pa'i chu 'byung ba'o/ /rlangs pa che ba ni dri che pa'o /de ni mkhas pas spang blangs bya/ zhes pa ni/ mkhas pa gzhung shes pa dang man thog yod pa'o/ /spang ba ni 'chi ba'i phyir ro/ /cig shos blangs zhes pa ni/ cig shos ni chu dkar bro gangs chu dang ma tsho chu lta bu'o/ /blang ba ni gsor thub pa yin no/ /de la la cig ni thur mas btsasas te zhes pa ni/ 'phrul tsags 'phrul skems mi shes par thur ma bdeg par rtsom pa'i skyon no/ /de la sos par gyur pa dag ces pa / sos par gyur pa ni/chu zad na tshe mthar thug pa'o/ /chu dum wa ra zhes pa ni/ 'jig rten du u dum wa ra'i me tog mi 'byung ba'o/ /de ni dpe'o/ /de yang mu dum wa ra dkon pa bzhin thur mas btsags pa sos pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar 'di la rme khas pa ni zhes pa/ sman pa gang gis spang la 'og gis blang ba'o/ /mkhas pa ni 'phrul sbyo ngas la mkhas pa'o/ / thal sman gyi gso zhes pa ni/thal sman gyi gso bar byed pa ni dmu chu'o/ /sman la gnyis te sbyongs dngakyiskems zhes pa sbyo ngas pa'i sman dang skems pa'i sman sanyis te bye bras go/ /sbyongs zhes pa sbyongs pa mi sbyongs skom zhes pa zhi ba'o/ /de la 'di ni gnyis don tshang / 'di 'a 'u gas rnam pa gnyis na sbyangs pa 'i thabs dang gtong ba'i thabs so / gtong ba ri sman ji lta ba la/ thabs ni sman tshang bar bsags pa/ bsresas pa dang sbyangs pa'o/ /de dag ma lus pa'i don no/ /shes par bya ba ni the tshom mi za ba'i phyir ro/ /sbyor thabs tsha dang grang ba dang zhes pa ni sbyar thabs mi mchos ste grangs dang ro ma thun pa ra sbyar ba ste/zhag dang rkang dang tshil dang sbyar ba'i thabs so/ / grangs ni nyi shu rtsa lnga na :tshwa zhes sanyis la sogs bsogs pa 'o/ / bsregs pa gsum du shes par bya/zhes pa ni/ bsregs pa ni song bu'i nang du bsregs la / gsum pa ni 212

byang bog gi rnas skoms par 'dod na/ gong gi thal ba la mi na 'di rnams sbyar/ bse ru rgya ru sa dor dang / tsan dan dkar dmar zangs thal dang / star bu ga pur cu sang gur gum dang / utpal sug smrel gla sang pi pi ling / se 'bru shing tsha de rnams thal sman dang cha mnyam par byas la sprang rtsi la sbyar/ sbyor lugs btsod phul gang 'bri mog bre gang / rgya skyegs phul phyed/ chu bre gsum la sbyar te bskol/ chu bre gang du song ba dang /bzhur la ba yi mar phul gsum / sbrang rtsi bre do bskol la chu chod pa dang phogade ngad pa yal ba dang gong gi sman btab/ ril bu 'u gle gi se ra rus tsam byas la lugazungs dang sbyar la ril bu bdun bdun btong / nge dus kha zas lug sha dang chang gcon gtong / 'di yi nus pa'i khyad par gyis/ ko chu nyi mas gdungs pa bzhin / rnag gi grong khyer 'joms par byed/ /mchog tu grang rnag dag la shis/ / thal sman snon po'i sbyor ba las/ /byang khos thagamaskems kyi man ngag yi thi/thal sman smon ngo 'i sbyor bas 'or dang skya rbab bso ba'i man ngag la song gi thal sman dang se 'bru shing tsha dzā ti gur gum a ru ra tsha ba gsum la la phud shing kun ru rta cha mnyam par byas la bu ram la ril bu byas la gtong ngo /thal sman snon pos skran bcos pa ni/ se 'bru skyu ru ra tsha ba sasu ma pi pi ling mu la tsi tra rka shing tsha rgya tsha rgyam tsha kha ru tsha tsab ru tsha ze tsha dwa tsha/ dbyi mong go bo'i pho ba lcag nge rnams thal sman dang cha mnyam bu ram la ril bu byas la gtong ngo / /thal mi na rtson pos chu ser gso ba ni/ so ma rā dza thal ka rdo rje spos dkar cog la li 'i gla rtsi cu gang gur gum li shi sug smel seng ldeng di rngams thal mi na dang cha mnyam la bu ram la rta byas la gcong ngo sgyu /chu ser darkar bo gso ba dang mdze pho 0so ba yi thi/ thal sman rnon pos chu ser nag po dang 216

gsang gnyis / /glo ba bya 'dabs skran yod do/ /glo gas nga bcu gnyis shes par bya/ /mdun nas lte 'khor g.yon pa brgyad/ /nu ma'i phyogs bzhir byol ba'i 'dom gsang sanyis dang dkar nag sanyis/ snying la yang tsasang bcu gnyis dag tu shes par bya/ mdun na snying gas nga bcu gnyis / snying gi sgron me malas pa chag gi man thog go/ /mchin pa 'i gsang snying la/ bser rlung rgyas pa nor ra re/ tsha bar ngo shes na ma chin skran shin tu rnying ba la/ /skran la thal kyang nyesapa chung / /skran nad gsar ba thams cad la/ /de la thur ma mi byed rdo/ /skra na gyi nad la song na 'chi/ / mtha' bskor dag nas bcos par bya /skran pa nas blugs la tsha ba'i nad rnams kyi rtags la bab/'bras dang smug po ma bris sdom/ la/ tshad pa lo bdun ma lon gnas med dang / /drug cu brgal dang zungs ngan spa ngas/ /'chi rtags byung dang gdon gyis rlom/ /nyam sa dang mi ldan thams cad spang / /so ma zin pa'i nad rnams la/ /mkhas pas thur ma spang bar bya/ /rgyab kyi thur ma sayul 'thab yin/ /'phral rtags thub bdun gyi 'phred bcur shes par bya/ gsang thad gar 'byed/ mchin dri la yang thur gsang drug mchin pa rang lathur gsang sasum/ mdun na rtsib ma 'i go bar gsu ma/ de ltar mtsher ba la yang glugasum/ pho ba dag la dgu ru 'dod/ di yi g.ya sa g.yon 'byin rnams la gnyis su 'dod/ ther g.yas g.yon gnad ni sbrul mig dag la gnyis/ lte sna g.yas g.yon sanyis / rlung rtsa srog 'dzin dag la gnyis/ kha ba la sprul 'khril dang / zangasatshags bong med bzhi la ni po ba'i sand du shes par gyis/ pho mchin mtsher dang gsum gyi sgron cha bsam me theng bo (rin rgyal gyis )bdas gi pha phog la gas so/ /220

ba'i thig dang bzhi/ /rkang mthil ske stong nyen sna'i bar/ /rkang ba ring na brla ring ngon /ro smad bag tsam thung ba 'ong / /de ltar mnyam na tshad ldan yin/ /tshad dang mi ldan pa yi rigs/ /thig la rnam pa bzhi yin te/ /ro thig dbus kyi ma khengs pas/ /nas kyi zheng gang bstung la btab/ /pho long gnyis nimagayas g.yon gzhal/ /rgan la sha chung bstung la btab/ /gzhon la sha rgyas de bzhin bsrings/ /de gnyis tshad ni nyungs dkar 'bru/ /dkar thig gsang tshol thig yin no/ /dmar thig rtsa la 'debs pa yin/ /rtsa dang gsang du bsdoms pa yod/ /de nas rig pas dpyad la btab/ /yi thi/dmu rdzing 'phrul ('di la khu 'u nga g.yab 'debs sa bya bar yod par 'dug rtso/ )sbyongs la/ byi sgong dbang bo rgyun sbyongs dang / bsil gyi spyang rgyug dang / rin chen rgod kyi 'phrul sbyo ngas dang / drag po 'dus pa'i spyi bshal dang / man ngag gzhung gi skem 'khrus dang lnga yod/ skem la/ dur thod mi rus rta rus khyi rus phag gi thod rus/ sol ba'i me la bsregs nas zhib par btags nas khem bu re gtong la chang zhim pos phul/ ga pur rngul 'don byed/ cung zad gtong ba gal che/ rin chen zangs thal byugs/ zangs thala'adul ba'ang 'di las lhag pa med/ mu zi ser bo dang a ru ra gnyis zhib brdung byas la chang la sbyar/ kong bur bsregs pas thal bar 'gro/ dras po 'dus pa'i spyi bshal la/ de'i 'phrul sbyongs ni/ sngon 'gro zhag gcig gong du skyu ru ra'i thang gtong / de rjes dngos gzhi 'phrul sbyong las/ gtong ba'i sman ni dur byid dan kra shrī khaṇḍa a ru ra rtsa ba'i sman yin/kha bsgyur gyi mi na ni/ sdig srin rgya tsha gur sum sga tig nyi dga' de 'phrul tshags su yong ba/ rdo smug po mdung rtse/ rdo dkar bo gcig thub/ dong ga rnams grogs kyi sman yin/ de rnams zhib par btags nas nam smad khams dang bsdun nas za'o/ /des chu khrus gnyis gar yong / chu lcag mi 225

dgos rlung la gzabs/ gzhug tu bcud la nan tan bskyed/ 'phrul glusbyongs kyis 'byongs nas skom la 'bad/ de rjes chu gsang la me btsa' —btab 'phrul sbyongs nyi shu byed par bshad do/ /khu lung g.yab 'debs pa'i chu 'beb yin/ phyi chu la drag po'i spyi bshal dgos pa yin/ dngos gzhi smri na ji/ dur gyid dan khra shrī khaṇḍa dong ga thar nu khaṇḍa a ru ra dang drug la/ gur gum cu gang bi wang sdig srin rgya tsha sug smel lcam pa bdun la / cu tis pa smus po sbal rgyab/ dkar bo gcig thub chang la sbyar la gtong /skom na mi rta khyi phag rus pa sol rshal dung ltar bsregs/ de'i steng du rin po che'i thal ba zhib tu brdung ba dang ba chu la sbyar ba legs par dkrugs nas gtong ba gal che/ khu lung g.ya ba mo 'debs pa ni/ rgya tsha mdze tsha gnyis chang la sbyar nas gtong bas chu rdol yong / des spang ba zhi'o/ /gzhug tu me btab pa ni/ tshigs pa brgyad/ smad du bco brgyad pa/ bcu dgu bcu drug nang gi lhen gsang / me drod nyams gsang / rkang ba'i byin gsang long rtsa yin/ 'gro kun chu ser nad las grol bar shoga'adi na mar glo gang ba pasas pa bcos pa bstan par byed/ 'gro mchog mi lus rten bcas kyi/ /zug rngu sel mdzad de la phyas 'tshal lo/ /glo rnag can gong sogasabyed cing / lus stobs chung zhing kha zas kyis ma thon na/nyin par mang du lu/ mtshan mo phal cher mi thon na/ nangasapar kha zas zos nas cung zad bde ba yang srid/ lud pa 'khyims ro stod na/ dang sa mi bde/ gzer mig bag re 'byung / de glo rnag 'khyims pa'i rtags yin/glo bsho ba'i sman ni/ kyi lce dkar bo/ pa yag pa'i 'bras bu/ po son cha shing mngar sug smel nim pa/ dug mo nyung dang sman sna bdun po de la snga ma gnyis bungs mnyam pa dang cha re bya/ phyi ma lnga bungs mnyam ste cha byed phyed bya/ bsres nagazhib tu btags te ka ra yis kha blangs la nam langs nas 226

'jig rten 'khor ba'i ring byung tshad/ / mtho gang sor bzhi yod pa'o/ /mtheb chen gong gi pir mgo ni/ /nyungs 'bru'i tshad du yod pa'o/ /rkang ba'i mthil gyi lung rtsa ni/ /ring thung sor mo phyed dang do/ /rlung rtsa'i mngon rtogs rdzogs so/ /rting ba dag ni mdzub gang na/ /srin mo bu khyer zhes bya ba/ /song ma rtogs kyi gnad chen yod/ /di la mtshon rnams phog pa na/ /mtshal bzang 'dra ba'i khrag 'byung ngo / /khyor gang yan chad byung na 'chi/ /de bas nyung ba byung na bcos/ /rma kha mi spang phog ngos kyi 'og skrang / /mkhal ma spang na de la bcos thabs bstan/ /rgyal bo dar gyi lwa 'u gon pa 'dra/ /tshigs pagasum pa la thag pa btags pa 'dra ba yod/ /tshigs pa lnga drug pa la brtags/ /glo ba ma sgang rgyab tu brgyad/ /sgang stod posas gzer stod na nyal/ /drug pa bdun pa'i mtshams shed na/ /phan tshun mkhyud re bcan ba na/ /glo ba sgang gi yul du bstan/ /bdun pa dgu ba'i mtshams shed na/ /phun drug sor drus bcal ba na/ /ma bsham zag snar 'dod pa yin/ /bu rnams bdun du bstan pa la/ /sang chung g.yas la ltag mgo g.yon/ /lde mig snying 'dabs g.yas na ni/ /gnas par thams cad mkhyen pas gsungs/ /nu ma sanyis kyi dkyil tshad ni/ /bu gsham tshad du bstan pa yin/ /des na gyen du tshon gang dang / /phun gang bcal ba'i sa dag nas/ /sgang chung ga'am du bsta na pa yin/ /g.yon pa de ni ltag mgo'i gsham/ /de la phyi rtsa nang rtsa gnyis/ /nang rtsa bcu ru yod pa yin/ /ma la bzhi dang bu la bzhi/ /ltag mgo gnyis la re re yod/ /de la phyi rtsa nang rtsa brgyad/ /gnyis ni lce yi nang du 'gro/ /gnyis ni dpung ba'i nang du 'gro/ /re thag chen po bzhi zhes bya/ /de las gyes pa'i rtsa drug yod/ /gnyis ni phrag pa'i gang sa g.yon sanas / /mi mngon pa yi rtsa zhes bya/ /gnyis ni rme chan 'og g.yas g.yon 'gro /glo rtsa ljon shing bya ba yin/ /gnyis ni nu ma'i 232

yi/ /rin chen (phyag sman )rgyal mtshan bdag ji skyabs sumachi/ /thur ma ma lus mdor bsdus pa/ /don sno da shar ba'i man ngag la sgo spyi don rnam pa bzhi bstan te/ /dang bo nad gzhi shes pa dang gcig nad ngos bzung ba rigs shes pa dang gnyis/ /bye brag yu la shes pa dang gsum/ /gsang gi bye brag 'chad shes pyodang bzhi'o/ /'tsho 'chi kha dmar la rnam pa gsum ste/ /grang rlung span dang gsum du bshad/ /grang ba dag gi nad rnams la/ /ma khul ma grang dang chu ser grang / /chu ser nad la tsha grang gnyis/ rgyu ma grang dang gi nga ba grang /long nad grang dang 'akrogs pa dang /pho ba grang dang bad kun grang / /bad lan gsar rnying mtsher ba grang / /ma chin pa grang ba 'di rnams la/ /rlan grang thur ma mchog tu bsngags/ /rlung gi nad rnams 'di lta ste/ /mkhal ma dag la rlung zhugs dang / smad du de bzhin rlung zhusas dang /sha ྅ gas bar du rlung zhugs dang / /rlung nad tshigs la shor ba dang / /skyon gyis tshigs la shor ba dang / /mo rlung can dang pho rlung can/ /mchin dang glo snying don gyi blangs/ /mdor na don gyi rlung zhugs pa/ /pho ba'i rlung ni mthu nyams dang / /me nyams rlung bsdongs tshad pa ni/ /dang ga mi bde 'bur tshugs lta/ /shes pa mi gsal ku co 'don/ sman bshad byed dang dpe chung dang / /de yang rlung nad dang 'dra ste/ /mkhas pasaspang bar bya ba yin/ /'bebs byed nongs pa'i rlung dang ni/ /skran gyi rigs rnam sa 'di lta ste/ /mtshan nyid/sha rus skam zhing zas rnams skyugs/ /phal cher chu dang chu cer skyugs/ /glo skran dag gi mtshan nyid ni/ /glo skad phra la mtsher ba dang / /glo 'gogs dka' la sha dus skam/ /zas zos rjes la skyugs pa dang /glo ba'i skran gsang 'dzin na ni/ /'di dag glo skran mtshan nyid do/ /mchin pa dag la skran yod na/ /mdog kyang smus la mig sprin ser/ /sha skam zas zos rjes la skyugs/ /lhag par chu dang chang skyur skyugs/ /mchin pa'i skran gsang 'dzin na ni/ /'di ni 236

mchin pa'i rtags su shes/ rma tsher ba das la skran yod na/ /yal sna phyogs su yong ba ste/ /mdog kyang rma chin pa lta bur srub sha skam zas zos mi len te/ /sgrogs pa rgyun du 'ong ba yin/ 'di yang mtsher ba'i rtags su shes /pho ba dag la skran yod na/ /zas zos rjes la skyugs pa dang / /sha skam zas kyang mi len te/ /phal cher phyi nas mngon pa yin/ /mchin babs dag dang nor ra re/ /'di ya nga pho ba'i risas su shes/ /long skran dag gi mtshan nyid ni/ /de yang pho ba dag dang ma thun/ /de yang rlung dang ldan pa ste/ /pho ba rlung 'chos ldang ba ste/ /long skran yod pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ /rgyu skran dag gi rma tshan nyid ni/ /sha lus skam la zas kyang skyugs/ /mig spyin ser la lus kyang lci/ /chu sri dri ma 'gags pa ste/ /de yang phal cher gso ba dka'/ sang ba dag gi rdo 'u de/ /de yang sbyor ba gzhan du shes/ mkhal ma dag la skran yod na/ /ma smin pa la zug gzer chung / /smin na rgyu skran dag dang mtshungs/ /sha lus skam gne tsha ba che/ /lus kyang snyi ba yong ba yin/ /dri chu dag ni gong dang mthun/ /rma khal ma'i skran gyi mtshan nyid do/ /'di yan don snod skran gyi bye brag go/ da ni skran gyi rigs bstan te rtsa skran/ khrag skun/ rlung skran/chu skran rdo skran/ bad skran/ lcags dres lhan skran/ lding skran/rnag skran/ mkhris skran no/ /na lugs ni/ rme khris pa zug gzer che ba dang /dang ga mi bde skom dad che/ /mig sprin son mo ser ba dang / /tsha bshal rjes la thur mas bcos /khrag skran das kyang de dang mtshungs/ /mdor na bad rkyan sru ga po yin/ /rtsa skran kun la rtsa bshal shis/ /rlung spa na dag la thur ma shis/ /chu skran phyi sra nang ni snyi/ /bad gan lhen dang nor ra re/ /nge la sbubs thur bdes par bya/ /rdo skran dwangs ma skran yin te/ /lcags dreg ces bya'i mtshan nyid ni/ /snod kyi ngos la zho chags bzhin/ /lhan skran pho ba dag las 237

rjes srung sbyor ba bstan par bya/ /bsdus pa'i thig la rnam pa gsum/ /gnam thig drang thig zur thig gsum/ /de la gnam thig gdung chen 'dra/ /zur thig log nas skas btsugs 'dra/ /drang thig bar gyi ka ba 'dra/ /don snying rgyal bo 'dra ba la/ /mtha' nas don sgod 'khor gyis bskor/ /de yi lde mig bshad par bya/ /thang shing sanam du sgrong ba 'dra/ /ma dun du canam thigalibargyad du bshad/ /lte ba yan chad stod na bzhi/ /lte ba man chad smad na— bzhi/ /stod kyi gnam thig bzhi bo yang / /dper na rgya them brtsegs pa — 'dra/ /lte ba man chad smad na bzhi/ /dper na mang la snang ris 'dra/ /pho ba zur gsum khyu yis rtsi/ /dor rta'i 'og nas 'then pa 'dra/ /mchin pa mchin pa'i zur thig gnyis/ /spra yi re thag 'then pa 'dra/ /rgyab nas zur thig lnga yo da pa/ /thang shing gnam du sgrong ba 'dra/ /rgyab la gnam thig du ru glu di bshad/ /tshigs pa dang bo'i gnam thig ni/ /tshigs pa'i gdung chen bres pa 'dra/ /bcu yi man chad smad na lnga/ /dper na sgo leb brtsegs pa 'dra/ /mchin pa mchin dri zur thig gnyis / /spra yi re thag 'tshen pa 'dra/ /smad na thig lnga yod pa la/ /dang bo mthal ma gnyis pa long / /gsum pa rgyu stod rgyu smad gsang / /lnga ba sgang ba'i gsang du bstan/ /de ni gnam thig btab lugs yin/ /bar du thur ma'i brdeg thabs ni/ /grang rlung skran rnams 'joms pa la/ /brdeg lugs rnam pa lnga ngo da de/ /rta 'gasas mdung tshugs 'phreng bcu dang / /rgya ram skor dang lhur 'byin no/ /don snod phal cher mdung btsugs so/ /pho gsang dang bo rta 'gags yin /mar khug yang ni de dang 'dra/ /pho 'gram zur gsang 'phred bcu'o/ /pho gas nga dbus ma rgya ram skor/ /gsang chen brgyad la lhur 'byin no/ /skran ni shin tu 'dril ba la/ /dbus su rgyab la mtha' mas bskor/ /skran ni shin tu leb pa la/ /mtha' bskor dbus su 2 0

grang lhu nga ni/ /lu sa kyi stod nas btegs pa'i nyes pa yin/ grang lhung bad gan dang bsdongs pa yin/ pho ba'i 'khru skyugs ni/ /kha zagam mnyam pa dang / bu chung cu kha thos mi 'phrod pa zas drags pasam zhu ba ste/ bad gan 'phel ba yin/ 'khru ba ma zhu ba rkyang ba yin/ skyugs pa ṅge mkhris pa dang bsdongs pa yin/ lte srin dang lte 'khor ni/ ma chags bu la lhung ba yin/ yang na ngus drags pas/ lte ba'i tsaspubs su rlung zhugs pa yin/lte srin ma'i chags/ lte 'khor rlung zhugs pa yin di nas nad ngos ji ltar bzung ba ni/ sna 'gags la dbugs rgod/ skom dad che/ stod bsdoms shing drod che/ dri chu dmar/ kha zas mi za/ glo chung rmi nga yang du lu ba ni/ grang nad yin par shes par bya'o/ /rgod g.yung zer kyang / 'di ni rigs gcig la/ nad babs che chung yin no/ /mchin nad ni gang yin yang sman pa lag len goms pas bltas pas/ mchin dri ring du babs te ngos 'dzin sla'o/ /de latsha lhung ni/ mig cung zad ser zhing mdangs smugaglo mang bo res lu/ drod che/ dri chu dmar/ mkhun bu bag re yong / rna ba'i rgyab rtsa sngo zhar gyis yong / grang lhung ni/ mig dpangs dma'/nag cing gyen du mi thegs/ sna sgo sen mos 'thogs/ lusamadog ser ram skya la sob/ drod dang zug gzer mi che ba ni grang lhung ngo / /'khru'am skyugs pa gang rung lte srin pho ba'i nad yin te/ 'khru ba ma zhu ba/ skyugs pa mkhris pa bag re 'dres pa'o/ /lte ba skrang ba'i gzer ram zug gzer che ba ni/ lte srin yin no/ /lte ba nas rnag 'dzag pa ni lte 'khor ro/ /da saso thabs ston te/ de la grang nad bcos pa'i thabs ni/ grang nad du shes na sro lo/ gur gum shing dmar/ li ga dur dang bzhi'i thang gtong / yang na skyu ru ra/ /btsod gur gum ba le rkya bzhi'i thang gtong / rjes la glo ba ma bu'i steng du me btsa'am zug dmigs dang bsnan la byed/ mdor na glo rtsa glu ske 258

'gramasapa'i bcos lugasa'aba' zhig bya'o/ / des bde bar 'gyur ro/ /mchin pa tsha lhung la/ skyu ru ra gur gum spang rgyan brag zhun gyi thang gtong /des ma bde na/ gur gumabrag zhun sug smel/ a ru ra/ ba sha ka sbya ra ba'i gye ma gtong / lag pa'i rgyab rtsa drug 'dus gtar/ des ma bde na mchin pa'i rgyab bshal tshes bya ste/ dur byid/ dan rog dong ga a ru ra/ gur gum brag zhun ba sha ga zi yadu rnams sbyongs su gtong / ma'i la zas spyod lam bsil bcos su bya'o/ /grang lhung la/ se 'bru sug smel li shi gur gum bzhi'i thang gtong ngo / /yang na se 'bru sug spel li shi pi pi ling /a ru ra brag zhun gur gum sri yaṅku rnams kyi phye ma gtong / tshigs pa dgu ba dang mchin pa'i sna la me bya/ zas spyod snyom sa par bya'o/ /'tha ba'i mdos ser na a ru ra pi pi ling khron bu gsu ma gyi thang bag re gtong / des sbyongs theb bcu gnyis 'byung / de rjes la da trig dang tha ram dang na ram ro na cha ra ka ped dom mkhris sbyar ba 'o la btab la byin/ des bde bar 'gyur ra/ /yang pi pi ling / rgyam tsha/ su ga smel gyi thang gtong / yang na a ru ra/ rgyam tsha/ sga skya gsu ma thang du gtong / de nas tha ram pi pi ling /sga gsum zho la btab la gtong / skyugs pa brag skya ha po sa le ljang ba 'bras bu gsum gyi thang gartong / zas spyod ni tsha grang gi zas dang spyod lam bzhin du bya'o/ /lte ba'i nad gang yin yang thems bya/ 'bras bu gsum gyi sman mar la sngo dar ya gan dom mkhris bse ru/ 'a ru'i thal ba rnams btab la gtong / tshigs pa bcu gnyis pa dang / lte ba la bzhi khrom du me gdab/nges mos par 'gyur ro/ de ltar kha zas dang spyod lam sman dpyad sogs phyogs tsam bstan pa 'di la brten nas / kha cig ris pas dpyad de bcos par bya'o/ / spyir bu chung gi nad la / gdon yang 'byung nyen che bas/gdon bcos pa gal che/ chung dpyad zhus lan bdud rtsi'i thig pa zhes bya ba/259

bla ma zhang ston gyis bu'i don du bkod pa'o/ /stod mkhun byung ba la gur gum cu gang gi wang gla gul gyi thang gtong / rgyab rtsa drug mgo skyor gong gtar/phyag i na mkhas pa'i khyad chos yin/ khu tshur nyams kyi yig chung / yi thi/bkra shis 'di ni 'ang ston zhig pos mdzad/ zab phyir phyag sman rin rgyal gyis/ khu tshur 'bum gyi bsgrigs su blangs thig pa brgya rtsa'i nang na (zhang ston gyi ma nangag )yo da/260

ta /bā lha pad ma skyu ki ṇa ba ling ta khā hi ༷ karma skyu ki ṇa ba ling ta khā hiḥ gsum lnga bdun nam nyer gcig sogs kyis dbul lo/ /bkra shes brjod mi lag mi brgyud par gdags so/ /'di 'dogs pa la saser zho med par mi sbyin no/ /man ngag zhu ba re re tsam la gserasrang re med par mi gtong ngo / /rgya rgya rgya/ lag len gsal ba'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/ chig brgyud min pa su la'ang byin par mi bya'o/ /rgya gar rgya nag bod yul gang du btsal kyang 'di las lhag pa'i srung ba gzhan med do/ /dkon mod rgyal lams yongs la dris/ nus mthu gzhan dang mi 'dra'o/ /nyams len lag la blangs pas shes/slob dpon des bu lasang ba btags nas ti se la sgom du gshegs pas/ lo gsum nas byon pas bu pos 'dug da nga la gtang rag 'bul dgosaskyigasungasapas/ slob dpon gyis des ci yang ma phan/ nged rang gisagazhan la nor phul nas thabs sna tshogs byas pas sos pa yin zer nas yon mi 'bul 'dug pas/ 'o na nga'i shing bu'i srung ba khyer shog gsungs pas/ khos kyang bu'i mgul nas shing bu dkrol nas gtad pa sa/ zhag bzhi nas bu nad kyis btab ste/ shi thug pa dang / mig mthong ba mang bos mthong nas/dbus kyi bsam yas nas 'ong zer ba'i rgyal 'gong gcig dang / gre mo'i 'bal mo gcig gisabu'i khres pablag blog re khur nas/ na ning nas kyang lo du ma btsal yang rnyed du ma 'dod/ tsa na ngu skad gcig 'dug kyang ma rkomathong / da res rnyed gyis zer nas/ khur song ngo / /sngar gtang rag za ba rnams kyis thabs ci byas kyang ma phan par zhag lnga nas bu shi song /gnas po 'gyod nas slob dngo na la bshags pa phul/ rgyab la gser zho gsum dang rta bzang bo gcig phul bas/ nga la brnyas nas skyu ṅka ma'i chad pa yong ba yin sasungs/ sang lo dus la bu 0/cig skyes pas la / thabs gzhan ye ma byas par shing bus srung ba btags pas/ da gzod bu sos/264
