shing bu'i srung ba re re lagaser zho re dang rta re phul bas/ bu gsum bu mo gnyis lnga mthud nas pos so/ /des na 'di las lhag pa mi 'dus go/ /gzhan yang lo rgyus mang dag yod de 'dir ma bris/ man ngas gser chos rta ri nor bu bya ba yin pas/ snying nas phyung rung kha ru bsdam/ nga min 0zhan la yod pa min/ dam tshig ldan pa'i bu la byin/ gcig brgyud kho na'o/ /aha ri ni sa hūṃ dzaḥ dkyil gyi thod pa dang shing bu rnam sa bzung thigs gis sprel/thos rnams gu gul gyi dud pas bdug rdzas rnams dar dmar la btum la gdags so/ /mkha' 'gro'i bsnyen pa zhag gsum bskyal/ thod pa'i gtor ma'i dbang bskur/ bgegs bskrad srung ba gdags so/ /shing bu'i man ngag zab mo shin tu zab ju 'i man ngag rdzogs so/ /da ni srung ba 'di lta bu bzhings pa gal che/ gnyis 'dzom legs pa yin/ phyag sman mkhas pa'i khyad chos yin/ khu tshur nang gi yang tis yin/ nga min 0zhan la yod pa min/ i thi/'di'i brgyud pa ni/ pad ma 'byung gnas la mkha' 'gro sde lngasam gnang / pad mas mnga' bdas nyang ral ba can la/ paṇḍi ta dharmā shri la/de la gser srang sang dang gos phyi nang gcig rta gcig rnams phul nas/rin rgyal/ 'od de/ rab ba'i ba/ de'i bu dge bsnyen/ de'i bu phyag sman sangs mgon rnams kyi phas bu la rim pa bzhin du brgyud nas bser chos su byas pa'o/ /bdag gis kyang gser zho gang dang chos rje rin po che 'jigs med grags pa'i sku ngo char nas/ chos rje bas ba gcig dang na bza' gcig gnang nas/ da chos rje'i sku ngo la ster ro sasu ngas nas drin bsngo dang byas nas gnas chen glang ri ru a pha sa ngas mgon gyis bdag shor seng la gnang ba'o /pa da ma 'i lte ba dang 'dab mar sator ma re re/ mar me re re/ kha dog dang mthun par bzhas 'dab ma shar dkar/ lho ser/ nubaskro 265

rtsa gug chag dbang bo'i lag pa dang bzhi/ yang rkyen rtsa bzhi yin/ byad ngo hom khung yin/ bu g.yon bskor/ bu lkogayas bskor yin/ phyogs bzhi'i zla ba gnyis gnyis thob/ mtshams bzhi'i zla ba re re thob/ nam dgra thog tu phyin pa'i dus na ngan pa yin/ gto yas de'i phyogs su 'phongs 'di spar kha brgyad kyi 'khor lo yin/ dbyar snying mo yi rtsa la skyon byung na/ dgun chu'i dus su ngan/ ston glo ba lcas/sa kyi dus skyon byung na/ dbyar me'i dus ngan pa yin/ dgun mkhal ma chu'i dus skyon byung na/ tha chung bzhi la ngan pa yin/ dpyid mchin pa shing gi dus skyon byung na/ ston glo ba lcags kyi dus ngan/ tha chung bzhi phyed phyed ngan/ pho mchin gyi rtsa la skyon byung na/ dpyid mchin pa shing gi dus ngan pa yin/ de ni nam sla dus bzhi'i bskor lusas so / /snying rtsa la skyon byung na rgyal bo gnod sbyin gnod/bya mdos rgyal sbyin bkar/ glo rtsa la skyon byung na/ btsan dang gri bo gnod/btsan mdos gtong snying rtsa la lho nas mi sha rtsa dmar ba gos dmar bo gon pa/bon bo'i gos dang rta dmar zhur/ mas dmar bos gnod pa yin/ glo rtsa la ni nub phyogs nas / mi sha rtsi dkar ba/ smrar blo bde ba/ rta dang gos dkar bo gon pa ni/ lcags dang gos dkar bo sogs la gnod pa yin/mkhal rtsa la/ phyogs byang nas mi 'a rtsi sngo ba dang / kha so mi gtsang ba/mas nag po/ gos nag rta nag zhon pa yin/ rmi chin rtsa la shar na/ mi bangs ske ring ba dbyibs skur ba/ shing bya la ber ga thogs pa/ pho mtsher la bande/ gos ser mas ser yin/ snying rtsa la skyon byung na/ byis pa rang la ngan/ gto bcos bya ba ni/ mda' la lo grangs zla grangs khram byas la chung yas/ ngar mi khras long gi kha bcad la bor/ mda' gzugs/ tshe chog dang tshe dpas med 'don no/ /glo rtsa la skyon byung na pha khu la ngan/ bon sha ba ru rgyas bya/ btsan mdos gtong / mchin rtsa la skyon byung na ma sru 268

la ngan/ dgra sri mnan/ rtsa shed che na tshe zad kyi dur los bya/ ma lha la skyabs / pho mtsher gyi rtsa langs na dgra brub bya/ rgyu long dang rma khal gi nga gi rtsa langs na mnan pa dang dgra brubs bya/ long rtsa stod pha khu'i sa yin/ rtsa smad ma sru'i sa yin/ rtsa dkyil rang sa yin/ snying rtsa med na srung ma da' bzubs/ glo rtsa med na/ gsol btab bya/ le gu la yon phul / mchin rtsa med na ma lha la skya bas de rnams rtsa'i gnas lugs yin/ snying rtsa lho me'i lams/ mkhal ma byang chu'i khams/ glo ba nub lca gas kyi khams mchin pa 'ar thing gi lams/ bu lho (rna rtsa'i rtsa ba )la rtsa ba/ bu mo byang tham sa 'a rtsis pa yin/ bu g.yo na bskor/ bu mo g.ya sa bskor yin/ nam dgra thog tu phyin tsa na ngan pa yin/ da dpe chung bstan par bya ba ni 'di ltar yin/ phyas sman mkhas pa'i khyad chos yin/ yi thi/ bkra shes/269

pa'i steng du skam/ /dam yog me yi tshigs pa 'dra/ /sor mos tug tug byas pa dang / /kog kog zer ba'i kog skad sogs/ /rlung rtags ro stod rlung gsang gzer/ /stod du dbugs 'tshangs ngar sogs yong / /de rnamasand byi ——rtags bstan pa'o/ /de yi bcos thabs bstan pa ni/ /zas dang spyod lam sman dpyad bzhi/ /dang bo zas ni bcud rnams spang /chang skyur tsha sgog sngo ngan spangs/ /btsod dang zho dang ba sha rul sungs med pa bsten/ /bdud rtsi dar ya kun gyi tshod rma thebs 'ga' re bsten pa 'o/ /spyod lam nyin gnyid drag shul spang / /grang ba rlan steng sdod pa spang / /sman ni gur gum dug mo zhung / /su ga smel shing tsha pi pi ling / /se 'bru ma nu pus dkar rnams/ /zhib btags ka ras rta byas la/ /thun chung bdun byas chu skol dbul / /'u su'i grang thang rgyun du satong / de nas nad kyi bsgang dus su/ / gur gum rtsi 'u brag zhun dang rga gi wang cu gang sbya ra la gtong / /srog 'don pa yi lcags kyu yin/ /dpyad ni ru thung mkhris rtsa btar/ /de yis mi grol gang yang med/ /kun gyis lag len sla/ nyam sa su blangs pa'i man ngag 'dis / /'byung ba ma nyam sa nad las grol/ /chab klu sadon grol la sogs bya /sa bdag nad las grol bar 'gyur/ /dkar chos gnas mal spo ba dang /chu ni brje ba la sogs bya/ /ma jug tu chang dang zas bzang satong / / phral mi ldang cing nad rkangamathung / /byus pa byed na 'di ltar ro/ /dang bo chu rtsa das gis bkru/ /gnyis pa ba yi chu yis bsdu/ /de nas gla rtsi yung ba dang / /chu ser sman gsum gu gul nag po dang / /gsal byed mdung rtse pha bong dang / /skus po sbal rgyab gser nu se/ /cong zhi go thal chags ma dang / / 'ib btags byis pa lo brgyad pa'i/ /dri chus sbyar la byubs par bya/ / yang yang bskus la nyi mas bdugame nyi drod bcos chen po spa nga / /nad kyi rlabs brid rtsang yang bza'o/ /nad 'di dang bo tshad rtags 'byung / /de dus chu tshan la dugs pas / /nad lhag 273

pa'i phan yon dpag tu med do/ /phyag mi na mkhas pa'i zhal sadams yin/oṃ hri ha na da tshag chu tshag chu snya hwa/ mang du bzlas nas srung skud la sngags mdud gsum byas nas zhed la bcings pas thub par nges so/ /yang lugs gcigal/ sngags 'di'o/ /byed lusas gong dang 'dra/ sna na mo bha ga wa te bhi su me rkya ro ma ra tso srid dha na ma sarba na hūṃ phaṭa su hā/ mi thub pa srung ba'i snga gas yin/ phyag sman mkhas pa'i byad chos yin/ i thi/ bkra shis 277

rlung / /rim pa bzhin du 'byung ba yin/ /bayang ba mkhris pa me chu — — glu dku 'khrugs/ /yang na sha khrus lta bu 'am/ /tshil gyi dud pa 'dra nyid dam/ /dmar zhing nag la khrag dang bcas/ /mtho 'khor mig na phugs su 'bros/ /bkru snan drags las 'byung ba yin/ /de bzhin skyugs sman drags las 'byung / /skyugs sman bkru sman 'dra bas na/ /cho ga slob dpon ngag la 5 dris/ /zas la rim gyis sbyor ba ni/ /de 'og nar ma'i kha zas bston de nas lta ba'i cho ga cha/ /mar dang 'o ma sprang rtsi so gas/ /mang ba'i sman gyi rnam pa dag de nas yud tsam ngal bsos la/ /phal cher sman ni sngar gyis 'tsho /gso ba dka' la yu na ring na/ /sngar gyi sman rnams bskyar la gtong / de nas snum dang dugs byas nas/ /mas gtong 'jam rtsi'i cho ga bya/ /rkyang ba ldan pa 'dus pa sogs/ /gang ma tshams bltas pa'i sman sbyor bya/ /phyi nas me drod saso dbos pas / /se 'bru bzhi brgyad la sogs sbyar/ /'bru bcud we gu'i sbyor ba bya /rtsa ba lnga yi sbyor ba dang / /phyi nas me yi sbyor ba bya/ /gtso brgyad sman gyis 'or gsang srung / /rma khal ma'i rtsa nag kun nas yod/ /bcu drug kha gsum sgang ba'i gsang / /de rnams me yis ma nan par bya/ /tshigs par spra ba lnga lnga gdab/ /rtsa rnams la ni gsum gsum mo/ chu snyi nyams kyi yig chung khu tshur 'di/ /phyas sman sprang bo rin rgyal gyis/ /a tsa ra la zhus pa 'di/ /slob ma dad gus ldan pa'i mi/ /chos la mos shing snying rje ldan/ /brtse bas nad pa skyo ngas pa dang / /saser dang 'bul ba bsnyen bkur sogs/ /phangs med 'bul nus slob ma snams la/ brtse ba'i bu ni rtag tu dga' phyir yi ger rin rgyal bdag gis sems can don du bkod/ rigs rgyud 'dzin pa rnams kyi yon la/ gser sogs gang 'bul blangs la/ byang sems ldan pa'i bu la/khu tshur rgyud 'di ma chad tsam re spel/ mang na rin chen gser yang mod pas sacig brgyud kho na'o/ /nga min gzhan la yod pa min/ phyag sman nang na re 283

re tsam/ yo da med rgyal khams yo ngas la dris / ma la ya na tsan dan 'ing /kha che'i yul na gur gum rtswa/ ku tshur man ngas ma nga na mkhas pa su yis byed/de phyir bu la'ang sasang ba'i rgyu/ phyag sman mkhas pa 'i khyad chos yin/rang la bu mang bo yod na de'i blo dge ba rig pa rtso ba gcig la ma na' bkag la byin/ bu med na slob bu dge la brtson cing snying rus che ba byang sems ldan pa nad pa la brtse ba/ slob dpon la saser gyis 'gos byas 'bul nus pa zhig la/ gcig brgyud min pa stong ri'i mna' lan gsum de dag bsag pa'i dam bca'/ a tsa ra nas rin rgyal yan nas/ deng sang a pha sangs mgon yan gyi lag len du 'dug pas oṃ pha chos se la'ang gser dang mna' dgos gsungs nas/ bdag nas gser zho gang dang / mar zho sang na bza' dga' ba gcig phul nas mna' phul lo/ /de bzhin kun byed rigs so/ /i thi/ bkra shis/ 284

bsdus pa'i khu bas gtong / /pho ba rgyu zhabs dugs kyis bdug de rnams byas pas gtor ba rnyed/ /'gags pa la ni rgyu sngar gsungs/ /sa bon ——'gags dang spu 'thun sa ches /khrag sha rdo 'us 'gag pa dang / /lhang ba kha 'chus lnga yin no/ /de rnams bsal ba'i thabs la ni/ /bde dpyad slob dpon zhal las shes/ sgring dang dugs dang bsku mnye bya/ /chu skol tshan rde yang yang gtong / /des kyang grol bar ma gyur na/ /byis pa 'i bdud rtsi hub sang gtong / /des ni grol bar 'gyur ba yin/ /gal te 'jam nas ra chod na/ / de 'og nyid du bcad pa ra bya/ / rgas dang zungs zad chung ngu la/ /nyams dang sbyar la dpyad par bya/ /zungs zad nad khams che ba la /tshad dang sbyar la (bag rtsam )snga bar bcad/ /nad dang 'u sa zungs sbyar la bya/ /shed che dar ma nad gzhi che/ /lus zungs shin tu bzang rnam sa la/ /mi bcad zhag 'ga' bzhas pa ra bya/ /nad zad rang chad 'byung ba yin/ /'on kyang chad du ma 'dod na/ /de 'og nyid bu bcad par bya/ /de yang tsha 'byams grang 'byams gnyis/ /tsha 'byams khrag dang dud khur 'byung / /rgya bshal mar tshar 'byung ba dang rga /grang 'byam sa chu ser sngo rtsa dang / /chu mdog nyid du 'byung ba yin/ /'on kyang rtsa chu nad gzhi shes/ /ma 'byams dus su shes par bya'o/ /bcad thabs sman dang zas spyod gnyis/ /sman ni dang ga'i sbyor phye dang / /nag mtshur ge sar sbyar byas la/ /yang na dom mkhris dag dang ni/ /chu la sbyar la gtong bar bya/ /ma chod sne 'u bkrus la satong / /des kyang ma chod btsod khu la/ /dom mkhris kha tshar btab pas chad/ /ma chod dom mkhris shing tsha dang / /shing mngar chang ngam chu sbyar gtong / /ma phan chu ser mkhris pa gtong / /dri chu bong dkar btab la gartong / /des ni mi chad mi srid do/ /zas ni 'bras ('di bar ma ldebs gnyis ma tshang)/ spyir rtsa lam sbyangs pa dang /pho mo sprad pa dang / dngos gzhi la/ rgya tsha che bar gtong bas/ ma sto 288

'gagasachu ser rgyu bgadugs drag tu bya/ ma tshan ma khrag tu sub pa la dugs mi bya/ gal te gne skran nam khrag mis sa bon 'gresas pa la sogs te/ gang gis de rnams kyang ma thon na/ lcags byi sbubs phra bar byas la/ de la rgyus pa'i sbyor ba lag len ltar bya/ nad pa nas khang la stegs byas la/ rgya tsha dang byang ba dri chu la sbyar la / lcang bar mas gtong du byas na phan no/ /lde'u sa bon 'gags pa gang yang 'byung nges so/ /dri med zla this las 'gags pa srung ba'i man ngas sas so/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dri med zla this las/ /ris pas sar 'phrod dpyad byas la/ /slob dpon gdams ngas thob pas btul/ /zhes pa mi/ dus dbyung ba/ gnyen po sdebs pa/ 'dul ba dngos dang gsum rngo / /dug dbyung ba ni/ bar gshog dbyung ba'o/ /byang ba nag khra kun la dus yod pas spang ngo / /la la mgo bo dang yan lag breg nas gtong zer ba yang yod/ mgo bo dang yan lag med na/ mgo bo dang yan lag gis nad mi 'drongs pas mi zag go/ /gnyen po gzhung na sas la lo /dus 'dul thabs la lnga'o/ / yos la 'dul ba dang / chang la 'dul ba dang ཿ dri chu la 'dul ba dang / /ma ra la 'dul ba dang / /rkang mar la 'dul ba dang lnga'o/ /yos la 'dul ba ni/ byang ba mar gyis byugs la ras la bstums la yos kyi nang du bcug yang na nas dang bsres la bas tsam brngos la bya chang la 'dul ba ni/ ras la bsdu mas la chang la 'as gcig sbangs la khu ba bas re dor ro/ /dri chu la 'dul ba yang de dang 'dra'o/ /ma ra la 'dul ba ni zangs gzhong gi nang du rme ra dkar la bcug la bsrol/ khu ba ser bor byung na zhag po song dang 'dra'o/ /zang mar la 'dul ba ni/ ra'i rkang mar rnying ba dang / zangs gzhong du bcug la byang ba dang bsres/ sol ba dngakyibazhag yang rkang mar gyis byugs la ras la phur la/ nge yos kyi nang du 289

zan bcig za yu na bzhas yang dri chu nub pa sacis rang thim yang byed/'dul lugs de rnams la nges pa med pas gang rung zhig byas pas chog go/ /spyir byang ba la dug dang gnas kyi bzang ngan yod pas/ bzang ba rnams 'dul ba drag tu bya/ ngan pa rnams zhan du bya/ zug chung la 'drongs che zer te/ zug che gsung ngo / /byang ba btul drags pa dang / thun chung ba dang / mgo lag med pa dang / ser khra rnam sa zug chung ste 'drongs yang chung ngo / /zug chung la 'drongs che ba ni/ dus dang gnas bzang ngan gye la mgo bo dang yan las tshang bar dug bton la thun tshad du gtong ngo / /'dul ba bag dal du bya/ grolas rgya tsha bshad pa yin pas thun skyed la gtong ngo / /dus ni ston la sanas ni srad ma'i gseb grir shi ba/ than pa dang ser ba'i dus bzang / pos 7 nam gzhug chod/ ba mos phog lo ma'i gseb rnams ngan no/ /gnas la ma yob mo dang / char dus kyi byang ba ngan pas nus pa chung ngo / /kha dog ni nas khra rtsub/ ser khra 'jam/ dmar khra mnyam pa yin/ dri med zla thig las/ bzang ngan brtsi ba rdzogs so/ /'jam pa 'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dri med zla thig las/ rtsa skebashal la zug skyed pa'i rgyu ni/ chu ser gyi rkyen gyis zug che byang ba tsub pas zug skye/ chu ser 'gyings pas zug skyed/ 'gags pa sa skye ba dang —— glubazhi'o/ /zug de gzhom pa'i thabs la chu ser 'gyings pa la zug skye ba ni /gzhung nas bshad pa'am/ de rnams kyis ma chos na man ngag stan gyis the tshom med/ gzhung nas ba da pas ma chog na/ shing tsha mthug po sga skya zhib pa ra byas la/ bye slong gang mar dkar gyis btums la gyur mid bya/ sman de yi grogs bye ma chang gis kha phru btab la dugs so gas kyis pho ba dang rgyu ma na sar dugs bya'o/ /des chu ser rgyu ba'i zug mi chog mi srid do/ /byang ba thun ches pa'am/ dug ma thul ba rtsub pas dug skyed par gyur na/ bong dkar 290

bye sgong gang gnam gyi thar (sna leb )ba'i mgo bo gsum zhigatu btags la/byis pa lo brgyad pa'i chu la gtong ngo / /nges zhi bar the tshom med/ chu ser gyis 'gyingasapa ni/ grang rlung ngam lus grang ba'am/ chu ser sman gyi phul bas de 'ong du mi 'dod par 'gyings na/ rgya tsha bye sgong gang / pi pi ling bdun/ sug smel thun gcig chang phul gang la btab la gartong / de yang 'jam sros la rkang mthil la byugs pa bya/ rgyu zhabs yos sam klog pa'i sbang skam bsros pas bdus go / 'gags pa zus skyes pa ni gong du shes/zla thig las/ 'gags pa gas la ba'i man ngas rdzogs 'di rnams zab bo rang /'jam pa 'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /da byin brgyad sbyor 'dzi sngon du 'gro ba'i sbyor ba ste/ da byid sdig srin rgyam tsha gser bye/ sug smel / nyi dga' sra 'bras/ mkhal ma zho sha sto tsang ba dang byug pa rnams byed /ril bu byas la/ che chung 9 ba'i ril ma tsam byas la chang dang sdeb la gastong ngo / /zus chung ba dang / rdo skran la sogs pa 'gasas pa mi 'byung / zla thig las sngon 'gro rdzogs so zla this la sa/ kha tshar gyi sman gtong ba'i rim pa mi/ rtsa 'grams 'khrugs dang rtsa thor la/ 'ol mo mang du gtong bar bya/ snying rtsa 'grams na dzā ti dang glo rtsa 'grams pa ra gyur pa na/ shing mngar star bu cu gang gtong / mchin rtsa 'grams na gur gum ba 9 ka gnyis gtong / mtsher rtsa 'grams na sug smel/ mthal rtsa 'grams na sdig srin sug smel gtong /mdze dang chu ser rgyas pa la/ gu gul nag po satong / rus pa'i chu ser rgyas pa la seng ldeng gu gul dkar bo gtong / dus la bong dkar dpa 'a bo ser bo sdum bu re ral khyung sder gtong / dregs dang grum bu'i nad la thal ker rdo rje so ma rā dza spos dkar gtong / byis pa'i lde'u la rgyam tsha rgya tsha 291

gser bye/ sdig srin ka ko la ka ra rmi nga du byin de rnams rtsa ba'i sman steng du/ rang rang spu bsgyur gtong ba'o/ /gnyis pa gtong ba'i cho sa la/ thang dang phye ma satong ba'o/ /thang du btang na smri na rnams hrom brdungs 'a ras la bsdums/ skam la btsir zhing sum yar gtong ngo / /phye ma gtong na sman rnams rtsi bzhin btags/ bdud rtsi'am ba'i chu la rta byas la gtong ngo / /rtsa bshal sbyor ba rgya mtsho las / dri med zla ba'i thig pa zhes bya ba/ drang srong brgyad kyi nyams stong bsdus pa de nas rim par brgyud pa/ da lta mtha' yas yongs kyi bcud/ gzhan ma mun pa 'i mag rum 'dra/ 'ji ni gsal byed nyi ma 'dra/ slob dpon chen po pha khol gyis mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /rma tha' bzhi stong gsum gang ba'i lugs/ /sazhan dang mi 'dra khyad par che/ /dam med kha bas ga can la min/ /las can snying rus can labyin/ /slob dpon a tsa ra nas phyag sman rin rgyal gyis pha phog la bsal spe la phogade nas rim bzhin ma pha sangs ma gon la pha phos la rim si bzhin du a pha chos se la phog des bdag shes rab seng ge la ya ba sras gnyis pos sanang ba yin/ yi thi/mi na gyi bla dang phyag 'os kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdams pa 'di pad bskor du yod pa dkyus su bris pa'o/ /'ji rnams mi 'gyur sman brgyad yin/dur byid mtheb tshigs gcig dan rog bdun/ shrī khaṇḍa ril ma tsam gcig 'gron bu dur byid snyoms/ a ru ra gcig spos dalar dang nyi dga' khyor re re/ thur rgyug chu phul phyed/ mi 'gyur sman brgyad yin/sbrum la spru dkar bsnan pas bu mi 'chor/ de ngo rme tshar che'o/ /mdze pho la mdze tsha 'dre gdon la sngags pa'i dri chu/ zhe ser la thal ka rdo rje/ mi thod bsregs pas btsan sa zin/ bzhu ba la dbyi mo nga khrus bu chung nyi shu rtsa brgyad 292

mtsher nad mtsher ba na ba dang / rtse'i phyogs re nag po yong / mkhal nad g.yas ga yon gnyis po'am/ gang rung na zhing skrang ba dang / brla rengs las nad skyed par byed// /gnod pa bdun ni/ mo nad mang ba la gnod pa dang / chu ser (la gnod sa ma nga ba dang khrag sla )la gnod pa dang / bu mi chags (zla mtshan las su mi rung bas rul ba'am khams ngang mi 'dre ba'i phyed thon pa yis )pa la gnod pa dang / bu chags nas gzugs su ma (chags pa dang )la gnod pa(skye ma ched ma dod phyir thon yang )bzugs chags kyang skye ru mi 'dod pa ( skye mched dod kyang skye ru mi 'dong pa ma bu 0nyis ka 'chi nyen yod )dang / zla mtshan la gnod pa dang / mngal la sanod pa dang bdun no/ /nyams pa lnga ste/ mig gi dbang bo nyam sa te mig tsag cing mi gsal / rmi na lag gi dbang bo nyams te sbrid pa'o/ rna'i dbang bo nyams te sgra mi thos pa'o/ /snying gi dbang bo nyams te brjed ngas pa 'o/ /lus kyi dbang ngo nyams te nyid pa skyur 'ing phyi bshol dga' ba'o/ /rkyen du gyur pa ni gsum ste/ srog dang bral ba'i rkyen du gyur pa/ mdze'i rkyen du gyur pa / snying rlung si rkyen du gyur pa dang sasum mo/ / skran rnam pa bcu sanyis ni/ khrag la sa gyur pa'i rkyen yin/ 'dzi mngal du khrag 'byam sa pa yin te/ bye brag mi dgos/ nge ltar rngo nad sum bcu so drug gsungs kyang / don hril gyis dril na/ khrag tshabs dang rlung tshabs gnyis yin gsungs/ mo nad bcos pa bdud rtsi'i this pa las /gang bcos par bya ba'i nad bstan pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa 'o/ /de nas gang la 'byung ba'i brtag pa bstan pa 'i le'u brtsod /ra bya ste/ de la gras tshabs nad kyi mtshan nyid ni/ mdos dmar smug mig dam ra chu ni chu rtsa'i khu ba 'dra/ lus kyi sha sbo ba dang / 'phris pa dang / tsha hrab hrab byed pa dang / yang na skabs su tsha 'ur 'ur ba dang / tshor ba chung ba dang / skra dang smin ma byi ba dang za ya 'byung / kha mtshul dang tshigs pa skra ngas nasa'agul spyod 296

dka' ba 'byung bar gda' drag shul lam me dang nyi mas rkyen byas nas stod brgyangs ma jing ba rengs/ mig dang mtshogs ma na zhing brag ro'i na lugs 'dra ba 'byung / 'di ni khrag tshabs byer ba ces bya ste tha ma mdze ru 'gro ba'i dpe yod rdo/ /rlung tshabs nad kyi mtshan nyid ni/ lce snyil dang mchu la sogs pa skya mig mi gsal/ snying mi da 'a/ zas dang gar mi yong / chud par sanam 'khor ba dang lus gud pa dang / grang lhags kyis phog pa'i tshe/ mabo bo 'khor/ rus tshisas kun khol zhing na/ sha yang khol ba'am 'chasas su mi 'dod pa dang / yang na rme ngal skran 'byung bas/ zla mtshan dus su mi 'byung ba'am/ 'ga' zhig zla ma tshan rgyun du 'dzag pa dang / skyed pa dang rus smad 'khril zhing na ba dang / lus sbyid cing bem por gyur te tshor ba chung ba dang / drod chung ba dang / rtsa yang phra zhing dal la sto nga ba 'byung gne/ 'di ni rlung tshabs zhes bya ste grang rlung 'u nad 'ba' zhig yin gsurngos/ lar mo nad spyi'i rtasas ma thun la / skrag tshabs dang rlung tshabs gnyis/ ma gri/ sa shas che ba dang rlung yas che ba la ba gas pa yin gsu ngas/ mo nad bcos pa bdud rtsi'i this pa las gang byung ba'i rtasas la brten nas ngos bzung ba'i le'u ste gsum pa'o/ /de nas sang gis bcos pa 'i thabs kyi le'ur bshad pa ra bya rtse/ brag tshabs kyi nad la byer ba thang cus sdud pa dang / 'dus pa bshal sgyes sbya ngas pa dang / phyi nad lums kyis drangs pa dang / phyi rjes mi na gyis bcad pa dang bzhi yin 0sungs/ thang ni 3nga tsha rgyam tsha lcum rtsa/ smyus ma'i rtsi/pa rmi ga pa rnams skol ba'i thang gtong / de nas chen ches na khrus sather bya ste nyi dga'i thang gtong la/ de nas ngos sazhi'i sman ni/ dur byid dan da nyi dga' gu gul dkar bo rgyam tsha shing tsha lhum rtsa byang ba srad dasar rtsa ba de rnams bshal du gtong la/ nad che na sbags la thengs 'ga' g.yong /297

sngon 'gro dang rjes sbyangs spyi dang 'dra/ phyi sha thi gas rkya nad la/ dbyar me tog dgun bdud rtsi lnga'i lugs mang du bya/ chu ser la sogs pa phyi ru 'dren pa man ngag yin gsungs/ rjes la sman mar la so gas pa 'bras bu gsu ma mam/ yang na seng ldeng shing tsha lhum rtsa 'ol mo bas tsam gcig pi pi ling smyug ma 'i rtsi/ nyi dga' gu gul dkar bo shing tsha lham rtsa so ma rā dza thal ka rdo rje se rgod bar shun lhum bu re ral pa yas la sogs pa dang / sbrang rtsi rnams kha tshar du btab la gtong / khyad par du chu ser nag po bcos par bya gsungs/ da ni rlung tshabs bcos pa'i thabs bstan te/ bcud bsher gyis grang rlung rtsa bcad pa/ smri na gsher gyis skyon bas la ba/ me btsas me drod kyis ro blang ba/ sman mar gyis nad kyi phyi rjes bcad pa dang bzhi yin gsungs/ de la dang bo bcud bsher ni lug thong tsher gyi sha rma sungs pa dang / tshil dang rus pa gsum/ gud gud du phral la/ sha rnams gris btogs la snod du btsos/ dus pa dang tshil rnams brdungs te bskol ba'i nang nas dwangs ma ya nga ya nga du snod gtsang mar blugs la/ i na ni tsha ba gsum se 'bru sdig srin 'ing tsha rgyam tsha tsi tra ka dbyi ro nga li shi ka ra la sogs pa rnams zhib par btags la snod cig tu btsos / de nas lho stong la dwangs ma de nas bag tsarma re blud/ de nas sha bag tsam re btab la dkrug ste phyed tshos tsam la sman bag tsam re btab tshos pa dang 'thung / gzhan yang gang na ba'i phyogs kyi sha de bzhin sbyar bar bya/ bcud bsher chen po 'di ni rlung tshabs nad la bdud rtsi 'dra gsungs/ zla mtshan rgyun du 'dzag pa 'am/yang na mi 'byung ba'am/ mngal du skran zhugs pa la sogs pa rnams la mngal bshal bya ste 'om mo / byang ba/ rgya tsha/ shing tsha/ rgyam tsha/ sus smel shu dag ru rta byang bul/ phab dan da dur byid rnams zhib par byas te/skyes pa'i chus ril bu sran ma tsam byas la gan rkyal du bsnyal la ril bu sran ma 298

tsam re sna nang mdzub bus bcar la btang / 'dis mngal skran dang bu mi 'chagasapa la sogs pa mngal gyi skyon mtha' dag sel ba yin gsungs/ me btsa' ni/ tshigs pa bcu gsum pa dang / bco lnga ba'am/ nyer gcig pa dang / gi nga gsang rnam sa su ris pas dpag ste me bya'o/ / ga'an yang drod chung ba dang / tshor ba med pa dang / zug che ba'i sa rnams su a na zug chog gi me bya gsungs/ sman mar ni rtsa ba lnga'am/ yang na brong nga'i sman mar la / kha tshar ni bcud bsher gyi sman snga btang la bsten/ rlung tshabs kyi nad 'dzi ni grang rlung rkyang ba yin te/ bcos dathos gsu ngas/khrag tshabs la zas ni snyoms shing bcud la brten/ spyo da lam ni/ dras shul spang la dal bar bya sasungs/ rlung tshabs la zas bcud med spang /drod bcud gcis bu bsten/ spyod lam grang lhags dang rlan spang sasungs/de nas dro bar bya/ de la dro bar byas te bcos nga 'i 'phrul 'khor rnam sa ni nad zhin che chung dang / skyed che chung la dpag spe/ gcig gnyis gsu ma bzhi la mosas pa 'phrul thub cing spod pa ra shes pa ra bya'o/ /'di brtsam sa las byung dge ba nges/ sems can kun la bde ba thob pa ra shog ro nad bcos pa'i bsta na bcos bdud rtsi'i thig pa las/ sang nas bcos pa'i thabs bstan pa'i le'u ste ba'i ba'o/ /mo nad bcos pa bdud rtsi'i thig pa khu tshur rdzosas so / /phyag sman mkhas pa'i khyad chos i thi/bud med bu ro ma thon pa la/ mi rus mi gcis pa gsum gyis spu nas gi gzhob/ smre mo nga sha dang sbyar chang nas phul la bstong / ya nga na rgya tsha rgya ru ri bong ril ma 0sum gong gi spu nag bcob dang sbyar la gtong / i thi sngags chu byed na/ kha thur bstan du chu bcus la /la dung gi lte ba zhiba'i btags btab la sngags 'di brgya'am nyer gcig btab/ 9 kri ma kri lam phye 'byung ba 'dus pa'i smo phye/ 'di yang phyag sman rin rgyal lag len 299

yin/ mo nad bcos pa bdud rtsi'i thig pa 'di yang / cher che zhang ston gyis mdzad pa'i thig pa brgya rtsa'i nang nas phyung ba'o/ /zhib par rmi phyag men rin rgyal rang gis mdzad pa'i mo nad bcos thabs zab pa las kyang ches zab pa zhes bya ba khu tshur na yod/ bkra shes/300

'dra/ de nas sngo dang chu'i dwangs ma 'dra/ rin chen g.ya'i dug la yang /'tsho bar bshad pa ma gsungs so/ /zhes pa dug gi brtag pa yin/ sbyar ba'i dug la rigs ni mang du yod gser/ dngul/ zangs/ lcags la sbya ra ba dang gcig ba bla ldong dul mthing shun mu zi la sogs rdo dus can la sbyar ba dang gnyis sbrul sbal ba byang ba sdig pa la sogs pa la sbyar ba dang gsum/ thang phrom pa ri sho ba g.yer ma la sogs sngo dug can la sbyar ba dang bzhi/ bse shing re lcags pa shing dug can la sbyar ge dang lnga / 'phral gyis btsan dug dang drus go/ /de yang dbyig dug ni zug che/ shed chung sha skam bcos dka'/ rdo dug yin na pho bar skran du 'gro/ shin tu zug gzer che yang glo ba la babs na sna khras 'dzag snang ba 'khrul ba 'byung ngo / / sha dug yin na/ sha 'gul/ so na/ rtsa sprid tshigs bzhi khol/dpe rim/sa 'khrugs dang 'dra'o/ /shing dug ni rus pa dang chu rgyus la 'bab/rengs pa dang 'khums pa 'byung ngo / / bse shing ni smug pa dang /bras tu 'khru'o/ /btsan dus gis ni yang na 'khru 'phral du skyug go/ /de babs lugs la gnyis yod de/ nyes gsum thog tu babs pa dang / don snod la babs pa'o /rlung gi gnas su babs na/ gnyid med tshig pa za zhing skam khol byed/ mgris pa'i gnas su babs na tshad pa skye/ dang ga mi bde/ mgo bo na/ sha lus mdos dang chu yang ser/ bad dan gnas su babs na skyus bro pho ba na/ dang ga mi bde lus lci'o/ /snying la babs na dran pa mi gsal lce yang 'gas/ rgyu ma yang ni 'khru snyams byed/ glo bar babs na glo chung 'ong / dbugs mi bde lud pa rnag dang khrag tu 'byung / sna sgo 'gasas long ya nga 'khrog pa dag tu byed/ mchin pa la babs na ga'og g.yas na/mig mi gas la/ ma tsher ba la babs na sbo/ mkhal ma la babs na mkhal sked na/ chu sri/ rma ba 'on/ chu rgyus la babs na sen mo la nag thig 304

chags/ dus pa la babs na/ so 'gas sam yang na nas por 'gro/ di rnams na lugs la brtag pa yin no/ /da ri bcos lugs bstan te sngun ma lta bur 'bred sman ril bu gtong ba dang gcig skyel mi lta bur tshor rme thog bcos pa dang gnyis /ran pa ltar rjes snyogs su 'brang ba yun ring lon pa bcos pa dang gsum yin no/ /dang bo 'bred sman ni/ dpa' bo ser bo gtso che bar gtong / gi wang gis klad pa la mi 'bab/ phyi bas sha dus kyi skra mi 'byi/ dus sbal gyi rus pas rus pa la mi 'bab/ mi 'gas/ rma bya'i mdangs kyis sha mi skam/phyi'i pags pa nag por mi 'gro/ gla bas nang gi mkhal ma la mi 'bab/long mi sbo/ rna ba mi 'on/ gur gum gyis mchin pa srung / khras dang mkhris pa mi skye/ mig mi 'grib/ rgya chos rtsa mig tu 'phul bar byed/ de rnam sa zhib par btags la/ ra'i mchin pa gris bzhar la de la btab la nyi ma la bdug mchin pa rlon pa nangs par bza'o/ /skam pa de tshags byas la dgong lto bcag la bsku mnye bya/ mtshan dron dugs bya tho rangs rtsa kha phye ba g.yer chu khyor gang gtong ngo / /nam langs la/ sman de khye'u nu 'thung gi chu la sbyar la gtong ngo / /nyi ma shar khar rtsar rgyug gi dogs la rdom mkhris kyi khu ba gtong ngo / /nyi ma shar ba dang mar khu dang zan dron la lto bya'o/ /des rtsa kha thems so/ /phyis dug phyung yang skyug go/ /dug sngags ni 'di yin no/ /oṃ krig le krig le hri chom chom su hwa/ oṃ krug le hri krug le hri chom chom su hwa/rtsi dug sbyar chom chom swā hā/ da skyel ma lta bu'i bcos thabs ni/ dug byung ma thag la/ sman la dpa' bo ser bo thun skyed pa gcig chos sman a ru ra/byis pa lo brgyad pa'i chu la sbyar la gtong / yar skyug mar 'khru bar byed do/ /ran pa lta bu rjes snyogs pa ni/ dang bo bsdu ba/ bar du bsad pa/tha ma sbyang ba dang gsum mo/ /de ni rjes spyod du shes par gyis/ dang bo bsdu 305

dang na le sham bul rtog tsha la dang / spang rgyan grang shas che na chang dang sbyar/mkhris shas can la chu'am khye'u rigs bzang chu la sbyar/ yang lugs gcig gzhung lugs spyi dang mthun dang bo rtsa sgo dbye bar bya/ de nas rtsa mdud 'grol bar bya/ de nas rtsa lam bas la bar bya/ de nas rtsa nad sbyang ba ni/lcam pa lha mo nyi ma'i gnyen nyi dga' (lcam pa )sngon po zhes bya ba/ rgyasapa la bdo (g.yeram )rta la bskyon/ sdig pa 'i ral gri lag (sdig pa rwa can gyi gtsos pa )na thogs/ rwa gtsos pa/ srin bu'i (sdig pa srin bu )zhags pa phyogs bcur 'phen/ lto lam yangasapa'i thang la rgyug nad kyi 'jigs pa snyil ba yin/ slob dpon rin chen mdung (mtshal)dkar ma tshal thogs/stag mo khra mo'i (byangab)rta la bskyon/ 'brong rog gcis (sbur skyogs )gis stag brgya 'ded/ ri dgas (gla ba )nye ba'i ngar mdung char/ blon po rin chen ber (mtshal)dmar rtson/ seng ge dkar mo'i(rgyatsha)rta la zhon/ kha chadapa' bo(gugul )lag na thogs/ nad kyi dgra dpung 'joms par byed kun byab gser (chos mi na )ma dog chu la bskyon/ mdung nag tsha 'de (na le mim)lag na thosas/ dgra gnyen 'dul ba'i 'dzangs ngo yin/ kha bsgyur sras ni bzang bo drug ces skyer ba dang gser gyi me rtog se rgod bar shun rtsam bu re ral/ gagi chung tig ta ba sha ku rma bya'i mkhris pa/ de rnams khrus kyi bya ba shes par bya/ da ni gnyen po'i mtshan nyid ston/ dug lnga'i gnyen po ye shes lnga/ rma bya'i gnyen po sgong dug la/ rma bya gson po khyim du bsten/ rma bya'i mkhris pas rta byas la/ a ru ra dpa' bo ser bo bong nga dkar ser dmar bo/ lhum bu re ral 'bri ta sa 'dzin dug mo zhung /se rgod bar shun/ skyer shun gang ga chung / 'dam bu rka ra/ sum cu tigabazang bo drug dang sbyar ba khrus kyi gong du'o/ /dug ldang dus ni/ ra sngon mchin dug dbyar nyi khyim dus ldang / des 'gre'o/ /ga pur gyi sbyor ba bya/307

lar 'du ba la nges pa med/ sha rul sungs la yong ba yang yod/ sgog tsong drod can la yong chang skyur la yong spyod la ma log pa de rnams kyis slong ba yang yod/ de rnams gong du bstan pa'i thang gis sa/so/ ma sod khrus kyis sbyangs/ phal cher mchin pa la babs na/ mchin sman rtse'u gur gum bras zhun/ gi wang pa ra pa ta shing mngar des la bzung / lhung sa pho ba yin pas mtha' rtsa nas bcod/ skyel ma ltar tshor ma thas bcos pa dang gnyis/ran pa ltar rjes snyogs su 'breng ba yun ring lon pa 'i nad bcos pa dang gsum / de la dang ngo 'dren sman ji/ dpa' bo ser bo gtso cher gtong /sga wang gis phyis glo bar mi 'bab/ phyis skra mi 'byi/ rus sbal rus pas rus mi na/ so mi 'gas / rma bya'i mdangs kyis sha mi skam/ phyi bsalapags dzinag por mi 'gro/ gla rtsi'i mkhal ma la mi 'bab/ long mi sbo/rna ba mi 'on/ gur gum gyis mchin pa srung / mkhris pa mi skye/ mig mi 'grib/ rgya tshas thams cad rtsa mig tu 'phul lo/ /de rnams zhib par glu btags gso/ spyi sman la mchin sman rtse'u kha che gi wang brag zhun par pa ta shing mngar rnams gtong / sha dug yin na/ dpa' bo ser gzhi blangs la gong gi man rnams gtong / rtsi dug yin na/ chos sman bong nga dkar ser dmar bro la gong gi sman rnams gtong / g.ya' dug yin na/ po so cha shu dag thar nas myugs bya/ gong gi sman gtong / dug nad mchin pa la babs pas/ mchin tshos gtong / gong mo gnyis gtar ro/ /snying larkobabs na/ snying zho shas khrus gtong / mthe bo che'i rgyab rtsa gtar ro/ /khyad par 'gro mgon bamid pa 'i khrus gtong / mtsher rtsa bong dur satar/ srin lag gnyis gtar ma khal ma la babs na/ mkhal 'o shas khrus satong /mthe'u chung gi rtsa gnyis gtar/ rlung gi sanas su babs na/ rtsa sbyongs bya/mthil bzhi spyi gtsus dang lnga la dusas bya/ brag dmar bo de brton/ de 308

rjes dugs bya'o /bad gan gnas su babs na/ ma nu pa tra ba le la song gi sman gyis khrus bya/ tshigs pa gsum pa nas tshon gang bcal ba'i sar 'jibs bya/ mkhris pa 'i sanas su babs na/ tig ta dang song gi sman gyis khrus bya/ ma khris pa la thor ba'i nyen yod pa sa/ mi rta ci sasu ma tshan gyis khrus byas pas phan/ rlung saso na dzā ti bong nga dkar ngo dmar bo sbya ra satong na phan/ ma khris pa gso na/ spang rgyan dkar ngo/ ba mi ga ba le ba nirme pa sbyar bas phan/ mkhal ma gso na/ bze ma 'om bu'i bar shun sbyar la gtong bar bya/ gong gi sman btong na phan no/ / rgyu 'o nga la/dug mo nyung / gla ba gu gul sbyar na phan/ dug nad mgo bo la babs na/mtshogs ma'i steng du rnam rten btar na phan/ dug nad mig la babs nas 'grib pa la/ mig gyen du lta mig rtsa gtar na phan/ dug nad la ni 'tham pa la/ mur gong 'khyugs rtsa gnyis po gtar/ dug nad glo mang glo nad gre ba g.ya' ba la/ skyor gong gi rtsa la gtar/ dug nad lce ni skam pa la/lcang ma gsar ba'i thang yang gtong / dus nad sha ni skam pa la/ sha (ra'i sha )bshar dbang lag thang yang gtong / skyugs na ske stong du me btab/skyigs bu ma chod na yos ko'i kyong mor me btab/ sna khrag ma chod na smin mtshamasasu me btab/ mig na na gser mdung gtar/ sna khrus gtong /rna ba 'on na rna ba'i 'og gi mgul rtsa gnyis su me btab/ rgyu long mkhal sked gnyis na na byin gzhug gtar/ mchin pa la ru thung gtar/ glo ba la drug mgo rtse gsang ngo / /rkang ba lci zhing mi thes na ltag rtsa rnam 'byed gnyis po gtar/ sked pa sgur na/ ltag rtsa nag po gtar/ dug nad kyis chu rgyus 'khums na/ bras zhun gser thig sartong na phan/ sha lpags la byer nas na ba la/ brag skya ha bo gtong na phan/ dang bo thang gi sde tshan mang du btang / bar du phye ma'i sde tshan sde gu gtong / tha ma ril bu rgyun du bsten/309

sos pa de ni nyin skar tsam/ /shes rgyu med la rang mthong can/ / malas pa mthong na sbyin 'dar glo snying gdung / /dmyal ba'i sa bon theb pa'i sman pa 'dzi/ /kye ma kyi hud skal med snying re rje/ /kye ma skal can (sman pa khu tshur 'bum chung yod kyi 〉'bum chung yod kyi phyag sman rnams/ /'gro ba'i don gcig byed 'dod na/ /ngom sa pa med pa'i thos pa skyed/ /g.yel ba med pa'i lag len slob/ /'khrul ba med pa'i man ngag zhus/ /brjed pa med pa'i gsang thig slob/ /phongs pamed pa'i 'bul ba gser sogs phul la zhus/ /byams snyesems ldan zhing snying rje che/ /brtse bas nad pa skyongs mdzad pa/ /gzhan don 'ba' cig gtso bor long / /rgyun chad med par bsgom pa ra bya/ /de lta bu yi sman pa de/ /phyi ma thar ba thob par the tshom med/ /nga yi gdams ngag khu tshur 'bum gyi yang thig 'di/ /rin rgyal nyid kyis gser zho sngon rting la nyi shu rtsa thogs gcig phul 'dug da rten 'brel gyis gser zho gang khyer shog glu gsungs nas mna' bkag go/ /de nas khu tshur 'bum chung zhu ba la gser dang mna' med par bu la yang mi sbyin no/ /0cis brgyud kho na'o/ dug bcos pa ha la me dpung zhes bya ba rdzogs so/ / rgya'i mthing shog sngon po la/saser gyi yi ge can yi thi/ 'di bzhengs da bas rnam dkar gyis/ lus can nad las yongs grol te/ mtshan dpe ldan pa'i lus thob nas/ 'gro kun skyobs pa 'i nas ldan shog khu tshur 'bum chung bden rdzun lag tu long la ltos/ 'di min gdams ngag dpe chung re tsam gyis bslu ba mang / des na 'bum khu tshur gces pa zungs/ nga min ga'an la yo da pa min/ snying dang 'dra ba'i rin rgyal nyid la byin sacig brgyud mna'i dam bca' dang /gser so gas len pa brka' rgya yin/ phangs pas mi phan nyid la ster/rgyud 'di ma chad pa byed pa la gas/ rigs rgyud bcad na mi yo nga ngo /sems can 'gro don mi yong bas/ nges na gcig brgyud gyis la byin/311

snyigs dus sman dpyad gso dpyad lag len ba'ad pa man ngag sogs 'bum khu tshur gcig po rang gis chog rgyud ga'an rnams mi shes mi zhig khong du mi chud pa sa zab rung phan mi thogs / des na phyag sman man ngag zab/dbon mod rgyal khams yongs la dris / bden rdzun la ga tu blangs pas shes/mang na rin chen gser yang long / ma la ya na tsan dan shing / kha che'i yul na gur gum rtswa/ bod yul dbus na phyag sman rmi las/ mkhas pa'i khyad rmi nga 'bum khu tshur gyi nus pa yin/ yon tan brjod na brjod kyis mi long / yon tan brjod na bod du thong sa med/ phyag sman go bde ba'i phyir byas pa yin/ zer rgyu phyag sman mkhas pa nas brgyud pa yin zer ro/ /rgya gar rma khas pa dzi na mi tras ma dzad pa rdzogs so/ /'di bris dge bas sems can ji snyed pa/ /dug gi nad las grol bar shog / 'gro ba'i nad rnams ma lus pa/ /rtags tu 'byung ba med par shog /312

gnyan bskyod gag pa 'joms/ /thun tshad nad stobs dag dang sbyar/ /rtsal chen rtson po'i sbyor ba yin/ /yang cig rnon po'i sbyor ba la/ /'dzin pa zho gang zhib btags la/ /nags (btsod mdud )kyi lcag ma zho do tshad/ /sbrang ngam bu ram dag la sbyar/ /gag lhog gnyan dang skrang 'bur la/ /nus pa rdo rje pha lam mtshungs/ /ser mi aru lce tsha dang / /rnam sna nga (dge slong ngam sngags pa'i )spyor ba'i rta 'dod de/ /gnyan rigs tshad pa ma lus dang / /mkhris gzer klad gzer ma lus 'joms/ /i thi/ sngon po g.yu 'dod spyor ba ni/ /aru 'dzin sbra 'i me tog dang / /stag sha gnyan dug hong len dang / /ser bo khrag rkang sri yang ku/ /zhib btags thun tshad nad stobs (yang na khram khrum du byas la thang du bya yang na ril bu'i thang du bya )sbyar/ /sngon po g.yu 'dod ces bya ste/ /'brum bu bal nad rgyu gzer dang / /gag lhog gnyan gzer rims nad — 'joms/ /yi thi/ nag po dgu rgyur ril bu ni/ /'dzin pa gu gul shu dag nag / sdig nag sbal nas rtsangs nag sha stag sha gnyan dug hong len rtsa /gnyen po a ru ra dang bcas/ /nas po'i sbyor ba zhes bya ba/ /gag lhog gzer gsum gtso byas pa'i/ /sanyan las gyur pa'i nad kun 'joms/ /yi thi/ 'dzin pa a ru gla rtsi gi wang gu gul nag chu cos byin byas zhib glubatags la/ /khyung lnga'i sbyor ba zhes bya ste/ /phyi nang gnyan nad kun la ske gluphan/ /rims tshad ma smin smin par byed/ /yi thi/ 'dzin pa a ru sta ga sha ba/ /shug dag gla rtsi gu gul nag / gi wang gri shas (skyes pa'i )rilabu bya/ /byung lnga'i sbyor ba mas bya ste/ /'byung bo klu dang sa bdag dang / /mdze nad lhog pa'i rims nad dang / /'bu rigs tsha srin grang srin 'joms/ /yi thi/'khun pa gros 'debs a ru ra/ /cu wang gla rtsi byi tang ka / srin bu dmar leb ril bu sgril/ /srin nad 'joms pa'i bdud rtsi yin/ /rmi nga cig mkhas pa'i man ngag las/ /'khun pa gros 'debs dmar ru rtse /gla rtsi sgog pa cis 314

skyes dang / /shing kun phur rnga 'i 'dab ma dang / / dwa rgod 'bras bu mar la sbyar/ /grang srin tsha srin chang chu rta bsgyur sel /srin 'joms ril bu bka' rgya ma/ /i thi/ gtum po (bong nga ) drag po (ra dus rtsa ) thog shing (re lcag pa )bser gyi me tos ka mo nya (thar nu ) me sa (shachen ) ka ra drug 'gyur sbyar/ /sanyan tshad rims smyon 'dre sha ser/ /mig ser rgya nad 'joms/ /'di za phrug dang 'brum bu la bsngags/ /za byed 'bar ba ces bya mang / /gnyen po spyor ba 'di lta ste/ /ra ru lug ru nying krad gsu ma (gyi gnob )/ tsha la bul tog mu zi gsum/ /chu rtsa dud pa tshwa mar gsum / /'ib btags mar dkar dag la sbyar/ /lus byugs spe nyi das la dusas/ /lan 'ga' byugs pas sel bar 'gyur/ /i thi/ dag byed so yi sra byed thabs /gser ma jog rgya skyesas nag rma tshur dang / ha shis cong zhi ril bur (chang gis sgril )bya/ /nangs par lto sto nga das (tha dang so )bkrus la/ /so steng bzhag la bcud len 'gyur/ /lha ba yo sa dang sra na ma rnams/ zla ba gcis si bar du srungs / /yang cig malas pa 'i zhal gdams la/ /lto stong dri chus kha bshal la/ /ril dkar (conga'i )byugs la kha nur bya /yun bsten pa yis bcud len glu 'gyur/ /mkhas pa g.yu thog mgon po'i rma na' lam bcu gsum ma rdzosas so/ /'di 'dra'i man ngag gzhan na med/ /yi thi/ shu bham/ /315

sman rgyam tsha/ rgya tsha/ shu dag sne'u sgog pa'i rtsa ba rnams cha snyom zhib btagasam ra nas la sbyar ba'i dwangs ma 'jam rtsi rma bar blug kha bag zan gyis bcad/ sman gyi rtsigs ma rnams zugs kyi sbu gur bcug la rkan drag pos 'jibs / sman ro bsal/ khrag byung na sman dang dusas snga ma bzhin bya/ nyin re bzhin du blugs pa bya/ zhag gsum song ba dang /lus mgo rnying ba brdung ba'i khu bas dusas/ srus gu tsha 'des dugs/ rna rtsar phying ba rme ra la btsos pas dugs/ rdo dreg pa sa dugs/ yang na chang gi nying khus dugs/ des 'on pa sel bar 'gyur/ rna ba 'ur zhing 'khrog pa dang / 'asags cing rnag grag 'dzag pa dang / sman ni/ ru rta/sgog skya / la phug pho ba ris yung ba rnams zhib btags shing mngar dang /tsam pa tsam byas la zhag gsum mnan/ de nas dngas ma rna bar blugabag zan gyis la bcod song bzhin byed/ rna ba'i nang du mag yong ba la rgya tsha/ lug ra rog cu chu dang sbyar nas rna bar blug na phan/ byed lusas sngar dang 'dra'o/ /phyag sman mkhas pa'i khyad chos yi thi/sa yi brje gdugs phub pa/ gdugs kyi yo byad thams cad kun/gdugs rtsib tsha la btags pas rkang / ma rul de yi khud du sum/ zhib btags chu la skur la gtong / sha dug nad la bdud rtsi 'dra/ phyag mi na dge bsnyen khyad chos yin/ rta sbangs btang ba'i shul du dbyar ka skyes pa'i nang nag po yod pa de la zer ba yin/ g.yung gnag ra sha bra bo sran ma dang /bu ram sbrang dang chang nyog ma sangs pas/ nu 'bying bre lkog lce sgo 'i sogs 'phral du skrang de nyid rdol la'am/ rtol sngag rtol 'phyis na/ de lta bu la brten nas rma sacis byung / de nyid sos par byed pa'i thabs bstan pa/sman ni tsha ba gsum dang yung ba dang / bye'u nas zan brun dang srin bya'i brun/ gro'i skum dang zhib btags lum sa su gzhug phyag sman mkhas pas 317

'khru ba'i rigs snams gcod/ phyag sman mkhas pa'i khyad chos yin/ dmu chu srung ba'i man ngag la/ sman 'a / a ru ra/ snying zho sha ru rta /lcam pa/ gze ma/ nye 'ing / rgyam tsha/ gser bye brag zhun rnams mar dkar dang sbyar la/ skar khong re tsam la gtong ngo / /'di yang rin rgyal man ngag yin/ ga du ra nag po'i sbyang rgyug la/ sgog nas zho do/ phag ril bsregs pa zho gsum/ kyi lce bsregs pa zho bzhi/ snya lo bsregayopa zho drug 'di rnams zhib btabs chang bzang bo phul lu do la btab la gtong ngo / /zhu rjes bzhi phul sang gtong / 'di yang dge bsnyen phyag len yin/phag tshil/ phag gi rkang mar/ sprang / tshwa/ mar snams bu mo stas lo mas sbyar nas rkang mthil bol gong la bskus na gon gon long ba kun gzhon nu ma ltar mig gsal bor 'gyur/ 'di yang rin rgyal gdam sa ngag yin/ gi wa nga / gur gum/ ba le ga utpal/ tis ta/ ba sha kabrag zhun/ ru ta/ gser me/ ka ra drug 'gyur gtong ba yis/ mchin pa'i nad rnam sa tshad pa sel / gi wang dgu ba zer 'di yang dge bsnyen gdams ngag yin/ phyag sman mkhas pa'i khyad chos yin/sman gyi bla la phyas 'tshal lo/ /rgya nad mig ser zhes bya ba/ stobs chen drag ngo 'i rims nad de/ ma khris yu la dpa' bo gnyan gyis 'phrog la lud sanas 'gyur rtsa la zhen no/ /mkhris pa yos pas lus zungs bsregs/ phyi ser na zug bar du 'khyug na long med par srog la rgol/ 'di la sos dal glod long med/ dug sdong bcad la me dpung bsal/ 'jigs pa srung la ngan skyug pho/ so ba ge la g.yang du bkugs/ 'dzi drug shes na malas pa yin/ rta ri drug sgris dus sdong bcad/ dngul chu mu zi gla gul bong nga /a ru ra/ stag sha snon pa yang yo da/ chang chu gang 'gro dbul/ bsil chen drug gis tshad pa ga'il gur gum/ brag zhun/ gser me/ dug 320

nyung / par pa ta/ stag sha mang ngam chu gang 'azod dbul lo/ /dpa 'a bo drug gis 'jigs pa srung / bzang bo drug la zer/ rkang mgyogs drug gis ngan skyus pho/ thar nu/ dur gyid/ re lca ga pa/ sngon bu/ khron bu/shrī kharṇa/ so pa drus gis gros thad dpyad/ shu das stag sha ba yi 'o ma la btab la satong / sgru nag myang rtsi spras chang la btab la gtong / gla gul skar chu la btab la gtong / bon po drug gis poyang len bya/ tig ta drug pa 'i sman ma ra 'dis/ nad lhag zung du rgyug par byed/ tig ta dus nyung gser me 'bras bu gsum/ drug drug mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag drugashin tu gces pa 'i ya nga snying yin/ snying nas byung yang khu sgor sdom/ nga min gzhan la yo da pa min/ ngom gyin ngon gyin gsang la sdod pho khyad 'don na dgos pa yin/ srog 'dzin rdo rje'i lcags kyu yin/ mi srog 'dzin pa'i bdud rtsi zhags pa bya ba yin/ bu min ga'an la spel mi bya/ nga min gzhan gyis shes pa min/ dge bsnyen phyag len man ngas yin/ snying dang 'dra bas gces par zungs/ phyas sman mkhas pa'i khyad chos yin/sacig brgyud kho na'o/ /tshethi/sman chen gla rtsi aru gser mdog byi tang ba du ta/ ma ru rtse/dwa ba'i rtsa ba/ phur mong lo ma/ thang phrom pa/ shu dag sum sha sbyar bas srin dang glang thabs la so gas la bdud rtsi yin mgo srin la sosas srin nad kun la phan/ phyag sman mkhas pas mdzad pa yin/ mdze tsha rgyal bo yin pas sum gnyis tshad/ rgyar tsha blon po yin pas sum cha tshad/ kha ru tsha btsun mo yin pas nges pa med gangs chu la solas chus phul na bsil du 'gro/ chang dang dus khus phul na drod du 'gro/ sings po co dar la sogs pas phul na snyom sa su 'gro/ phyas sman rin rgyal phyag len yin/ e thi/ma na ngag byad par can gyi nd+ra na la/ sman chen/ chu rtsa rkang 0cig ya 321

phyag tsher sngon/ a ru ra gser mdog na chen sanyis gur gum rnams sbyar nas gtong bas rlung stod 'tshangs snying gzer kun la phan/ g.yu thog mgon po'i phyag len yin/ thar nu'i sbyor ba bstan pa ni/ pi sti (thar nu yin kun 'dra )rgya tsha dwa rgod dbyi mong sbya ra bas gre 'gag nad la phan/ pi sti a ru ra/ bong nga / shu dag su gul dri chur sbyar bas lhog pa sel/pi ste/ rgya tsha/ shu das chu dron sbyar bas bad mkhris la phan/ pi ste kha ru tsha ru rta chang la sbyar bas sbo sa pa sel pi ste klad pa tshwa dang mkhan pa skum dron mo sbya ra bas lu mas su gzhug rkang ba'i ro ma sha ro gnyan dbyung zhing sel / pi ste mi rus nya rus bsregs thal/ cil ba'i byab ra sbang ma sbyar ba'i 'u mas su gzhug 'bras 'a sogs ru sel ma lus 'byin par byed/pi sti bsres thal mu zi bul tog sgos dkar/ sha ru bsreg thal/ mar ram tshil bu la sbyar bas / za sga shu ba 'brum bu lhang nad sel/ pi sti bsreg thal sprang sbyar bskus gyur na/ rta bong sgal ba 'bras la phan/ pi sti bsregs thal ra ru nying sprad/ spo sa dkar sha thar nu zho sbyar bas mes tshig rma la phan/pi sti dres ma bsreg thal tsha phab mu zi bul tog spo sa dkar zo nas mar kha tsha 'di la 'byar bas za 'phrug sel/ pi sti za bsreg zo mar sbyar bas za 'phrug sel/ pi sti sha thal sbo sa dkar zangs phye btab pas rma rnams sos pa yin/pi ci tshwa dang sgog skya ra khrag gi 'brum bu so srin nad la phan/ pi sti phul gang la /zang drug bzhi cha gcig gla rtsi ril ma tsam gcis gu gul blo dog tsam gcig 'dzin pa ril ma tsam gcis bong nga sran ma tsam gcigamadze tsha ril ma tsam sacig stag 'a tshum pa gcig mu zi sran ma tsam gciga.a ru ra brgyad 'gyur g.ya' kyi ma dum gcig dur byin shrī khaṇḍa dan rog sngo na bu khron bu lnga bo sbyang nas mnan no/ /gzhan ma 'o ma la btsos na bad gan nad la bdud rtsi 'dra/ chang la btsos na rlung nad pa la bdud rtsi 'dra/322

dri chu la btsos na gnyan nad la bdud rtsi 'dra/ gsum ka rang thim la song song btso/ pi sti'i gdams ngag zab/ g.yu thog mgon po'i khyad chos yin/yi thi/ sangs rgyal sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo/ /g.yu thog mgon po'i dzi ba da gzhung gis/ kun tu rgyug pa'i ril bu ni sman chen/ a ru —sanyis/ ru rta/ shu dag gla gul/ gyur gum/ cu gang / gi wang /shog shing / thar nu/ chu rtsa gri sha dang ni bcu gsu ma ste/ yang na dzā ti shing kun sbyar/ /'di yi sbyor ba ldan gyur na/ /stod du babs pa'i stod gzer thub/ /smad du babs pa'i smad sazer thub/ /gag pa lho ga gsum tshad pa thub/ /khyad par gnyan gyi rigs la bsngags /thun tshad/ a ru ra dang dur byid sman chen drug 'gyur/ gi wang ma dos 'gyur gla ba dri thon/ga na rnams cha snyom lo brgyad dri chus sbyar/ ril bu bra ba'i ril ma tsam/nad kyi stobs dang sbyar la gtong bar bya'o/ /de ltar 'dzam bu gling na'ang dkon/ ming yang ril bu rta 'dod zer/ phyag sman ma khas pa'i khyad chos yin/ yi thi/sangs rgyas sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdud rtsi sngo yi sbyor ba bshad /byi lce da ra bo/ stong ri zil ba/ gang ga chung / par pa ta bzhis/tshad pa'i nad rnam sa sel/ mgo bo na na/ tig ta/ g.ya 'a kyi mo sanyis po gang rung gcig gtong / khur mang bsnan/ glo mang ba la sro lo a krong bsnan/ khrag shas che na spang rtsi dwa bo/ ba sha ka bsngan/ mgri/ sa pa la dug nyung skyer ba'i lo ma bsnan gnyan la gla gul stag 9 bsnan/ pho ba na na se 'bru shing tsha bsnan/ chu 'gags lcam pa/ rgya tsha bsna na/ rgyu long na na su ga smel ba lu bsna na/ 'khru na me rtog bya rkang tha ram na ram bsnan/ sngo stor bsdu sa pa'i yang snying yin/ sngo'i rgyal bo sde ba dang / slob dngo na lnga dang /dam sa mi dgu 'di sbyor rshas na malas pa yin/ rgyal bo bzhi ni/ hong 323

len gyi lce sang ga chung / sro lo dalar bo ba'i yin no/ /slob dpon lnga mi rtsi dmar chang (raskon yin )sa/cig spang rgyan dkar bro/ spang rtsi do bo/par pa ta/ rtsa mkhris pa ste lnga'o / dmag mi dgu mi/ brag skya ha bo/'dzin pa tig ta/ su ma cu tis stong ri zil ba can/ pri yang ku/shug pa 'i lo ma/ nyang rtsi spras / 'ba' sto ba dang dgu'o/ /'di nyid sbyor ba'i thabs bstan pa / rgyal bo ba'i bo cha snyam bya/ blon po lnga dang dam ga mi dgu/ rgyal bo'i phyed phyed gtong bar bya/ kur sbyar phye ma gangs chus phul/yang na thang du gtong bar bya'o/ /'di yoyon tan brjod mi long / tshad nad kun la phan pa ste/ mchos tu sru sa po'i tshan pa sel/ dug gi nad la rab tu bsngags/ rims kyi tshad pa thams cad la/ thang du gtong /yang na lca bsil stag sha khu bas phul la gtong / gag lhog la ni dri chu'i phul/grum bu'i nad la bong khrag phul/ byung na dron mos phul/ glo ba'i nad la sro lo'i khu bas phul/ tshad pas 'khru na brag zhun khu bas phul/ tshad pa byer zhing rnying ba na/ char chu gangs chus phul glo tshad lud pa dud khu la/ se rul khu bas phul/ tshad rī sa dri ma 'gasas pa na/ ba chus phul / gre ba 'gag pa la spa nga rgyan ku bas phul/ zhib btags ka ras rta byas char chu'am gangs chus phul bas/ tshad nad thams cad sel/ tshad pa rab 'bring tha rmi / sman thun rab 'bring tha ma gartong / dug si risas la bye'u la phug pa/sgong thog pa / srad dkar/ 'dam bu ka ra'i khu bas phul/ phyag sman rnam sa kyi snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa yin nas ngo dgu sbyor ni khyung lnga / gu gul/ stag sha brag zhun pu se/ dgu sbyor 'dis gag lhog gzer gsu ma gnyan la bsnga gas pa yin/ g.yu thog mgon po'i khyad chos yin/ phyag sman ma khas pa 'i khyad chos yin/ kun la ma spel snying la 'chang / i thi/ sngo sbyor bdud rtsi 'dus pa rdzogs so /324

na mo rmi rmu shrī/ glo tsha ba'i rgyu ni/ mchin mkhris kyi tshad pa stod du shor ba yin/ de rgyas tshad yin pa sa ga du ra/ bzang drus gi wacho / tsan dan dkar dmar/ rgun 'brum/ shing mngar sro li/ li ga dur /ka ra sbyar bas chu satsang phul/ rkyen bras shul dang tsha skyur gdon la rkyen nas yong / gro'i lud pa rnam pa lnga gzer lusas rnam pa lnga / gso thabs rnam pa lnga'o/ /lud pa rnam pa lnga la/ khras tu lu ba glo ba nas yong / mkhris pa ra lu ba pho mchin gnyis nas yong / bad dan du lu ba phro ba nas/ spe snabs 'dra ba 'byar bag can 'ong / dud khur lu ba she dul 'dra ba mtsher ba nas yo nga / rlung du lu ba rnam pa lnga'o/ /lud pa skya sob sbu ba can snying nas yong / gzer ba rnam pa lnga las/ glo gzer ba rgyab la gzer na/ glo sman 'tshosas tshad satong / glo ba dang mchin par bzer ba/ sayas gzer na/ tig ta dang brag zhun 0tong / glo ba dang / mtsher bar gzer na/0yon 0zer na mtshal dang / gla rtsi ka ko la gtong / glo ba dang / snying du gzer na/ mdun du gzer na/ dzā ti li shi cher gtong / gso thabs lnga/ gras lastobagasha bya ba/ khrag dud khu 'dra na gang rgyas kyi rtsa la btar/mkhris pa lor du sgyur ba ni/ 'u da pa ser na ba la bya/ bad kun gsang du drang ba ni/ sbe snabs la yang na glo bshal skyug yang bya/ dud khu rnas tu bsgyur ba ni/ mtshal/ dom mkhris / rtsos nag dam ra gsum sogs kyis bsgyur ro/ /rlung sgo zas kyis sdom pa dang lnga'o/ /gsar bcud bag re gtong / ma jug tu che ru thong / khrag la stobs sha bya ba chi/ glo tsha ba la brag nang du brtol ba dang / phyi ru drang ba gnyis las/ stobs mi bya ba la/gtar 'u gas mi dang bo nang rtsa rul nas 'gro bas mchen rtsa gtar/ bar du sgang rtsa mkhris rtsa sosas mang du gtar/ tha ma glo rtsa gtar/ khyad par du'ang gang bab rtsa la mang du gtar/ mkhris pa 'or du bsgyur ba ni/325

phangs kyang gser chos min pa ra nor phyir mi btang / byams sem sa ldan pa'i bu la byin/ nga min ga'an la yod pa min/ yod med sman pa sazhan la dris/ lag la blangs pas shin tu zab/ khu tshur rme na ngas snying nas phyung yang kha sgor sdom/ dpe mthong ba tsam gyis go yul skye ba yin/ nge phyir mi la mi bstan pa yin/ snying dang 'dra ba'i bu la satong na dpe'adi tshang mar ston cig dpe sna gcig spya da dang phan mi thogs/ phyas sman rnams la log lta skye/ yon dang mna' sogs long la byams sems ldan pa'i bu gcis la rgyud ma bcad khu tshur tshang mar byin/ gcig brgyud ma chad byed pa phyag sman phyag len yin/ yi thi sadams pa khyad par can dmu chu bcos pa'i ma na ngas la/ ba dmar mo 'i chu la sngags 'di bya'o/ /oṃ ma ni la sum / seng ge la gya gyu/ chu ser 'obs su thi nga ba ni/ 'og nas phyung cig su hā/ btsun pa 0tsang ma bzhi sde gcis ma ṇi bgrang du bcug rang nyid spyan ras gzigs su bsgoms/ bum pa gcis zangs min pa'i rdza ma byung na dga'o/ /bum pa'i nang du ba chu blugs nas sngags bdes so/ /lto snyi na 'di rang nas chosalto sra na/ sman la chu ser sman gsum/ rnon po gsum / dur byid shrī khan/dan rog dong ga byang ba med pa'i rtsa spyongs kyi sman rngams/ ba chu la dar btsags byas la satong / sman ngal bo yin/ nad sdo bas dang sbya ra/ rlung chu 'angebs nga 'i sman ni/ mdze tsha/ lcam pa'i 'bras bu/ chang nas phul la gtong / yang lusas gcig la/ mdze tsha/ nyi dga'/ go stod gsum chang gis phul bas chu mang du 'gro/ ming yang khu lung g.yab 'debs zer/ phal cher 'di rang gis sel bar byed /mi rta chu sdom pa'i sngags la/ oṃ ram ram/ tsir tsir rtses rtsegs rbad nyil rwa ta/ zhes bzlas pa / chang ngam chu la btab la sa/tong / yang lugs gcig la/ rang a tsa rar bsgoms/ sngags mi yo raṃ raṃ tsheg tsheg32 rka

pa 'i tshebazhan la'ang ster/ rang la'ang 'bad/ de'i dus na sngags 'di blo la yod pas dus thul/ dper na sngags 'di blo la yo da pa'i mi gcig dus gi lung ba la 'grim na dug 6 nus pa nyams 'gro ba la the tshom sa la dgos/de bas bser srang brgya yod kyang ci phan/ mi gcig na srog yang ga la bsab zer nas phul lo/ /sngas/sa mi bi shi yang / snyi ka 'bun badzra/ bi sha ke re me yong / yin sta ri gi ri gas ma pa sa la/ na so na te/ a pa tsa long /sa ma ba ta me/ ba so ki tsa 'o nga / yan ni ra ddha ra/ ddha ra rnyi/ tsa long shing gir a tho ra bis kun/ rna dzu la bu rdo/ ha rka ra ta ka ra/ zhes pa 'di dbusas kyi thon tshad brjod/ 'di la na ro bcu 0nyis/ gi gu nyer gcis 'greng bu drug zhabs kyu lnga/ bi bzhi/ bis gcig 'di rnams byung na tshang ma yin/ nam smad bya skad kyis ma non pa la bsnyen pa stong tsho gcis bskyal lo/ /gzhan la chu gtsang la btab la gtong rang la bzlas pa sa chos 'dis btsan dug sbyar dug lang dug sgong dugasha dus la sogs pa dug gi risas tham sa cad thub bo/ /oṃ shrī gu ru sko4 rakta dza ṭa/ rakta phaṭa/ rakta mu la dha ri ṇa u nyi sti ta/ manta ḍa yoni kra mā yi mi/ sha hūṃ tshe ta e de la/ chu ti nā ri/ tha ka ra hūṃ/ dogs pa yod par sngags 'di ci rma nga bzlas/ rdo rang cu/ dus rigs tham sa cad thub/ga na la byung na/ snod gas chag med par chu satsang ma blus la sngags 'di brgya rtsa la so gas pa bzlas nas khong du gartong na dug phyir skyus par 'gyur ro/ /yang na babs che na/ sngags bzlas shing rma bya'i sgros byang po/ de ltar byas pas dus ji ltar thu yang grol bar the tshom med do/ /bsten pa stong phras sacig sngon du song nas/ sa lo gyi'i ngan sngags dang / dug cu nad gnyis ka la bsngags zhes rgya gar barṇa chen nags kyi rin chen gyis gsungs so/ /yi thi yang dug ma na ngag khyad par can 'di dngo na 'ang na gzhon pas /330

bdag bla ma rin po che rnam rgyal ba la phul/ des bdag la gnang ngo / /gu ru sbas / bha su te ho/ na mo sho ha 7 la ko ri/ si smar/ rang nyid bram ze nag por bsgoms/ gzhung bzhin gyi lag pa g.yas dug gi lo ma khar 'dzug pa g.yon pa me'i 'gas pa thogs pa/ lus la me'i tsha tsha 'phro ba gcig tu bsam/ las sbyor gyi dus su 'dom bar gyi sa la bsngalas nas 'debs/bshugs pas 'bud nus pa dang bo mchin pa gnyis pa khyi las tshad pa sa shes so/ /bsnyen pa'i grangs tshad stong yin/ las la sbyor dus dug bab che chung la dpag la bya'o/ 'di ni myong bas grub pa 'i ma na ngag lag len ma rang yin pas the tshom skad cig mi bya bar las len la 'bad nas sems can la phan 'dogs byed pa la skyo dub bya bar mi risas so / /gu ru nyis/ sthā su te ho /na mo tho dha/ ka la ku tra shis smar/ zhes kyang zer bas/ nus pa sang che 'dren par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas sman gyi bla dang rmi/ 'tsho byed drang srong phyag ston zhu zhang dbon/ /'gro ba'i dug gsu ma nad sel mdzad pa yi /sngon gyi drang srong mkhas pa rnams la 'dud/ /rkyen dang sbyar dang dbyig dug sogs/ / sbyar ba'i dus dang zas mi 'phrod pa zos/ /nge das las byung dus rin 0so ba'i tshul/ /cho ga'i sbyor ba 'di lta ra bshad pa ra bya/ de la dang bo brtas thabs ni /res 'jos tu na zhing / skyes pa'i dbang bo stobs chung ba dang / lus rul ba dang lud pa 'thon rgyu med pa 'i glo chung 'byung ba dang ( lce'i bu dang bral ling shin tu dmar ba ni phal cher dug yin pa sa/ ji lta ra brtags na/trim nag gi tshod ma la nya phas gi rdor btab la 'thung bas shes ces dbang phyug chen pos 'jod/ za'i tshod ma la thog rma ra nya sha btab des ma thub na phag mi btab la btung / nges kyang ma thub na gnyis ka btab la 'thung bas thub nga ra 'gyur ro /tshod ma'i tshad ni gung phul ngo la byed/ yin na 3 31

zug rngu ga na dang mi 'dra ba yong la/ min na skyo na tsam mi 'byung / dngul dkar lhad med pa la sku da pa btags te/ jong du mi 'chor bar bya ba'i phyir so la skud pa 'dogs so/ /dus tshod ni nub mo gnyid du 'gro dus kha nang du bcus nas de'i nub khar bzhag sa nga snga dro sder ma'am zangs sder gang thab tu chu gtsang blug la de'i nang du dor bas/ dngul mdog nyams nas nag por song na dug yin/ ma dog ma nyams na dug ma yin no/ /yang na ba man gyi rwa phor du chang dang nad pa 'i dri chu 0nyis phyed mar bsres pa nyi ma la bzhig la/ gzi mo byi thur dang zer sgang thur gyis bkrug pa 'i tshe/ gzha' ris byung na dug yin la/ rma byung na ma yin no/ /yang na nad pa'i chu gtong ma khad kyi dron mo la/ ri bong gson ngo 'i rma ra bcug la/ rtse mo gug na dug yin/ ma gug na min no/ /yang na ba dmar mo'i 'o ma la/ lhum bu re ral lam/ spre mjug cing sang rung 'ib nga ra btags pa btab nas 'thung bas bshal dang skyugs byung na dug yin/ ma byung na min no/ /de ltar glu brtag thabs bzhi gas brtas pa legs/ sang rung gcig gis bltas pas shes par 'gyur ro/ /de nas dug yin par shes nas gso ba'i sman ni /so ma'i sman dam ra bo rab/ dkar bo 'bring / ser ngo tha ma ste/ gang rnyed dang / gla rtsi lhad med pa/ a ru ra rnam rgyal la snying bo sgonyis yod pa'am/ zur bcu ba'am ma rnyed na bser mdog gang 'byor bse ru dkar bo sde man bzhi bo des 'o cha la btegs pa'i bzhi'am re dang / byung sder dkar bo dang dam ra bo drus gam re/ btsod shing lnga'i tsha snying lug lga bal tshil can gyis bstums la mer bsregs nas/ bal rnam sa gcob tu song ba dang grang du bcus la ga'ob rnams bas la ba'i tshwa zho phyed rnams zhib par btags la/ nad zug sazer che na sman rta med pa thun bco lnga byas la zla ge phyed kyi bar du brtsen par byas shing / na zus chung na mi na gyi 332

bungs sanyis 'gyur tsam gyi ka ra dang bsres la / zla ba gcig gi bar du bsten pa ra bya'o/ 'phul byed mi rtsam rgyal dbyug gu 'ing cu thang la bya zhing /ma rnyed na chu skol gyis phul 'o ( /sbyo nga dgos la nge yang sngon du nad sdud dgos pa sa de la nad sdud pa'i sman ri/ shing se ba/ chu thing 'om bu/ ci ma ma se ba skyer ba rnam sa kyi bar shun dang / spyi bsil shing mngar rnam sa cha mnyam par byas pa'i/ grang du bcus nas drod cung zad ma yol bar zhag sasum nas bcu'i bar gang rung bston pa ra bya'o/ /pho bar 'dril nas gsus pa sbo sa pa dang / long 'brol bar byung na nad 'dus pa'i rtags yin pa sa/ thang gi 'phro bcad nas sbyong ba'i la sa bya'o/ /de yang ji lta ra na a ru ra rtse snyung ba'i'i rtse mo dang / dan rog bdun skog bshus pa'i lce bton pa dang / dur gyid dang / thar nu ba/ sgog pa bshus pa gnyis lug gi ril ma tsam re dang / shrī khaṇḍa zhes grags pa bse lo dkar bo'i thang chu bzhi rnam sa dang dong ga'i nang gi 'khor lo gsum dang / /tsha la gla ba'i ril ma tsam gcig dang / pi pi ling bdun rnams re re bzhin zhib pa dang 'dres par bsres nas ril bu sran btsos tsam byas te nad pa lus zungs bzang ngan na so can gcon/ nad tshabs che chung sogs la dpasas pa'i bcu gcig nas nyer lnga 'i bar rig pas brtag pa ra bya zhing / yu gu shing gis phul la gtong ngo / /sngon 'gro la ma khan pa dang sbang ma gar bos 'u sa bkrus te tshigs gzhung sug ba'i la sogs pa/ gsus pa ma gtogs pa rnams la mar dkar gyis byug pa nyi ma sanyis gsum byas nas gtong na 'ju ba sla zhing dga' bar sems so/ sbyong gsum bzhi'i bar du re re bya'o/ /chu ma khol ba 'jam tsam gyis lcas bya ba sogs sbyong gzhan dang mthun no/ /nge'i rjes su pho ba'i me drod skyed dgos nga sa/ 'jam 'bras byi tang ba tsi tra 7 me 'bru/sug smel/ sga skya/ ba 'u dkar bo'i 'dab rma rnam sa cha ma nyam pa'i phye ma 333

bu gsu ma gyi khu ba ste/ /tshes pa bco lnga'i snga dro nyi shar dus/ /lce la 'phog par sman gyis la ba la nas/ /de yi rjes la sgra ni med pa ru/ /legs par bkrus pa phyi ru dor ba ste/ /de ma thag la lce steng gri yis bzhar/ /de'i mod la btsan dug bzang bo dang / /a bhi sha yi 'bras bu bse yab rtsi yis sbyar la lce steng bzhag de steng dar dmar dri mas ma gos pa/ /sman steng dkris la nyi shar tsam gcig bzhag de nas tsha ber tshul rkang byung ba dang / /dar dmar bsal la de steng sman gyis bkru/ /de byis phyis su spyor ba byung ba'i tshe/ rang gi lce la sngar ba na yong bas na/ de dus dug sater lag nas bzung bar bya/gdams pa 'di 'dra shin tu dkon pasan/ chu sron srir gyi kha bzhin legs par bsdo mas / dug sbyor mang bar phan sems kho nas spel/ lag len phal che ba dang rjes spyod sogs gong dang mthun no/ /yi thi/ tshal 'byor gyi —dbang phyus chen po dpal chen sha ba ri la phyas 'tshal lo/ /oṃ pra ku na tsos 'phel dha sha ri/ shwa ri man tra oṃ āḥ:/ oṃ shrī gu ru asto/ rakta dza ḍa/ rakta phaṭa/ rakta mu tha dha ḍa mi/ u ma ti ste mchu yi ni/shakung tsha dha ye/ de la yung thi/ ma ri tha la ri hūṃ/ oṃ ma rghaṃ/ tshopa ru pa rme / phu ra garsā/ pa ri ṇa/ rma na'o/ i ba na/ som i li/ su su mi ni ra/ mi ra ha ra thi bi sha ka ri thi pa mi mosirnyi gu ru pā zhu dza ni/ zhes pa dang / mo bi ru na ga la (bza' zhi ma'i sbyor ba bsngags/ 'og ma lo na byad chos yin ) tsastu ta hu bi sha ma hwa ra ti dzu sha yi bhi sho na shu bhi swā hwa/ gza' nyi ma la solas pa'i tshe/ sngags drug cu re bdun bzlas la/ chu gtsang ma la btab/ lag pa g.ya sa pa'i mtheb chen srin ma dzub kyi rtsar gtugs pas/chu de sayon phyogs su dkrug ste 'thung na tshe 'di la dug cu gnod pas mi tshugs nges so 'di ni rgya gar ba'o chen nasas kyi rin chen gyi sa/dmas pa khyad par can lags so /dus gi nad brtas pa'i thabs zab mo 'di/ nad 3 36

pa 'i srin lag gnyis nas/ khrag sran thos tsam bton nas chang gar ma'i nang du blug pas/ sngo dmar byug yo nga na dug yin no/ /yang ba man gyi rwa nang du nad pa 'i chu btang ba la ri bong cu/ rma ra bcug la/ de tshig tsam khyogs na dug yin no/ /rmi nga na nad pa'i stsa khrag this pa gsum ba man gyi rwa nang blus pa'i lar chu gtsang ma blugs pa'am / nge gnyis go log pa gang rung byas pas khol na dug yin no/ /yang na nad pa'i chu dang chang bzang bo mnyam du ba man gyi rwa nang du blusas pa la/ gzi mo byi thur gyis dkrug pas sngo dmar khyus byung na dug yin no/ /rmi nga na nad pa'i sna khrag bong bu'i 'o ma'i nang du blugs pas/ de'i nang du 'gron bu bcig bcus nga la gzi mo byi thur gyis dkrus pas khrag dang 'o ma so sor phye na yin/ yang na nad pa'i chu nang du khyim bya mtshal bu'i gre ba nas khrag brton pa blug nas/ de la bong nga dkar bo'i bye ma shad tsam btab nas ba sa pas dar cig nas chu rnag tu song na dug yin no/ /ya nga na dngul dkar lhad med pa leb mo gcig dar ram ras skud kyis lung byas nas/ mtshan rngo ra smra bcad byas la lce thos tu bzung nas nyal rte/ nangs par dngul de nag por so nga na dus yin no/ 'di bad mkhris tshabs che ba la yang yo nga gin 'dug pas/ phyi skabs na dug yin/g.ya' sla na nges pa med do/ /mi 'gyur ba'i rtasas ni/ gser sbram po bsregs pa nad pa'i chur skyur bas dus yin na nas ngo ra 'gro/ ma yin na chu sazhan gyis dri ma 'don par byed pa ma yin no/ nad pa'i chu la kho rang gi sku dang bzhan gyi skra bcug pas/ mi na ba'i skra snal mar yong dug can gyi skra tshig pa dang 'phyogs pa dang / chag pa yong ngo / /rmi nga nad pa dang / mi na ba'i chu de sla ngar skol bas chu gzhan skam nas 'gro dug can gyi chu kha dha'am la cha lta bur 'gro bas/ de'i mdog kyang 'ja' chen 'dra na dbyig dug dmar na sha dug sanag na rdo dug so gas shes par bya'o/ /ya nga na 337

gsum nyi shu'i sbyor la lto stong khyor gang 'thung / nyin phyed zan mar phor ba re za/ de ltar lan gsum sbyor ba yis / sha dug sbyar dug btsan dug rnam sa/ oṃ ma ṅgā nyis ka ro tsa sgos/ ting ku la sgos/ na ga sing nan rbad su hā/ sa'i ma lo sod/ nub bram ze sod/ kur bram ze sod/ 'os gi bram ze sod/ lo sacig thub par gdon mi za/ lan res zla ba ba'i bzhi thub/ sta ga sha rang si dri chu gnyis sbyor ba 'thung bas 'ag bdun thub/shin tu zab pa 'i man ngag 'di/ gser zho re dang brje bar bya'o/ /zab i thi/ rgya rgya rgya/yang dug srung zab mo 'i byad chos lugs sacig la/ rgyal bo khrag si srung ba zhes bya ste/ bu mo rigs bzang ba lo brgyad dam bco brgyad lon pa la gtar sa byas pa 'i khrag khyor ba gang la bzang bo drug nas tsam re sa pur nas phyed/ ldum bu re ral sran ma tsam/ a ru gser mdog tsha la /rgya tsha/ bong nga dkar bo gla rtsi rnam sa nas re'i tshad zhib par btags la/khrag grang mo yin na cung zhig bgros dron mo yin na de rang la btab/gnan la 'ag drug so/ /de rjes ril bu ril ma tsam du bsgril nya ra legs par bya/ ming ya nga dbang ril ril bu zer/ zos pa'i phan yon gyis lo drug gi bar du dug thub/ casas ji ltar 'byung na dug long du byung ma khad skyug yong / khong du dug chags pa'i skabs med de/ gla ba'i dri chil gyi skyug yong / 'di las zab pa'i dus srung med pas/ 'di ril bu re re dang rta re brje'o/ /dug brtag pa 'i thabs la/ ldum bu re ral rdog po gsum/ a ru ra gser mdog rdog po gcig de rnams zhib par btatsas la thang du bskol nas gtong bas/ dug yin na khong bar dros tsam la/ gang la babs pa'i don snod la gzer langs yo nga / dug min na mi yong ngo / /yang dug brtag pa'i thabs gcig la / dang bo phyag tshang ba la brtag pa ni /33 9

rdor btab 'thung ba yin /yin zhes dbang phyus chen ngo sa 'dod/ /de ltar yin pa'i thos ma la/ bar shun sasum gyi khugs su 'jus nges ni stod kyi 'phro ba sru nga / /ma nu thang chen drug pa yis/ /nd+ra da kyi nad bzhi 'phro ba srung / /lhum bu re ral so ma'i cha na/ /byis pa'i ra tshan lcags phye sbyar paza byed sbyongs kyi sbyo ra ba ri/ /a ru ra gcig me la bsregs ya ru ra 0cig sbyin bar bya/ /a ru ra gcig btsog bar bya'o/ /gser gyi me rtog e ran (dan da )gtong / /bdud rtsi g.ya' (kyimo )thun gcis rnams/ gangs chu tshol grang chu la btab sbyong byung lcag tu dong ga'i chu satong zhing / chu dron mar bcug lcag yang btong bar bya/ rtsam thang mar dang ldan pa'ang gtong bar gces/pho ba lo nga khar blug gu snum can bdus rjes su zhun mar ka ra bsten pa mchog 'tsho bar nges pa the tshom med/ yi thi/ tshosangs rgyas sman gyi bla la phyag 'tshal lo/ /snyigs ma'i dus zas ngan dug gi risas dar bar gsungs pa la / de'i gnyen ngo ra shin tu zab pa 'i sngags/lag tu blangs pas phan thogs shin tu che ba'i man ngag rgya gar barṇa chen nags kyi rin chen nas brgyud pa 'di/ dug gi rigs gang la ya nga / sman ci ya nga mi dgos par sngags gcig bus chog pa'i man ngag khyad par can 'dis/rang srung bar 'acod na nangs re bzhin sngalas brgya rtsa re bzlas pas thub la/gzhan gso na sngags chu long du thengs pa sa chog nges so/ /nad tshabs che na sngasas chu yu na bsrings so/ /zas spyod ni/ tsha skyu ra dul sungs rnying bcud rnams spang ngo / /khyad par lus spyod ni dal zhing nyin sanyid ma khris pa yo nga bas spang / lag len myong bas grub pa'i rme na ngas 'bi'i snga gas mi/ bla ma mnyes pa ra byas nas zhal las shes so / /'ji rgya gar barṇa chen la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma drung 'dul 'dzin ngag dbang bas zhus / nges bdag la dasos pa chen ngo 'i sem sa can gyi jon la rgya che bar dgongs nas gnang ba'o/ /mkhas nga 'i 343

dbang ngo 'jigs med grags pa ngas/ / rgya 0ra rgya nag gangs can malas rnams kyi/ /sngags dang sman sbyo ra dbang ril brtag thabs rnams/ /sems can don phyir zab bsdus yi ger bsod/ zab/ yi thi/slob dpon pad mas sasungs pa 'i dug bcos pa'i man ngas zab mo 'di la brtsom pa dang / bzlas pa dang / srung ba dang / brtasas thabs so/ /dang po ni rang nyid rma byar bsgom ste/ de yang mchu ser ba/ mig dang zang ba dmar ba/ lus po ljang gu/ mdongs rnams la kha dog sna lnga'i 'od 'phro ba zhas re dran tsam du bsgoms/ 0nyis pa bzlas pa'i sngags ni/ bla ma mnyes pa ra byas te 'al la sa shes so/ /lngasas blo la yod na rang gi sha dug btsan dug sbyar dus la so tsas pa thub nges so/ gsum gsum bzlas pas sbyar dug thub bdun bdun bzlas pas dug rigs thams cad thub nas rma bya 'dra bar 'gyur ro /zab yi thi/ sngags mang na bshal yong / brgya bas mang ba mi bgrang ngo rga /gsum pa srung ba'i thabs ni/ sngags gser yig tu gzab chung bris nas mgul du btasas na dug rigs thams cad thub/gzhan saso na sngags chu 0tong bas sos/ de'i ring la chang sru nga ngo / /btsan dug la ྅ gas bzlas pas thub / kṣ-i dus la yod pa sa chog sgong dug la zhag re la bdun bdun ma chags na thub nges so/ / zab/ i thi/ rgya rgya rgya/344

dngos su bstan nas / tsakra rgyal bo la man ngag rdzogs par gnang / rgyal bos zhang bo ti li ka ma la gnang / zhang bos bse yi ga 'ur bcug dar zab kyis dril nas gces spras su byas nas/ sems can gyi don la dbongs nas bod du khyer nas byon/ bsam yas su mnga' bdag khri sro nga lde'u btsan la skyes su phul bas rgyal bo dgyes nas dus kyi tha ma la phan par dgongs nas/rin po che'i gter du sbas nas snyigs ma'i dus byi/ byams dang snying rje che ba'i gang zag gcig dang 'phrad par shog ces smon lam btab bo/ /dus phyis lha sra sa mu tri btsan po la 'brum pa byung bas/ bod kyi lha rje mkhas pa mi dgu'i rgyud 'dzin rnam sa bsogs pas/ mkhas pa mi nyag gis/ lha sa la 'bas bskor mdzad paso lha sa'i sgo gong na/ bse yi ga'u dar zab kyis dril ba mthong nas/ lag tu blangs nas kha phye bas/ 'brum pa 'chos pa'i srung thabs/ brtag thabs/ gso thabs rnams gter nas gdan drangs nas/ rgyal bo bcos pa sa drags nas/ ma khas pa mi dgu'i nang nas kyang mkhas pa mi nyag mkhas par gralas pa yin/ ma na ngag 'di la gsu ma yo da pa la/ dang bo rang ga'an srung ba/ bar du nad brtag pa/ tha ma nad bcos pa'o/ / dang bo rang gzhan srung ba la/ phyi srung / nang srung /gsang srung ngo / /phyi'i srung ba rdzas sna dgu'o/ /ra tshil ra khrag su zi gsu ma/gur gum/ gla rtsi/ gu gul gsum/ tsan dan/ sgog skya/ shu dag gsum/ rang gi dri chus sbrus la 'u sa la byugs / rtag tu lus la bcangs par bya/ nang gi srung ba rdzas sna drug su gul/ gla rtsi/ shing kun gsum/ shu dag tsan dan mu zi gsum/ dri chus sbyar la khong du gtong /sngags 'di stong rtsa brgyad du bzlas/ tarya thā/ oṃ sham sham me/ sham sham nee ye swa hwa/ gsang ba'i srung ba la stong nyid bsgoms pa bla na med/nad brtag pa la lnga/ rlung las gyur pa'i 'brum pa ni/ phyi ru mi thon lus po 348

grang / zug gzer che la rtse 'dar mang / mkhris pa las gyur 'brum pa'i nad/ ma go na lus po khong nas 'dar zug gzer che la gli lam za zi mang /'brum pa mang ngo phung bor yo nga / mchog tu glo snying gre ba na/ bad kun las gyur 'brum pa ni/ lus thed chung ling skom dad che/ gnyid ni che la zas mi len/ na 'u gas chom pa ba'in du yong / 'brum pa dkar la skya hral 'thon//brag la sa gyur pa'i 'brum pa ji lus po khyong zhing rngul snyam byed/ mig dmar 'dar zhing zug ni dus tshigs khol/ 'brum bu dmar bo kha srun pa /'dus pa las gyur 'brum pa ni/ bsngags zhing ji ma 'greg pa dang / phyi nang med par khol zhing rtse 'dar 'byung / 'dar zhing kha sna lus po grang /'brum bu gsor mig lta bu 'thon mkhas pas gso sa na sos pa yin/don lnga dag la babs pa na/ snying la bab na smyo zhing tshig pa za/ zhag ni gsum gyi dgong mo 'chi/ glo ba dag la bab pa na glo mang gre ba 'gas cing 'u / zhag ni bzhi nas 'chi ba'i rtags/ mchin pa das la bab pa na/ ro stod na cing dbusas kha thung / lus ngo 'dar zhing 'thib bsngangs 'ong /zhag lnga'i nyi ma dros nas 'chi gi nga ba das la bab pa na/ dri chen dri chu 'gags nas 'chi/ 'ag ni nges pa med par 'chi/ gre ba dag la bab pa na/gre ba 'gres cing lce chung skrang / skad cis nyid la slob pa yo nga / rgyu long dag la bab pa na/ rgyu long na zhing 'khru ba yong / de nu chan tsam 'jigs mi dgos/ ma ra thab nang du log pa na/ las kyi 'chi ba yin par nges/tha rma gso thabasabashad pa ni/ rlung gyur ga pur nas ngo 'i chu/ ra khrag gla rtsi bzang drug dang / gu gul phag ril sreg thal ka ra sbyar gu gul chu'am lcags su bskol ba'i chu tshan phul nges kyang phyi ru ma thon na tsan dan dpor bo ka ra dang / cu gang gur gum mkhris chen dang / ra dang bse yi ko ba dang / ra khrag sbya ra ba byis pa'i dri chus phul la gnong / mkhris pa la 349

ka ra gnyis dang sbyar/ skabs su smyu ga skom bar du stem ( spyi gtsug 'ching zhing snum ldan du/ mig la bab nas mi long na/ skyer khaṇḍa/ ti tsha dkar bro/ phug ron khyag khye'u skyes pa'i nu zho dang / dom mkhris sbyar ba'i byug pa bya/ khrag gi ri mos sgro yis byabs/ de rjes gu gul chu yis bkru/tsha ba ya la na mur song mig rtsa bsregs / tsha ba zhi na grang ba bsad cing rlung la brngan pa byin/ lus po rlung dus 'dar zhing gnyid mi pheb/ rlung rtabs ston na gosar 'jam chang dang 'u sa sha gtong / mchog tu lug sha bsngasas pa yin/ bsku mnye lus po kun la bya/ nges kyang ma phan tshigs pa bdun pa lnga ba bsresas/ 'brum pas gre ba 'gags pa na / tshod ma tshan 'des gyur mid bya/ gzhan ya nga sman dpyad rig pa mda' yis bsnun/bdud rtsi gsang ba'i mdzod nang nas / /'brum nag saso ba'i man ngag phyung /'phasas pa 'jam dpal thugs rkya nying khu yin byams sems ldan pa'i mi dang ni/ /las 'phro can dang 'di 'phrod cig /phyag sman mkhas pa shaka yis khu tshur nang du sbas pa yin/ bu min ga'an la gas nga ba'i rgyu/ re re tsam la lung rnga nod bka' rgya byin/ shin tu zab yi thi/351

phan/ a ru brgyad pa dang / dzā ti bcu ba yin/ a ga ru a ru ra/dzā ti/ byi tang ga seng ldeng skyer ba/ tsha ba gsum/ rdo dres nas po/ sug dkar rgyarme tsha/ zhen sna/ sus smel ka ko la / go snyod/srin bu dam ra leb/ lang thang nag po/ yaṃ gnyis seng tsha byi skyer tsha gsu ma rdo/ sus rgyam zha sug ka ko/ /srin lang zhag gsum zug la 'brum rnying mgo rnams mtsha nad spyo nga / mgocung cis kyang ma sel na/ lus rmi so srul la sha rus phral/ dus khu bsdus la sha lpags brdung / zhib par dus khu mar dang bsdus/ sgos skya bco lnga/ gla rtsi phur ma nga thong gi mi na dang sbyar/ maso rlung thams cad sel ching 'joms/ nam gyi srod yol thum re za/ tshangs pa 'i dgu sbo ra chen por grags/ des kyang ma phan mgo rlung la/ re thag brgyad bzhir me this bzhag di nas thur du sa la tsa na/ 'gram nyams nam mthong 'gugs pa dang / mas rtsa dgye ba ces bya ste nya rengs yo ba ces dang zer/ de ni gso ba'i rim pa la/ stal mar dzā te long thang sbyar ba rma bar blugs bag zan tha bkas rna ba la bsku 'o/ /des sel bar the tshom med/yang na til dang yer ma pi pi ling / mi rus se mo'i zan dron gtug shu dag ru rta su ga pa gsum cha mnyam brdung ba rtsa ru blug yang na bul tos ras bas ma sa rna ru srubs pas smin pa 'byung / rma sman drag po mas bya 'dzis /sbrid pa thon nas mgoskrung zhi bar byed/ des sel bar ma gyur na/ rta bong 'o ma dron mo btung /sngas med stan la 'thung thog nyal ( /til ma ra byugs pa ya nga yang bsten /de yis stod rlung nad rnams sel/ /nge nas thur du 'jal pa na/ a na rshastong dang bo rlung gi tsasang / /dreg pa 'bor ba zhes bya ba/ /rlung nad kun gyi 'bab sa yin/ /ma dun du sazer dang rgyab tu gzer/ /dkar nag nu ma drang bo'i phyed/ /gzhung nas tshon gang ngo dang gsum/ /sayon pa phyed dang rdo do mi /dpal khab thusas spub bya ros mig steng 'og gyen rgyu'i 353

zas byi dbus su ni/ rgyalam re'i bar du bsnol ma gtong / /'jam rtsi song dang 'dra bar bston/ :des kyang bde bar ma song na/ /rgyab kyi tshigs pa drug pa ru/ cu se thur ma 'phang bar bya/ /thur sel rgyu ma sang ba dang / brla dbyi dal skyed mkhal ma gzer/ brla yi cu nga zur brgyangs snyam byed/ /sbos chung 'og rlung 'gags pa dang / /rgyu 'o nga 'khrog cing bshang lci sri ba yong / /de la gso thabs 'ji ltar bya/ /'jam rtsi la sogs gong bzhin brtsen/ /rgod po gzer 'joms dzā ṣka brgyad/ /nangs pa ra zas kyi sngon la gtorngo / /gang yang thur sel 'khrugs pa la/ /zas byi sngon du zhun mar sbyin bas phan/ /rlung nad rtsa ba'i rtags bstan pa/ /gyen rgyu'i rlung ni gyen du 'tshangs/ /brang cu mgo nas mgul ba ru/ /khu tshur gyen du bcangs pa 'dra/ /gzhan ya nga phrag pa nam thong dang / /brang stod la so gas brgyangs pa 'dra/ de la rlung sman dgos dus gtong / /sro ga 'dzin rgyungs pa'i sbubs su na/ /khyad pa ra klad pa 'i dkyil na gzer/ /dbugs 'chad 'brog 'gyel yang yang yong / /de la bcos thabs gong cu sman/ zas bams re dang bstsol la gtong / /des kyang ma sel rengs gyur na/ rgyab kyi tshigs pa drug pa kha sasum bsregs par byed/ /des kyang ma phan spyi gtsug bzhi khram bsregs / ma nyam gnas rlung ni pho ba'i dkyil du gnas /sbos chung skyigasabu ya nga ya nga yong / /yang na pho ba sdeb cing phur ba brgyab snyam byed/ /de la gso thabs zas zos pa dang bde tshul ston/ a gar brgyad dang se 'bru brgyad/ /gang 'phrod pho ba'i mi na sde rnams/ /nangs par zas kyi phyed la gartong / /khyab byed rlung chi 'u sa kun 'dar zhingal — ske dkrugs/ /'gro stobs 'chor zhing lasang tshig sru / /gtam la spyod sdom yi ga 'chus /bshang gcin dri chu sri'am ya nga na 'chor/ /di lta bu yi rtags byung na/ /khyab byed rlung mi 'khrugs pa ra gyur pa yin/ /gso thabs smo sa pa'i rlung sman snam sa /sgos skya cho dang sbyar ba la sogs par/ /nangs pa ra zas thos 356

rjes la ni/ /zas khams gcig gis bsnan la gtong / /thur sel rlung ni rgyu ma dang / / sgang ba long kha brla stod rnams / / sngo 'khrogs byed cing smad du glu 'khyugs/ /gso thabs bkru ma 'jam dang snum ldan gyis/ /mas gtong 'jam rtsi ma chog yin no/ / ga'an ya nga rlung mi na lnga chosas gang 'phrod gtong / /nangs par zas kyi sngon la gtong / /gzhan yang thur ser 'khrugs pa la sa/ sgyumago la nyi ma ltag 'khor dang / sgra can 'on pa zi thom dang / /nam tshong dgugs dang gnya' rengs dang / /'gram nyams pa dang kha 'chus dang / gal ba dang ni rnam ba'i ste/ /bcos thabs gong gi risas pas dpa bas la bya/ /go na ya nga phye ma ra lums la sogs rgod ma'i 'o ma sbyin pa dang / /gzhan yang rlung gi snum lums bya/ /ya na la ga 'dar dang gzhog phyed zha'am na/ /'bi sha tse dang brtse ba can/ /rkang ba la tsa pa gar yang sanas / /yan las rlung ṣka byed lugs la/ /chu bo gyen la gshags nas mi / rta bong 'o ma dron mo sbyin/ / snum/ lda na bcud kyi lums kyang bya/ / rkang ba das la gnas pa'i rlung rga brla rengs pa dang 'khyam rlung dang / / 'bi ༅ tse dang bzugs 'khums dang / rgyabartse ba rkang ba gnyis la gnas/ gsang dmigs mthe bo tshisas la sanas/ /du sa mo'i dkyil du zhusas pa 'i rlung 7 /rlung ce spyang 'dra ba sbo ma 'ing 'gril /ce spyang mgo 0cis yin zhes grags rga / nge lta bu ye gso thabs la/ /chu pyu gyen la dras gshasas la/ / rta bong 'o ma song dang 'dra (mar rnying phyed mar dron mo'i bcud/ /re rtsar sked las gtum pa ra bya/ /rta bong 'o ma 'thung nas rgyug mdur drag tu bya rlung mad 'joms par gyur pa/ la/ /0tar bar mi bya rtsa brtsol bya/ /rlung nad rtsa ba'i rtags dang sdom tshis 'dzi/ /phyag sman malas pa shāka ye yis / /rlung ma dzod dbar mo'i sde mig zur 'debs 'ji/ (khu tshur 'bum gyi snying bo yin/ /chung nas da lta rin rgyal bu la snang ba yin/ /'dzi bris dge bas sem sa can rnam sa/ /nad kyi zug rngu las 357
