de rjes rngul 'don dag la 'bad/ ma thon rlangs pa grang 'og gzhug chu tshan thang gtong gos byor dbyibs la bzhag rngul thon rjes la dro sar nyal/'brum pa lam bsal man ngag 'di/ mkhas pa rin rgyal bdag gi nyams myong yin/ 'brum pa nang du zhen mi srid/ gal te des kyang ma thon na tsher ma spang spos gcig thang btang sbal rgyab mdung rtse tsha ba gsum/chang khyor re la sbyar la gtong / tshad pa shin tu che ba na/ ga pur gla gul bzang bo drub ltas sprad tsha ba'i dus su btong / bar ram gla rtsi tsher sngon pa/ zhib btags chang phul sang la sbyar/ des ni mi thon mi srid ngo/ /yang na ga ngu ra gla gul yer/ /spa nga sngos ma ru chu sbya ra gcong 7 /rjes la rngul 'don byas pa yis /nad tshabs che ltar che rung kyang ( /zas sbyo da ma log 'chi mi srid / /zas su tshod ma tsha mo dang / /bil zan chag tses gre ba sbyong / /ba glang sha dang ba zho dang / /ba 'o dum pa bsten par bshad/ /darkar dang skyur rnams spang bar bya/ /spyi bo rengs pa mi da~X' bro ba dga'/ /de phyir thos mal dro sar bsdad/ /grang na 'brum pa mi thon pas /nges ma dro ba gces pa yin/ /khong thor phyi ru 'phul ba na/ /'brum pa chil gyi yong 'phro la/ /chad kyis so nga na khong du shor/ /'u da pa dmar rtsa ser bo 'byung / /bying 'thib 'dar mabasnga ngas smyo tshis ji / blo chung 'bud cing gre ba 'basas / /rtags ldan nang du thor bar nges/ don stod rnams la bab pa na/ /nges pa ra 'chi bdag kha ru tshud pa ra nges/ /de phyir phyi ru 'phul ba gces/ /phyir 'phul 'dzin pa nas tsam sacig ka ra sbyar la rngul 'don bya/ 'di ni shin tu mchos yin no/ /sal te nges kyang ma thon na/ gla rtsi shing kun zang nga dkar/ bur darkar ra khrag sbyar la gtong / des ni mi thon mi srid do/ /ya nga na 'phul byed ngo rtsi gnyis sba la rgyab dang ni mdung rtse gnyis/ dang bo rdo sbyo ra rgyad kyi sman/'phul byed gyad pa chen sku bzhi/ sbal rgyab ma dung rtse gcis thub mtshal/361

gyis sbyangs/ dur byid thar nu rgya tsha a ru mchu bsnyung gla gul stag sha shu dag re lcas gur gum gi wang chu ser sman gsu ma sbyar/ mgo bo la so gas skrang ba la sman gnyis chang sbyar lan gnyis btang / bong dkar gla rtsi chang sbyar btang / stobs chen gong gis bshal gyis sbyangs/ de rjes gnyen po'i sman gyis bsad/ thor bu'i bcos thabs bstan pa ni/ mig la 'brum pa byung ba ni/ nyin mo mig sman bsku bar bya'o/ /skyer khaṇḍa a ru ra ga pur/ dom mkhris cu gang byug nub mo rgya mtsho lci med bdug (chu drod 'a zer)/ gre bar babs pa'i 'gags pa la/ zhi byed rtsi sbyar sman la khyad par med/tsher sngo na spang sbos bsdus khu dro 'jam dang / sbangs khu bskol grang zhi bar 'gyur/ yang na li shi rtsangs pa'i tha cu sang mtshur dang ka ra sbyar/ras la bci mas nas mur nad sel / gre thor shin tu spyad darka' na 'gag pa bcod pa 'i tshul du bcad/ sman gyis ma chod dpyad kyis dpyad/chu ser thor ba byung ba la/ rgya tsha/ gla rtsi/ shu dag du rta/ zhib brdungs blug des ni chu 'bag sel bar 'gyur/ rjes la 'khru bas shi ba yang / de ni tsha 'khru ba'in du bcos/ rjes la rnag smon man ngag bya/ rtsa chu tshad pa chung zhing ma thil bzhir 'brum pa thon/ snga rme rnams ni rnag tu 'gro/de dus ri thang mtshams yin kha zas cha yis glod/ 'brum pa snag tu yong ba la/ sha ru'i thal bas gzhi bzung la / phur mo nga yob mo dres thal dang /chu rtsa zang gcis bya thal dang / rta sbang dbyar ba'i lci ba dang / srol dkar bsreg thal spos dkar sbyar ba lus nu byug rmag rnam sa skem sa par the tshom med 'brum shul subs pa'i thabs bstan pa/ shing kun chu yis bkrus rjes la ra phag tshil bu gang rnyed dang / a phyag tsher sngon sbyar bas byus rang gi dri chu dron mos bkru/ yang na ra brag 'ol mo dang / 'bri mog sbyar byugs le0sa pa yin/ de rjes seng phrom lde gus byusas/ sadong legs sha 363

mdog gsal bar 'gyur/ zas kyis gso ba 'in tu gces/ nyams kyi yig chung bdud rtsi'i jig pa gso dpyad shes bya'i dbyil 'khor nas/ shes rab btsal gyi rgyud lung man ngag rnams nas cung zad bsdus pa 'ji/ skyes bu me lha'i nyams yis yin/ la sa 'phro sad pa mkhas pa mi nyag bdag la sanang / 'dzi la gces spras gyis la bu min ga'an la gsang / man ngag 'di'i zur tsam gcig malas pa g.yu thog mgon ngo bdag la sbyin/ de min su la'ang gtad pa med/ 'bul don mang bo byed pa yang byung ste/ zur tsam min pa bstan pa med/ de phyir malas pa mi nyas gis saser g.yu gos dar rta la sobs mang bo zos nas brtse bas 'brum pa'i gdams ngag dzosas par btad do/ /rgyud 'dzi ma chad tsam re spel sems can don du rigs rgyud chad na phongs gsungs nas brka' rgyas btab nas gnang ngo / /deng sang phyag sman mkhas pa'i khyad chos yin/ /ston shas rin rgyal snying thig yin/ ‘gces nas ku tshur 'bur du sbas / /da lta sangs martson bdag gi lag cha glu yin/ /phongs pa sa mi phan chos rje'i stu ngo la /ston pa shes rab seng ge nyid la gtad /kun la ma spel snying la chongs/ /'dzi 'dra'i man ngas shin tu dbon/ phyag sman rgyud res 'dzin rgyu yin/ mi spel ba'i mna' re bya mi spel rgya gal spel na mna' dang yo na rdzosas gyis la byin/ mang na rin chen gser yang mod/ kun gyis shes na mkhas pa su yis byed/ de phyir shin tu gces par zungs / i thi/ shu snyam/364

dkar skol bshad byas pa dang sbyar sha ba'i ril rme tsam btang ngo ) ba dus nad sel/shing bcud lnga yi spyor ba yin/ ba tig bong hong gur chu tsan/ cu gang gi wang sprang dkar sbyar ba yis/ sto da 'khrugs glo nad sel bar byed/ (snga dro nyer gcig gi dus sto da 'khrulas glo nad sel ) gtso bo brgyad pa'i man ngag yin/kyi ru mdze ltar shu dang lnga phye ma/ (kyi lce dalar/ ru rta/ rmi dze tsha/ sta ra bu/shu dag dang / lnga'i phye ma chus phul 0tong ) ka ra rta yis 'khrugs rlung se la/gar rta star bu pa nyang rtsad grags gu ru la bsngags cis gi gsang ma skyu zhis ha la'i sdo nga bo(ku ru nyis dha ngu te'o na mo sha'o rka la ku dhe nyis ma ra) / khyad par btsan dug la bsngags/ dug rigasam kun la phan/ rtsad nas bcod/mu stegs thal kha'i bsgom bzlas gces/ (nu stegs thal gle/ sna zur ba/misakhung ba/ sku gyen du bcings pa/ kha nas me stag 'phro bar bsgoms ) shugs sgra 'ur bdun sbyor ba yin/ bsrung dur chem las sru ngas sru ngas/ ngur ngur/ chem chem/ khas bas / sod sod/ zer ro/ so da nga 'i sngags/gag pa / lhog pa / sag lhog gnyan rims 'jom sa par byed dug sbra nga lcags (sa lhog pa za ba/ rang nying dug la rgyu byas pa'i sprang ma mtshon cha che bas gshog pa / chung bas gzings spu byas pa ) bshol sgo ga po gcig ni bcu ni dbang dpa' bo ser bo cis thang zhas bcu dbang / ( ma ru gser mdos dang / ngapa' bo ser bo zhag nyer gcig) rtsa gcig rtsa gcig na/ zhag bdun sbyar dus 'joms/ (bong nga ser bo zhag bdunabatang bas rjes spyod do/ /ser bo bsum gyi sbyorab yin ) man ngag yid bzhin nor bu 'ji/ grags 'dod pa la chen po byin gab yis dang kha bo che ru byin/ don gnyer ba la (chan 'a 'di byin zer )chung ngu byin/ snying gi bu la sanyis ka byin/ dge bsten gyi bu la btang ngo / /thugs kyi nying khu zab/ yi thi/ mi thi/ mgi / tsho bkra shis 373

rtsa chu'i brtas pa rgyud gzhan ltos /'di dag bla ma'i 'al shes dang /snyan rgyud dmar khrid yig cha la/ /gab 'khrul nor lha sa ma chad bkod/ /man ngag 'di la dpe 'dis tshang / / 'dzi las lhag pa ngas ma brtsams/ / 'di chad man ngag kha yang ral/ /gcig med man ngag kun med yin/ /thams cad 'dus pa'i shog dril la/ /khu tshur 'bum pa zhes su grags/ /phyi yi skor la nag po zer/ /blon po mdzub khrid ldan pa ra gyis/ /bden rdzun lag tu long la ltos/ /gal te man ngag 'dis bsrus na/ /phyag stsa na bsalabar ngan 'gror sprod/ /the chom mi dgos nyams su long / /kho bo'i rjes 'jug bu slo ba kun/ /ngas rma nga' ris dbus gtsang kun tu 'grim/ /mtshan ldan bla ma mang du glu bsten/ /snyan rgyud bshad pa mang du thos / /bla ma slob dpon don ched du/ /lus stong 'dra ba'i mos gus byas/ /ci gsungs bka' la 'goms pa med/ /de phyir thugs rjes man ngag rnams/ /snga sri med pa ra mang du thob/ /rgya sar rgya nag phyi ba yi/ /chig brgyud bka' bgrol mang du shes/ /gso rig bsta na —bcos phyogs mthong tsam/ /gso bya mthong thos gang yang shes/ /khyad par bod 'gyur man ngag la/ /0so dpyad 'dzi ni shin tu dkon /gso dpyad man ngag 'di lhas med/ /sbyor nub sanyis ka phyogs mthun yin/ /phyag sman mkhas pas nyams len byas /de phyir man ngas mi la med/ /phul du byung ba phyag gi lugs/ /bcos sla da med pas rgyud snams bzang / /man ngag 'dzom zhing snyan rgyud ldan/ /phyag sman thob cog bdag gis sdebs/ /sngon dpyad rtsom pa bris zin gyis/ /man ngag phyi bsnan ma byed cis / bcos slad shor ba'i man ngag de/ nad la mi phan yi re mug / slo ba dpon mkhas la log lta 'chor/ /rnam smin duḥkha sna tshogs myong sgo nge bas ma bcos nyams su —— long / /snying dus bskyed la stod smad ltos/ /des ni i 'grub the tshom med /ngas byas pa la the tshom na/ /man ngag 'dzi la nyams myong zhing / /rtsa ba chod 376

cing ra las pa ni/ /nga 'dra bod du mi rnyed cing / /the tshom spangs la lag len gyis/ /snod ldan slob ma bsten pa na/ /khu tshur 'bum pa'i shog dril rnams/ / smod la brtasas shing rim gyis byin/ /snod min rnam sa 'a gas nga ba ni/ /yon tan ma bas dregs 'di mi dad/ / slob dpon mi khur man ngag 'do da / /'bul ba mi sprod thob grangs bgrang ( / kha bas sas ngos bstod gzhog slong mkhas/ /shes na man ngag zong lta ra 'tshong / slob dpon gas nga zhing rang bstod byed/ /shes rab chung zhing khong khro byed/ /gtam zhen che la snying rje chung / /mkhon la gas ra 'grogs che ba'i mi/ / rnam smin mi sems tshe 'dzi 'dod /de 'dra'i smod min gang zas la/ /ma na ngag lta zhog dpe ma ston/ /rang ca'an gnyis la gnod pa'i phyir/ /chu srin spyir gyi mgrin chud ltar/ la nas dbyung ba'i ska bas med do/ /'phral dge mabs 'dod can la so gas/ /ma go 'dra 'dra tsam byas pas/ /man ngas lhod par the tshom med/ /de phyir gdams pa 'di sbos shig / nga yi tha tshig mi sems pa ra /sal te nor dang rngo dga' la/ /dpe rnam sa ston par byed pa na/ /brka' sru nga ma bon pos rjes chod cis / nam mkha' rdzong du sbyar ba yi /'bri byed slob dngo na gralas se yin/ /phyag sman man ngag sater chen las /snyan rgyud gru gzings yodam sa pa 'di/ / skal ldan dbul phongs rab bsal nas/ 'gro ba'i zug rngu sku 'jom sa pa ra shog / 'di nyid zur du bskol ba'i phan yon gyis /man mala'i nor bu rjes 'jus la/ 'gro ba'i pad tshal rab rgyas te/ bso rig rkang drug ldan rnam sa kyi /bdud rtsi cung zad thob gyur cis / ces pa 'di gnas chen ga'ag tu zhus pa lags / margalo/ yi thi/ 37—
